jobs.title: Regional Account Manager, Sales - Mid-Central
jobs.excerpt: Job Type: Full-Time, Salaried / Exempt - $95,000 - $125,000 Job Location: Fully Remote Individual base salary for this role ultimately will depend on numerous factors, including but not limited to experience, job-related skills, relevant education or training, certifications, etc.
jobs.description:
Job Type: Full-Time, Salaried / Exempt - $95,000 - $125,000
Job Location: Fully Remote

Individual base salary for this role ultimately will depend on numerous factors, including but not limited to experience, job-related skills, relevant education or training, certifications, etc. As such, pay for the successful candidate could fall anywhere within the stated range. Beyond base salary, we offer competitive health, dental, 401k, and wellness benefits beginning on the first day of employment. This role also is eligible to participate in Kodiak's annual discretionary bonus program, which is dependent on various factors, including individual and company performance.



Kodiak is looking for a Regional Account Manager to lead our Mid-Central United States grocery / distributor business and drive profitable growth across key regional accounts. This role will own direct relationships with retailer headquarters / distributors, build account plans that expand distribution and strengthen shelf presence, present new products and promotional opportunities to buyers, and manage trade investment, forecasting, and in-market execution. The ideal candidate has direct experience calling on and presenting to headquarters-level buyers at regional grocery chains, including ownership of account strategy, sales planning, and business results. This role works directly with our broker partners who help execute sales plans with retailers.


What will you do?

  • Grow distribution and strengthen assortment across assigned grocery retailers by building account strategies, earning buyer support, and selling in new product innovation.
  • Deliver annual sales, revenue, and trade-spend commitments through clear account plans, strategic promotional calendars, disciplined budget management, and timely course correction.
  • Improve monthly case-volume and revenue forecasts by combining retailer input, historical performance, promotional plans, and current business trends.
  • Turn retailer, shopper, sales, and competitive insights into focused actions that improve account performance and unlock incremental growth.
  • Strengthen execution by aligning broker partners and cross-functional teams on priorities, owners, timing, and retailer support plans.
  • Keep the account running smoothly through accurate new-item setup, responsive billing follow-up, and clear sales reporting for leadership.

You will bring the following capabilities to the role:

  • Retailer leadership: Build trusted relationships with buyers and category managers, independently lead account conversations, and navigate opportunities or challenges with sound judgment.
  • Strategic selling and influence: Translate brand strategy, innovation, and consumer insights into persuasive, retailer-specific stories and recommendations.
  • Commercial and financial acumen: Connect volume, revenue, pricing, promotions, and trade investment to account decisions and business results.
  • Analytical fluency: Use syndicated and retailer data, Excel, and competitive information to spot patterns, size opportunities, and recommend action.
  • Cross-functional execution: Partner effectively with brokers and internal stakeholders, including Marketing, Shopper Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Sales Operations.
  • Ownership and adaptability: Organize competing priorities, follow through on details, communicate clearly, and keep momentum in a fast-moving environment.

Your experience should clearly demonstrate:

  • A track record of building retailer relationships and influencing buyers or category managers.
  • Experience managing account plans, sales forecasts, promotional activity, and trade budgets with measurable business accountability.
  • Working proficiency with Excel and presentation tools, plus experience using syndicated or retailer data to guide decisions.
  • Ability to travel up to 30% and operate effectively in a fully remote environment.
  • Genuine interest in Kodiak, our products, and the opportunity to help grow the brand.

What else do I need to know?  

This role is fully remote. We offer competitive compensation and benefits that include:  

  • Medical/dental/vision plans   
  • 401k match   
  • FSA & HSA accounts
  • Life & ADD Insurance
  • Short Term & Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Cell Phone & Internet Stipend
  • Relocation assistance
  • Annual Professional Development Stipend
  • Travel Reimbursement
  • Annual performance bonus
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • A company fleet of snowboards and other equipment 
  • Wellness lifestyle allowance (B.E.A.R Bucks)  
  • Mental Health Therapy Benefit & the Calm app
  • Free Kodiak Product
  • Flexible Time Off
  • Sick Leave
  • Early-out Fridays  
  • Parental leave  
  • Casual dress code 
  • A variety of other Kodiak-unique perks

jobs.excerpt: SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.
jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

You will lead a team of AI Tutors responsible for delivering high-quality training data and evaluations that power SpaceXAI’s models. You will set the standard for data quality on your projects, review work in the domain, ensure the accuracy and consistency of the data produced, and build operational excellence at the team level. This is a hands-on leadership role — you will both execute labeling/review work and continuously improve processes as we scale.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own end-to-end quality and delivery for assigned Human Data projects — personally reviewing work in the domain, ensuring accuracy, consistency, guideline adherence, and high-quality data production at scale.
  • Lead, coach, and performance-manage a team of AI Tutors, including conducting regular performance reviews, maintaining records, creating action plans, managing shadow sessions, and driving continuous improvement.
  • Oversee and actively participate in labeling and reviewing tasks to maintain high standards and model best practices.
  • Ensure strict guideline adherence, taxonomy management, and quality assurance processes.
  • Drive efficiency by identifying and resolving operational bottlenecks, implementing process improvements, and tracking performance via KPI dashboards (e.g., quality metrics, throughput, send-back rates).
  • Collaborate closely with Human Data Managers, fellow Team Leads, and Engineering to translate model needs into clear labeling strategies and requirements.
  • Coach and develop talent while maintaining strong accountability and a high-performance culture; support disciplinary actions as needed.
  • Document outcomes, suggest process iterations, and report project status, risks, and results.
  • Act as the voice of your tutors while fostering strong collaboration across the broader Human Data organization.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 8 months or more of hands-on experience in data labeling, annotation, AI training/evaluation, content quality, or similar operational domains.
  • Basic understanding of AI and machine learning concepts and how high-quality training data impacts model performance.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a clinical or medicine-adjacent field (e.g., medicine, nursing, public health, health administration, biomedical engineering), including graduate degrees such as MPH or MHA, or 5+ years of experience in lieu of a degree.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Previous people leadership experience.
  • Medical Doctorate (MD, DO, MBBS, or equivalent physician qualification) or other completed clinical doctoral degrees (eg PharmD, DDS, certain PhDs).
  • Residency or postgraduate clinical experience is a plus, as is familiarity with clinical data and workflows, including laboratory results, medical imaging, electronic health records (EHRs), and clinical documentation.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong track record of reviewing domain work, ensuring data quality, and improving operational processes.
  • Experience with performance management, coaching, training program development, and certification frameworks.
  • Proficiency in data analysis and associated tools (SQL a plus); ability to use metrics and KPIs to drive continuous improvement.
  • Experience managing mixed employment types (full-time employees and contractors) or distributed teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build rapport quickly and align stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as Notion, Axiom, JIRA, Linear, or equivalent.
  • Strong organizational skills, high attention to detail, proactive problem-solving mindset, and focus on continuous improvement.
  • Strategic thinking combined with strong hands-on execution.
  • Passion for building high-performing teams and scaling high-quality Human Data operations.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Candidates must be based in one of the following countries where SpaceXAI has a physical office; remote work is also possible

    - United States

    - Dubai

    - Ireland
    - United Kingdom
    - Ireland
    - Japan
    - India
    - Indonesia
    - South Korea
    - Philippines
    - Singapore

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

US based candidates: $104,000 - $170,400 USD depending on factors including relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, and qualifications. International candidates: Information will be provided to you during the recruitment process.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXAI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. Benefits vary based on employment type, location and jurisdiction. Benefits for eligible U.S. based positions include health insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid sick leave. Specific details and role specific information will be provided to you during the interview process.

SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Job Title: Project Manager III

Location: Remote

Program: NASA NCAPS

Company/ Program Description:

Centuria, a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), has been delivering IT, Engineering, and Scientific solutions to the Federal Government since 2002. During our two decades of service we have earned the trust and respect of our government clients for the simple reason that we have great people who are experts in their fields and take pride and ownership in everything they do.

The Washington Post has recognized Centuria Corporation as one of the top workplaces in the DC Metro area for 2024. This award celebrates nationally recognized companies that make the world a better place to work together by prioritizing a people-centered culture and giving employees a voice. The Top Workplaces USA award is based entirely on feedback from an employee engagement survey completed by the employees of participating workplaces. Centuria is honored to have been awarded this distinction.

  • Work with project leads to translate strategy, priorities, and team resources into executable sprint and release plans, and keep day-to-day execution aligned to those priorities.

  • Produce clear delivery products and overviews (roadmaps, prioritization and trade-off views, delivery and status reporting) that let leadership make informed trade decisions on prioritization and investment.

  • Deep, demonstrated command of Scrum and other agile frameworks (Kanban, SAFe, Lean), and of servant-leadership practice.

  • Demonstrated experience producing delivery metrics, status products, and reporting that support leadership decision-making and prioritization.
  • Demonstrated use of delivery data and metrics to measurably improve team efficiency and quality (for example, reducing cycle time or defect rates).
  • Demonstrated experience setting delivery or quality standards and holding a team accountable to them, and coaching teams to a higher level of performance.
  • Proficiency with agile delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar).

Antora Energy delivers affordable, reliable energy to industry, data centers, and the grid. Our thermal batteries turn low-cost electricity into always-on heat and power, without supply-constrained critical minerals or multi-year construction timelines.

We are growing our company with people who put team and mission first, value connection through laughter and joy, and work with humility and openness. We are committed to building a diverse, passionate, and creative team dedicated to a future powered by abundant, clean, low-cost energy.

Position Summary

Antora is seeking a Manager, Interconnection Projects & Grid Infrastructure Delivery to own the delivery of interconnection engineering, SCADA and telemetry systems, and grid infrastructure for Antora’s thermal energy storage projects across multiple RTOs/ISOs. This is a hands-on role: the person in this seat will write/validate the statements of work, hold the budget, set the schedule, and hold consultants, Owner’s Engineers and EPC firms to deliverables that are technically defensible.

The ideal candidate combines practical program management discipline, scope definition, cost and schedule control, change management with enough engineering fluency to interrogate a data point list, an architecture diagram or an interface control document and recognize what is missing. The role works across Antora’s portfolio in MISO, SPP, ERCOT and PJM, and partners closely with interconnection and grid engineering, project development, product engineering, legal and finance.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Interconnection Engineering & Infrastructure Delivery

    • Manage engineering firms from concept through issued-for-construction design, covering substations, switchyards, POI configurations, protection and control, metering, grounding, and equipment specifications. Optimize configurations for reliability and cost.
    • Ensure designs incorporate interconnection studies and GIA/LGIA/DIA obligations; resolve changes affecting design, cost, or schedule.
    • Lead utility and transmission owner coordination on facilities and network upgrades, including scope, estimates, transmission-owner-built versus self-built options, engineering reviews, and milestones.
    • Manage Owner’s Engineer and EPC interfaces, define scope boundaries, coordinate long-lead equipment procurement and negotiations, and oversee construction with EPC and engineering teams. Deliver complete packages for construction and commissioning.

    Consultant & Vendor Management

    • Write SOWs and manage RFPs, technical and commercial bid evaluation, contracting, purchase orders, invoices, budgets, change management, and closeout.
    • Define deliverables, dependencies, exclusions, and separately priced uncertain tasks. Assess relevant experience and gaps, enforce not-to-exceed estimates, and reject fixed-price or fixed-timeline commitments without documented precedent.
    • Maintain reusable SOW templates, vendor qualification standards, and bid evaluation criteria.

    SCADA, Telemetry & Metering

    • Scope and contract SCADA/telemetry engineering; determine responsibility for detailed SCADA/DCS engineering and programming across EPC, integrator, or in-house teams before contracting.
    • Drive novel measurement methods, including translating stored thermal energy into reportable state of charge, through separately scoped, not-to-exceed tasks. Own settlement-quality metering design and validation.
    • Align ICCP configuration and Open Loop/Closed Loop testing with RTO requirements preceding Test Energy and Trial Operation.

    Portfolio, Schedule & Cross-Functional Coordination

    • Own integrated schedules, critical paths, dependencies, and milestones. Maintain one portfolio record of deliverables, technical assumptions, open issues, and RTO/TO correspondence.
    • Partner with interconnection/grid engineering, development, execution, product engineering, operations, commercial, legal, and finance teams to align delivery with project commitments. Communicate cost, schedule, and risk to leadership and nontechnical stakeholders; escalate critical-path exposure early.
Key Qualifications
  • 6+ years managing capital energy or electric infrastructure projects—generation, storage, substations, or transmission—with direct accountability for vendor scope, budgets, schedules, and change management.
  • Experience designing interconnection configurations, evaluating feasibility, selecting and procuring equipment, and coordinating interconnection/substation engineering with utilities and transmission owners.
  • Ability to identify gaps in one-line diagrams, protection schemes, point lists, interface control documents, and architecture diagrams.
  • Utility-scale generator experience with SCADA, telemetry, protection and control, or substation automation sufficient to scope work, evaluate bids, and challenge deliverables.
  • Working knowledge of interconnection studies, GIA/LGIA obligations, and the scoping, costing, and construction of interconnection facilities and network upgrades.
  • Strong technical writing and ability to independently manage concurrent projects across geographies and counterparties, navigate ambiguity, prioritize competing deadlines, and raise issues early.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, another engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Additional Qualifications Desired
  • Exposure to ICCP, RTU integration, or RTO telemetry validation, and to resource integration or ICCP modeling teams.
  • Experience with synchronous generator telemetry, settlement-quality metering, and co-located, hybrid, or surplus interconnection configurations.
  • Utility, transmission owner, IPP, or developer-side delivery experience.

jobs.description:
Este es un puesto de trabajo remoto.

Agente de Atención y Gestión de Reservas (Part Time, Remoto)

Ubicación:Trabajo 100% remoto (horarios enhora de España)

Jornada:Parcial – 4 horas diarias

Horarios rotativos:

  • Lunes a viernes:18:00 a 00:00 (horario España)
  • Fines de semana:10:00 a 19:00 (horario España, según necesidades operativas)
  • Disponibilidad:Inmediata

Descripción del Puesto

Buscamos incorporardos Agentes de Atención y Gestión de Reservasresponsables de cubrir el servicio fuera del horario de oficina, asegurando atención constante para nuestros pisos turísticos, alojamientos coliving y apartamentos gestionados.

Los candidatos seleccionados trabajaránde forma completamente remota, atendiendo solicitudes en tiempo real y garantizando una experiencia fluida para los huéspedes durante horarios vespertinos, nocturnos y fines de semana según las necesidades operativas.

Responsabilidades

El rol comprende la atención de mensajes y consultas de huéspedes mediante los distintos canales digitales, gestión y confirmación de reservas en el Channel Manager, seguimiento de check-ins online, registro y derivación de incidencias, así como garantizar que cualquier solicitud urgente fuera del horario administrativo sea atendida con agilidad y profesionalismo. La persona deberá mantener comunicación fluida con el equipo interno cuando deba escalar situaciones o coordinar acciones operativas.


Requisitos

Requisitos del Perfil

  • Experiencia previa de mínimo 3 años en atención al cliente, turismo, hospitality o gestión de apartamentos turísticos.
  • Formación en ventas y servicio al cliente.
  • Disponibilidad para trabajar enhorarios españoles(tarde, noche y fines de semana).
  • Excelente comunicación escrita y oral.
  • Manejo de herramientas digitales; valorable experiencia con Channel Manager y CRM ZOHO.
  • Inglés nivelB2 o superior(preferible).
  • Proactividad, orientación al servicio, capacidad de respuesta y trabajo autónomo.
  • Incorporación inmediata para cubrir turnos rotativos.

Ventajas

Lo que ofrecemos

  • Trabajo100% remotodesde cualquier país.
  • Incorporación inmediata.
  • Horarios estables con planificación fija.
  • Oportunidad de crecimiento en un equipo en expansión.

Company Description

RedMane Technology LLC is an application software consulting and systems integration company based in Chicago. We deliver software solutions for our clients throughout the United States and Canada by means of building new applications, implementing cloud and packaged systems, and/or modernizing legacy systems.

RedMane has earned an exemplary service reputation that prioritizes a highly collaborative culture. Our primary objective is to ensure the solutions we design and implement meet or exceed the needs of our clients for their mission critical systems.

The diverse and passionate teams within RedMane address complex, real world challenges. Technology is just our tool.

The Role

RedMane has a full-time opportunity for Curam Software Developer as we continue to grow our Chicago based practice. As a Curam Software Developer you will provide technical design and programming activities You will create technical design for Curam extensions, configurations and interfaces. You will work with other developers and business analysts to create and test quality Curam customizations.

Skills & Role Requirements

The Curam Software Developer will need to have:

  • Extensive experience (5+ years) with development, testing and implementation in Curam environments.
  • Expertise in Curam rules development is required
  • Extensive recent experience with DB2 and SQL
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience of J2EE architecture
  • Ability to mentor other programmers in quality design and coding techniques and standards
  • Demonstrated experience with n-tier web-based applications, Unix, Shell Scripting, Ant script, JavaScript, XML/XSD and source code management tools such as Subversion or Git
  • Working knowledge of Web Service, EJB, Messaging and other system integration technologies
  • Experience in an enterprise environment with large-scale, complex interdependent systems
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information, applying logical reasoning and sound technical and/or business knowledge
  • Analyze code to find causes of errors and revise the applications as needed
  • Participate in software design meetings to analyze and determine user needs are met with technical requirements
  • Work collaboratively with broader development team to design, test and implement Cram code to meet project deadlines

All professionals at RedMane are expected to possess these skills:

  • A strong ethical foundation, capable of thriving in an environment and culture where honesty, integrity, and accountability are core values.
  • A collaborative spirit, a team orientation, and a willingness and desire to contribute to the success of others.

We Offer You

RedMane has an environment that offers challenging and interesting work. A place where you can have fun and express your talent and creativity. You will be working side by side with like-minded peers in a non-bureaucratic environment where sharing knowledge is the norm. Everyone at RedMane shares a passion for making a real difference for individuals, communities, and the world.

Additionally, we believe you should have fun and enjoy growing your career; we provide the supportive and empowering environment to make it happen. RedMane is very proud to offer employees professional and personal perks that include:

  • A flexible work environment that includes hybridized locations and schedules with frequently catered lunches in the office.
  • Market based compensation with a full range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), short and long-term disability insurance, etc.
  • A culture that promotes and fosters career growth through professional training and mentoring.
  • An employee wellness program that includes free access to professional fitness coaches, structured dietary/nutrition plans, training/workout planning, and events that range from 5k's to triathlons.
  • Opportunities to give back to the community through our RedMane Community Impact Team which organizes events like Feed My Starving Children, Toy Drives, and other charitable activities.

jobs.description:
Principal Medical Writer - Publications

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
    • We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
    • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Leads the clear and accurate completion of complex medical writing deliverables, ensuring scientific information is presented clearly and accurately. Manages medical writing activities associated with individual studies, defining document strategy and coordinating medical writing activities within and across departments with minimal supervision. Leads the resolution of comments from the client.
  • Completes a variety of documents that may include clinical study protocols and clinical study protocol amendments; clinical study reports; patient narratives; annual reports; investigator brochures; informed consents; annual reports; plain language summaries; periodic safety update reports, clinical development plans; IND submissions; integrated summary reports; NDA and eCTD submissions; journal manuscripts; and abstracts, posters, and presentations for scientific meetings.
  • Adheres to established regulatory standards, including, but not limited to, ICH E3 guidelines, as well as company standard operating procedures, client standards, and company and/or client approved-templates, authorship requirements, and style and formatting guides, when completing medical writing projects, on time and on budget.
  • Advises clients and study teams on data presentation and production strategies to ensure that client objectives/expectations are met and quality standards are maintained.
  • Leads team document reviews and reviews documents for technical issues. Coordinates quality and editorial reviews and ensures source documentation is managed appropriately.
  • Serves as expert peer reviewer for internal team, providing review comments to give maximum clarity of meaning, accuracy, and relevance, and to ensure that client objectives are met and overall quality standards are maintained.
  • Reviews statistical analysis plans and table/figure/listing specifications for appropriate content, and for grammar, format, and consistency. Provides feedback to further define statistical output required and document needs.
  • Interacts and builds good working relationships with clients, department head, and team members in data management, biostatistics, regulatory affairs, and medical affairs, as necessary, to produce writing deliverables. Works with staff across company to advance company priorities.
  • Performs online clinical literature searches and complies with copyright requirements.
  • Identifies and proposes solutions to resolve issues, escalating as appropriate. Serves as a key technical SME and contributes to development of internal materials and presentations on needed topics. Contributes to changes to internal process, standard practices, and capabilities.
  • Mentors and leads less experienced medical writers on complex documents.
  • Develops deep expertise on key topics in the industry and the regulatory requirements and guidelines that affect medical writing. Engages externally with industry groups on industry initiatives.
  • Aware of budget specifications for assigned projects, communicating status and changes to medical writing leadership. Contributes to bid projections.
  • Communicates status and changes to medical writing leadership; negotiates timelines and assigned deliverables.
  • Represents the medical writing department on clinical study teams, at conferences, meetings, and for presentations to the client regarding writing projects.
  • Completes required administrative tasks within the specified timeframes.
  • Performs other work-related duties as assigned.
  • Minimal travel may be required (less than 25%).

At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, eligibility to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

Salary Range:

$80,600.00 - $175,700.00

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. jobs.excerpt: Power BI & Data Analytics EngineerPosition Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.
jobs.description:
Power BI & Data Analytics Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled Power BI & Data Analytics Engineer to transform engineering specifications into interactive dashboards, automated reports, and data-driven insights.

Our engineering team designs the logic, calculations, and reporting requirements behind each dashboard. Your role is to bring those specifications to life by building scalable Power BI solutions that utility clients rely on every day.

You'll work at the intersection of engineering and software—connecting data from multiple systems, building robust data models, and creating reporting solutions that help municipal water utilities better understand and manage their infrastructure.

If you enjoy solving complex data challenges, building high-quality reporting systems, and turning technical requirements into intuitive visualizations, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Dashboard Development

  • Build and maintain interactive dashboards and automated reports using Power BI.
  • Convert engineering specifications into accurate, user-friendly reporting solutions.
  • Design dashboards that present complex operational and infrastructure data in a clear and actionable format.
  • Continuously improve existing dashboards based on client and internal feedback.

Data Modeling & Analytics

  • Build scalable data models using SQL, Power BI, and Python.
  • Transform large volumes of time-series, asset, and operational data into meaningful insights.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reporting reliability.
  • Optimize dashboard performance and reporting efficiency.

GIS & Data Integration

  • Integrate Esri GIS data into reporting solutions and visualizations.
  • Combine geospatial, operational, and asset management data into unified dashboards.
  • Develop mapping visualizations that support infrastructure planning and operational decision-making.

Cloud & API Development

  • Work with Microsoft Azure and Azure Fabric to support reporting and data solutions.
  • Develop and maintain API integrations that connect multiple business systems.
  • Support automated data pipelines and reporting workflows.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with engineers to understand reporting requirements and technical calculations.
  • Learn complex water utility concepts and translate them into easy-to-understand dashboards.
  • Recommend improvements to reporting systems, data models, and development processes.
  • Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the company's reporting platform.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You enjoy transforming complex technical data into meaningful business insights.
  • You can quickly understand engineering concepts and convert them into reporting solutions.
  • You are highly analytical and detail-oriented.
  • You enjoy solving complex data problems through automation and visualization.
  • You take ownership of your work and continuously look for ways to improve systems.
  • You thrive in collaborative, fast-moving technical environments.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • Advanced experience developing dashboards and reports using Power BI.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for querying, transforming, and modeling data.
  • Experience using Python for reporting, automation, or data processing.
  • Hands-on experience with Esri GIS.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure and Azure Fabric.
  • Experience working with API integrations.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling and business intelligence best practices.
  • Experience working with complex datasets such as time-series, geospatial, or asset management data.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience working within the water utility, engineering, infrastructure, environmental, or asset management industries.
  • Experience developing frontend applications using React or Blazor.
  • Familiarity with Reporting Hub, IconMaps, Figma, or ClickUp.
  • Experience building automated reporting platforms for enterprise clients.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

Your day begins by reviewing engineering specifications and project priorities before building new Power BI dashboards and reporting features.

You'll write SQL queries, create data models, integrate GIS and API data, automate reporting workflows with Python, and ensure dashboards accurately represent complex engineering calculations.

Throughout the day, you'll collaborate with engineers to clarify reporting requirements, troubleshoot data issues, optimize dashboard performance, and contribute ideas that improve the company's reporting platform.

By the end of the day, you've delivered reporting solutions that help municipal utility clients make smarter infrastructure decisions using real-time operational data.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Recruiter Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you'll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video.

It's a short, self-recorded introduction completed on your own time and serves as the final step in completing your application.

This allows hiring managers to evaluate your communication skills before moving forward with interviews, making the hiring process faster and more efficiently.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

jobs.excerpt: Come join our team!  Reveille provides a full benefits package include medical/dental/vision, FSA, paid time off, commuting reimbursement, 401K / matching, Wellness subsidies, LTD/STD/AD&D insurance, and salary + incentive (bonus) compensation.
jobs.description:
Come join our team! Reveille provides a full benefits package include medical/dental/vision, FSA, paid time off, commuting reimbursement, 401K / matching, Wellness subsidies, LTD/STD/AD&D insurance, and salary + incentive (bonus) compensation. We're a team of strategically-minded consultants who focus on prioritizing a work-life balance.

Reveille Group is a strategic advisory consulting firm with offices in Washington, DC. We are focused on providing our diverse clients with innovative solutions including technical analysis and development. We are looking to bring on an integral team member to provide support for an existing project. You will function as a Learning & Development Specialist for a federal agency. Please note this is a remote position, and you must be in the contiguous United States available to travel to DC and other locations on occasion/as needed.

Role Description

  • Lead implementation of the Government-established learning and career-development framework for a 10- to 25-person early-career acquisition cohort, aligning activities to program milestones, priorities, participant needs, and applicable acquisition career requirements.
  • Develop and maintain the Development Framework and Curriculum Plan, including learning objectives, sequencing, delivery methods, facilitators, prerequisites, milestone dates, evaluation methods, dependencies, and required resources.
  • Coordinate learning across federal acquisition fundamentals, the acquisition lifecycle, procurement and contracting, mission and organization, business acumen, customer engagement, market research, acquisition planning, data literacy, digital acquisition, emerging technologies, communication, negotiation, project management, leadership, ethics, and career planning.
  • Design and facilitate cohort-based learning activities such as workshops, case studies, speaker series, leadership engagements, peer-learning sessions, mission briefings, innovation challenges, capstone projects, networking sessions, and communities of practice.
  • Develop facilitator guides, participant materials, job aids, learning schedules, presentations, exercises, case materials, assessments, and accessible digital resources for Government review and approval.
  • Support each participant's Individual Development Plan or equivalent roadmap by documenting required and recommended learning, target competencies, developmental assignments, mentoring, rotations, certification milestones, career milestones, goals, and target completion dates.
  • Establish repeatable processes for learning enrollment, attendance, completion, make-up activities, participant communications, resource distribution, feedback collection, and maintenance of current learning records.
  • Coordinate mentor and mentee guides, expectations, matching support, orientation, engagement tracking, pulse surveys, and issue escalation in partnership with volunteer Government mentors and program leadership.
  • Support identification and coordination of rotational and developmental assignments, including objectives, schedules, stakeholder communications, participant and supervisor feedback, completion tracking, and developmental outcome documentation.
  • Maintain participant learning and development data, including training requirements and completion, IDP milestones, certification-related progress, rotations, mentoring participation, cohort activities, competency development, developmental assignments, feedback, risks, and corrective actions.
  • Define and apply Government-approved status criteria to identify participants who are on track, at risk, or materially behind; document contributing factors and recommend timely developmental interventions without performing supervisory functions.
  • Develop learning measurement strategies using appropriate models and methods, including reaction, learning, application, milestone attainment, competency progression, participant experience, supervisor experience, and program outcomes.
  • Analyze which developmental activities correlate with participant progression, retention, competency growth, and career milestones; document assumptions and limitations and distinguish correlation from causation.
  • Provide development measures, trends, risks, narrative insights, and recommended actions for dashboards, monthly reports, quarterly analytics, executive briefings, annual evaluations, and continuous-improvement reviews.
  • Conduct recurring needs assessments and use participant, supervisor, mentor, and stakeholder feedback to identify developmental gaps, delivery barriers, successful practices, and opportunities for standardization or automation.
  • Coordinate recommendations for changes to the development framework with the officials responsible for acquisition workforce development and certification before implementation.
  • Maintain curriculum assets, data definitions, operating procedures, version histories, lessons learned, and transition materials so government or a successor contractor can sustain the program without avoidable dependency on incumbent personnel.
  • Ensure learning products and records comply with applicable federal privacy, information-security, records-management, system-access, and Section 508 accessibility requirements.
  • Respond to routine Government and participant inquiries within established service levels and promptly elevate material gaps in learning, mentoring, rotations, supervision, or developmental opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in learning and development, instructional design, curriculum implementation, workforce development, talent development, adult education, organizational development, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end learning programs, from needs assessment and curriculum planning through delivery, administration, evaluation, reporting, and continuous improvement.
  • Advanced knowledge of adult-learning principles, instructional design, blended learning, facilitation, assessment, learning transfer, and program-evaluation methods.
  • Experience developing measurable learning objectives, sequenced curricula, facilitator guides, participant materials, exercises, job aids, surveys, assessments, and learning-evaluation plans.
  • Experience managing individual development plans, competency frameworks, mentoring programs, rotational assignments, cohort learning, leadership development, or early-career development programs.
  • Ability to translate policy, competency, certification, and workforce requirements into practical learning experiences and trackable developmental milestones.
  • Experience analyzing learning and development data, including completion, assessment, engagement, satisfaction, progression, risk, and outcome measures, and communicating findings to program and executive audiences.
  • Strong facilitation, presentation, consultation, coaching, stakeholder-management, writing, editing, and project-coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage concurrent learning events, participant needs, deliverables, dependencies, and changing priorities while maintaining accurate documentation and quality control.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint, plus experience with a learning-management system, survey platform, virtual-learning platform, or comparable learning technology.
  • Ability to protect applicant and employee information and satisfy applicable federal suitability, onboarding, confidentiality, accessibility, records, and information-handling requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in learning and development, instructional design, curriculum implementation, workforce development, talent development, adult education, organizational development, or a closely related field.
    • Bachelor's degree in instructional design, adult education, organizational development, human resources, learning sciences, public administration, business, or a related field; a master's degree is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end learning programs, from needs assessment and curriculum planning through delivery, administration, evaluation, reporting, and continuous improvement.
  • Advanced knowledge of adult-learning principles, instructional design, blended learning, facilitation, assessment, learning transfer, and program-evaluation methods.
  • Experience developing measurable learning objectives, sequenced curricula, facilitator guides, participant materials, exercises, job aids, surveys, assessments, and learning-evaluation plans.
  • Experience managing individual development plans, competency frameworks, mentoring programs, rotational assignments, cohort learning, leadership development, or early-career development programs.
  • Ability to translate policy, competency, certification, and workforce requirements into practical learning experiences and trackable developmental milestones.
  • Experience analyzing learning and development data, including completion, assessment, engagement, satisfaction, progression, risk, and outcome measures, and communicating findings to program and executive audiences.
  • Strong facilitation, presentation, consultation, coaching, stakeholder-management, writing, editing, and project-coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage concurrent learning events, participant needs, deliverables, dependencies, and changing priorities while maintaining accurate documentation and quality control.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint, plus experience with a learning-management system, survey platform, virtual-learning platform, or comparable learning technology.
  • Ability to protect applicant and employee information and satisfy applicable federal suitability, onboarding, confidentiality, accessibility, records, and information-handling requirements.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications

  • Experience supporting a federal agency, government contractor, federal workforce-development initiative, internship or fellowship program, or acquisition workforce program.
  • Knowledge of federal acquisition roles, the acquisition lifecycle, federal competency models, and acquisition career training or certification requirements.
  • Relevant credentials such as Certified Professional in Talent Development, Associate Professional in Talent Development, Project Management Professional, Prosci, instructional-design certification, coaching certification, or comparable qualification.
  • Experience applying Kirkpatrick or comparable evaluation approaches and developing executive dashboards or reports that connect learning activity to workforce outcomes.
  • Familiarity with Section 508, plain-language practices, accessible virtual facilitation, and accessible document development.

jobs.excerpt: The Vice President, Sales – Team Lead manages a personal sales territory and multiple levels of the Sales team.
jobs.description:
The Vice President, Sales – Team Lead manages a personal sales territory and multiple levels of the Sales team. This role is responsible for generating net revenue growth from new and existing clients, and ensuring that members of the team, including direct reports are hitting their goals. Account planning, client servicing, partnering with other teams such as Product and Marketing, and regular management reporting may also be necessary parts of this job. This is the ideal role for someone who is driven by their own and their team’s success and an effective manager and communicator.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Including, but not limited to the following:

  • Overall responsibility for revenue retention and growth for assigned territory or accounts, and those of your sales team.
  • Primary focus is new business development, utilizing desk research and in-market activity to identify prospects and client opportunities; email and social outreach and in-person interactions at industry events to create awareness and interest and set up meetings; exploratory and follow up meetings to understand client needs and potential fit for M3 MI solutions; present proposals and get signed agreements.
  • Evaluate and distribute leads and opportunities to others on team where appropriate; and mentor team members on good new business practices.
  • Utilize account and market data to create strategies and develop plans that are executed and reviewed on an ongoing basis to grow the business. Review opportunities and accounts monthly versus sales and revenue goals.
  • Monitor and maintain all sales KPIs on the various sales and activity metrics we have in place to ensure optimized performance and balanced workloads, ensuring all team members are fully productive working against clear goals, with weekly review and reporting.
  • Supervise day-to-day and strategic aspects of certain key accounts.
  • Nurture a client-centric culture in your and your team’s accounts with strong sales behaviors, building strong relationships with main contacts.
  • Serve as a CRM advocate, assisting with training and being responsible for keeping account data clean and current.
  • Serve as contact point for new hire onboarding for supporting team members.
  • Achieve all team financial goals, delivering as a minimum on-target revenue per quarter.

We’re looking for a sales leader with a proven track record in business development within pharma/healthcare marketing, advertising and research.

The ideal candidate will bring:

  • 10+ years of client-facing experience, with at least 5 in sales or business development, preferably with a recognizable company in the pharma/healthcare ecosystem that establishes credibility with our target customers and team.

jobs.description:
Voici un poste à distance.

TEHORA est présentement à la recherche d’un(e) conseillère ou conseiller en gestion du changement ayant d’excellentes aptitudes techniques, d’excellentes connaissances et qui souhaite mettre à profit ses compétences au sein d’une équipe polyvalente.
Sans être exhaustifs, voici les services et livrables que devra fournir la personne retenue.
Description des travaux ou des biens livrables :
La conseillère ou le conseiller en gestion du changement a pour mission, à titre de partenaire stratégique et de facilitateur, de soutenir l’Office dans l’intégration des changements engendrés par ses projets en élaborant des stratégies, plans d’action et outils de gestion de changement efficaces. Ses interventions viseront entre autres à assurer la mobilisation des employés et à préparer l’organisation dans sa transition vers les changements.

Responsabilités principales

  • Poser un diagnostic sur la nature des changements à déployer et en mesurer les écarts par rapport à la situation actuelle : impacts du changement sur les processus d’affaires (actuels et futurs) et les parties prenantes;
  • Exercer un rôle-conseil sur les meilleures pratiques et la méthodologie en gestion du changement et communication;
  • Concevoir des activités de gestion du changement efficientes et appropriées au contexte organisationnel;
  • Produire des contenus de communication qui mobilisent les parties prenantes en élaborant des messages clés;
  • Contribuer au développement des compétences des gestionnaires en matière de gestion du changement dans le cadre des projets;
  • Planifier, déployer et coordonner l’ensemble des activités de gestion du changement;
  • Assurer un suivi des plans et des activités de gestion du changement et mesurer leurs retombées;
  • Rédiger un bilan de l’ensemble des activités de la gestion du changement et proposer des activités d’amélioration continue.

Profil

Connaissances générales requises
  • Expertise en communication organisationnelle en contexte de gestion de projets;
  • Capacité de conseiller les gestionnaires, la haute direction et les comités directeurs de projet en matière de gestion du changement.
Connaissances spécifiques et habiletés requises
  • Certification reconnue dans le domaine (ex. : PROSCI, CCMP, etc.);
  • Connaissance des approches, des méthodologies et des outils en gestion du changement;
  • Très bonne maîtrise de la langue française, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.

Scolarité requise

Posséder un baccalauréat ou l’équivalent en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine pertinent.

Expérience requise

  • Posséder au moins dix (10) années d’expérience dans le domaine de l’administration des affaires, dont cinq (5) années à titre de conseillère principale ou de conseiller principal en gestion du changement.
  • Parmi les années d’expérience présentées à l’attente minimale, démontrer que la ressource proposée possède au moins trois (3) années à titre de conseillère principale ou de conseiller principal en gestion du changement et que cette expérience engendrant des modifications majeures aux façons de faire d’une organisation.
  • Démontrer que la ressource a réalisé deux (2) mandats au cours desquels elle était responsable d’élaborer et de superviser la mise en application du plan de gestion du changement dans des environnements d’une envergure au moins équivalente à celle de l’Office.
  • Décrire la méthode préconisée par cette personne lors de ces mandats pour accompagner l’organisation tout au long de sa démarche de changement, notamment par :

• le choix et la production de messages clés et l’élaboration d’un plan de communication;

• la mise en place de plan de gestion du changement en adéquation avec le contexte organisationnel;

• le développement d’indicateurs pour évaluer la réussite du plan de gestion du changement;

• la gestion des résistances et de l’engagement des différentes parties prenantes.

LIEU DE TRAVAIL

Le lieu de travail sera déterminé selon le mandat, il peut être en télétravail ou chez le client.

POURQUOI SE JOINDRE À TEHORA?

TEHORA est une firme québécoise multidisciplinaire reconnue pour l'excellence de ses services professionnels, de nature technique et de gestion de projets à l'échelle nationale et internationale. Notre mission est d'accompagner nos clients dans la concrétisation de leurs projets par l'excellence de notre savoir-faire et de notre créativité.

Depuis sa création en 2017, notre équipe de professionnels connait une croissance exponentielle en répondant aux besoins importants en gestion de projets multidisciplinaires, dans le domaine des transports, du génie civil, du TI et plus.

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

As a Database Consultant you will work as part of Pythian's Oracle team and supply complete support for all aspects of database and application infrastructure to a variety of our customers. Our collaborative environment means everyone works together to solve complex puzzles and develop innovative solutions for our customers.

If this is you, and you wonder what it would be like to work at Pythian, reach out to us and find out!

What you will be doing:

Database Management & Technical Expertise:

  • Solution Design & Implementation: Coordinate, analyze, design, implement, and administer IT solutions, including database server configuration and ongoing maintenance.
  • Infrastructure Analysis & Improvement: Analyze client infrastructure and processes, recommending best practices to enhance current operational procedures. This includes ensuring maximum uptime and recoverability for all databases.
  • Backup & Disaster Recovery: Administer backup procedures and disaster recovery plans. This involves proactive monitoring to prevent issues, responding to alerts, and troubleshooting operational problems.
  • Data Integrity & Recovery: Oversee backup, clustering, mirroring, replication, failover, and the restoration of corrupted databases.
  • Action Plan Development: Develop and review action plans for maintenance, deployment, and upgrades, ensuring all relevant client documentation is completed. Maintain a thorough understanding of client information, including warnings, handoffs, and briefing notes.
  • Data Architecture: Develop, implement, and maintain complex data architectures (e.g., normalized and/or dimensional data models and DDL generation). Perform data transformation and migration using scripts or stored procedures.
  • Problem Management: Lead problem management efforts by assessing incidents for recurring patterns, designing technical procedures for regular requests and changes, and developing/reviewing action plans and associated documentation.
  • Oncall: Participate equally in the team’s on call rotation, typically one weekend per month.

Client Engagement & Communication:

  • Client Commitments: Make, manage, and meet client commitments in collaboration with team members.
  • Reporting & Communication: Prepare client status and incident reports, review client reports regularly, and respond to client requests and inquiries.
  • Client Alignment: Maintain alignment with client operating procedures, including change control, and manage client allotments, alerting the Team Manager to any pacing concerns.
  • Technical Client Affinity: Take on technical client affinity as assigned by the Team Manager.

Process Improvement:

  • Innovation & Improvement: Participate in and, at times, lead efforts to suggest, recommend, and potentially design/implement new monitoring checks, enhancements to DBC toolkits, and other process improvements (e.g., Initial Reviews, Performance Reviews, Audits). Focus on initiatives that increase the value Pythian provides to clients.

What we need from you:

  • Knowledge and experience in installing, configuring and upgrading Oracle databases & tools relevant in Oracle Administration.
  • Automation technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, Chef, SALT experience.
  • Debugging skills and the ability to troubleshoot methodically, identifying and applying fixes for known errors, and when necessary, capacity to think outside of the box to resolve complex issues
  • Very good documentation skills.
  • Nice to haves include; Understanding of current IT service standards such as ITIL. Being a contributor to projects relevant to Oracle, or other database or infrastructure software.
  • Experience with cloud-native and managed database monitoring tools, including AWS CloudWatch, Google Cloud Operations (Stackdriver), and Azure Monitor. This includes configuring monitoring solutions, analyzing performance metrics, setting up alerts, and troubleshooting database issues in cloud environments.
  • Experience in database migrations from different database engines, including Oracle, MySQL, and MSSQL, to PostgreSQL. Using migration tools such as ora2pg, AWS/GCP/Azure Database Migration Services (DMS), and other CDC-based techniques to ensure a smooth transition with minimal downtime.
  • Experience migrating between on-premises and cloud-based databases.
  • Experience analyzing and optimizing schema conversions, SQL compatibility issues, and performance tuning post-migration. Experience with Debezium and Striim is not mandatory but beneficial.
  • Experience in monitoring PostgreSQL databases using industry-standard tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, SolarWinds, pgAdmin, Zabbix, Nagios and Datadog is an asset.

Job Description

Senior Product Business Analyst

Thermo Fisher Scientific is seeking a Senior Product Business Analyst to join the Laboratory Products Automation, AI, and Data (AAD) team supporting the Laboratory Products Group (LPG). This role will connect supply chain processes, enterprise data, analytics, artificial intelligence, automation, and technology delivery to drive measurable business outcomes.


A key near-term responsibility will be advancing LPG's adoption of Thermo Fisher's global standard supply chain data model. The role will own the business analysis activities required to transition legacy analytics toward modern enterprise data and analytics capabilities and define business-specific extensions where requirements are not addressed by the standard enterprise model.


Beyond the data transition, this role will identify, shape, and advance opportunities to apply trusted data through analytics, AI, automation, and digital workflows to improve supply chain decisions, productivity, service, inventory, and working capital.


DESCRIPTION

Data and Analytics Transformation

  • Lead business requirements, gap assessment, validation, and readiness activities required to transition legacy data and analytics to modern enterprise capabilities, prioritizing reuse of enterprise-standard solutions.
  • Elicit and document business and data requirements, business rules, and acceptance criteria for enterprise data model adoption; partner with data engineering, analytics, and business teams to assess model fit and define required extensions.
  • Identify gaps requiring business-specific data or analytics capabilities and translate them into scalable functional requirements.
  • Lead assessment and rationalization of the existing analytics portfolio, identifying duplication and defining migration, consolidation, or retirement recommendations.
  • Define and validate business definitions, data quality expectations, lineage, and governance requirements to ensure solutions are trusted and fit for business use.

Business Process and Opportunity Definition

  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of supply chain processes, workflows, decision points, pain points, and business outcomes across LPG.
  • Identify and shape opportunities to improve processes through data, analytics, AI, automation, and digital workflows in partnership with business leaders, process owners, and the AAD leadership team.
  • Lead discovery and future-state design sessions with planners, buyers, supply chain leaders, process owners, and other stakeholders.
  • Define future-state processes, decision points, and functional needs, challenging existing ways of working rather than simply digitizing current activities.
  • Develop value hypotheses, business cases, success measures, and adoption expectations to support demand prioritization and investment decisions.
  • Research business performance, user needs, industry trends, and emerging technologies to surface potential use cases and contribute to the team's broader opportunity pipeline.

Product Discovery and Solution Definition

  • Translate prioritized business opportunities into well-defined use cases, requirements, process flows, user stories, business rules, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
  • Define the roles of data, analytics, AI, automation, enterprise applications, and human decision-making within future-state processes, including required governance, controls, traceability, and human oversight.
  • Lead business discovery, prototype validation, and value assessment to determine whether proposed solutions should progress toward scaled delivery.
  • Serve as the primary business-analysis interface across business stakeholders and product, engineering, analytics, data, AI, automation, and user experience teams.
  • Maintain continuity from discovery through design, build, validation, deployment, and post-release support, ensuring delivered capabilities remain aligned to the defined business need and intended outcomes.
  • Lead requirements clarification, backlog refinement, solution walkthroughs, and functional decision-making within the defined business scope.
  • Manage functional dependencies and tradeoffs across enterprise standards, business-specific requirements, and legacy capabilities, escalating decisions where appropriate.

Validation, Readiness, and Adoption

  • Validate delivered functionality against requirements and acceptance criteria before business UAT, documenting gaps and driving functional defect resolution.
  • Define UAT scope, scenarios, entry criteria, and readiness; coordinate business testers and ensure solutions are sufficiently validated before requesting business acceptance.
  • Assess release readiness across requirements coverage, defects, process impacts, documentation, user readiness, and operational dependencies.
  • Develop and coordinate adoption activities with process owners, including pilots, training, communications, office hours, and feedback mechanisms.
  • Define and track adoption and business-impact measures such as process efficiency, cycle time, decision quality, service, inventory, and working capital.
  • Monitor post-release performance, user feedback, defects, and enhancement demand; use results to recommend solution, process, enablement, and backlog improvements.
  • Ensure delivered solutions are usable, supportable, governed, and aligned with agreed business outcomes and enterprise standards.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Seven or more years of experience in business analysis, product management, digital transformation, supply chain systems, or a related discipline.
  • Strong understanding of supply chain processes such as SIOP, demand planning, inventory management, replenishment, procurement, and service performance.
  • Demonstrated experience leading business analysis across the solution lifecycle, including discovery, process design, requirements definition, acceptance criteria, solution validation, UAT, and release readiness.
  • Proven ability to identify, shape, and translate business opportunities into scalable data, analytics, AI, automation, or digital solutions that improve business processes and outcomes.
  • Experience modernizing data, analytics, or business processes within complex enterprise environments, including working across multiple systems, business units, or operating models.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise data, analytics, AI, automation, and ERP or supply chain technologies, with experience in platforms such as SAP, JDE E1, Oracle, Syspro, Databricks, AWS, or Microsoft Power BI preferred.
  • Experience applying product discovery, process improvement, design thinking, process mining, user-centered design, or similar methods to identify and shape solutions.
  • Strong facilitation, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills, with demonstrated ability to drive decisions and influence across business and technical teams without direct authority.

ENTWICKLUNG & PERSPEKTIVE**

jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryAt MedReview, our mission is to bring accuracy, accountability, and clinical excellence to healthcare.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

At MedReview, our mission is to bring accuracy, accountability, and clinical excellence to healthcare. As a leader in payment integrity solutions, we provide DRG Validation, Cost Outlier, Readmission Review, and Payment Integrity services to healthcare clients nationwide.

Under the direction of Payment Integrity leadership, the Data Mining Ideation Specialist is responsible for identifying and developing data mining audit concepts that promote payment accuracy across Medicaid, Medicare, and Commercial lines of business. This role leverages expertise in medical coding requirements, claims adjudication processes, reimbursement methodologies, and healthcare regulations to identify improper payment opportunities with a high degree of accuracy and consistency.

The Data Mining Ideation Specialist collaborates with audit, analytics, and operations teams to develop new overpayment recovery opportunities, define data selection parameters, validate audit results, and support ongoing quality and education initiatives. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, extensive coding knowledge, attention to detail, and the ability to interpret complex healthcare reimbursement policies and regulations.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Leverage Federal, State, local, and client-specific regulations, contracts, policies, and reimbursement guidelines to identify new data mining audit opportunities.
  • Develop and define data selection criteria and audit logic requirements to ensure accurate claim identification.
  • Validate audit outputs and results to ensure integrity, consistency, and payment accuracy.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for designated clients and audit concepts.
  • Assist with obtaining client approvals and responding to client requests related to audit concept development and performance.
  • Develop and maintain concept-specific training materials for audit staff and operational teams.
  • Monitor audit performance and identify opportunities for ongoing improvements, enhancements, and logic revisions.
  • Maintain expertise in CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding guidelines, healthcare reimbursement methodologies, and claim submission requirements.
  • Collaborate with analytics, operations, audit, and client services teams to identify and implement new payment integrity opportunities.
  • Research emerging healthcare regulations, coding updates, and reimbursement policy changes that may impact audit development.
  • Support quality assurance initiatives and provide guidance regarding audit accuracy and concept implementation.
  • Perform additional projects and duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of five (5) years of complex claims processing, claims auditing, medical coding, or payment integrity experience within the healthcare industry.
  • Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial health insurance plans and reimbursement methodologies.
  • Prior experience developing payment integrity, data mining, or reimbursement audit concepts strongly preferred.
  • Mastery of CPT, HCPCS, and ICD coding standards and guidelines.
  • Current coding certification required, including one of the following:
    • AAPC Certified Professional Coder (CPC)
    • AAPC Certified Outpatient Coder (COC)
    • AHIMA Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)
    • Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT)
  • Expert understanding of medical claim coding and its impact on claim reimbursement and payment accuracy.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare claim processing, billing regulations, reimbursement methodologies, and provider contracting principles.
  • Knowledge of legal, regulatory, compliance, and documentation requirements related to medical coding and billing practices.
  • Experience interpreting reimbursement policies, payer edits, and regulatory guidance, including:
    • National Coverage Determinations (NCDs)
    • Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs)
    • NCCI Procedure-to-Procedure (PTP) Edits
    • Medically Unlikely Edits (MUEs)
    • DRG, APC, and EAPG reimbursement methodologies
    • Multiple Surgery Reductions
    • Three-Day Payment Window regulations
    • Eligibility and Coordination of Benefits (COB) requirements
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis techniques.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python, SQL, or other data analysis and reporting tools.
  • Clinical healthcare experience or background.
  • Experience translating complex technical concepts into user-friendly training materials and documentation.
  • Previous experience within the Payment Integrity industry.
  • Knowledge of EDI transactions, including 837 and 835 claim formats.
  • Experience using coding and audit tools such as 3M, WebStrat, Encoder, or similar platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and related business applications.
  • Ability to work independently while managing multiple projects and changing priorities.

Why Work at MedReview

At MedReview, you'll be part of a team dedicated to improving healthcare through accuracy, accountability, and clinical excellence. Our employees make a meaningful impact by helping healthcare organizations improve payment integrity and drive better outcomes, while working in a collaborative environment that supports professional growth, innovation, and continuous improvement. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career with an industry leader.

Salary Range: $90,000 - $110,000 annually

Actual compensation will be based on qualifications, experience, skills, certifications, and business needs.

Our mission is simple but critical: to build pathways for adult learners to earn high-quality, workforce-aligned degrees and credentials from North Carolina’s public universities.
At Project Kitty Hawk, our work reflects our company values: 
Collaboration – We prioritize our partners’ success and reputation, aligning every initiative with their goals, reflecting their values, and enhancing their impact. 
Innovation – We innovate, not replicate. As creative problem solvers, we use data-driven insights to push boundaries, continuously improve our services, develop solutions, and redefine what it means to serve nontraditional learners. 
Empathy – We understand the unique challenges of nontraditional learners, and are committed to supporting them with empathy, respect, and solutions that fit their needs. 
Integrity – We operate with transparency and accountability in everything we do. We uphold honesty, take ownership of our work, and maintain the highest standards. 
Teamwork – We embody the collaboration we seek. We always strive to be dependable, supportive, and solutions-oriented teammates. 
Together, we partner with universities in the University of North Carolina (UNC) System to produce innovative, flexible degree and credential programs in high-demand fields. Each PKH team member plays a vital role in advancing this mission and shaping the future of education for adult learners. 
These values will enable us to realize PKH’s vision: to make North Carolina’s public universities the top choice for adult learners and to amplify the UNC System’s role as a national leader in higher education innovation, access, and student success.   • Analyze and interpret data to effectively support students and improve conversion rates.
  • Ensure confidentiality and proper documentation of all student information.
  • Adhere to and enforce the appropriate security policies based on the sensitivity of company data
  • Report any security related issues to the appropriate individuals
  • Ensure the appropriateness, accuracy, and timeliness of institutional data used for the conduct of business.
  • Collaborate with external partners and universities to ensure that the best practices, excellent student service, and high standards are met and upheld.
  • Participate in professional development activities, attend relevant conferences, and engage with industry associations to expand knowledge and network with peers.

What you bring:

  • A bachelor’s degree.
  • At least 1 year of experience working in higher education with adult students in an online setting.
  • Demonstrated success in individual and organizational goal-focused performance.
  • Knowledge of the challenges and needs specific to adult learners in higher education.
  • Knowledge of and experience with CRM, LMS, and SIS platforms and other technologies used in online higher education and student management.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport with adult students.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Knowledge of relevant academic policies and procedures.
  • Knowledge of Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act of 1974 (FERPA).
  • Ability to exercise discretion, professionalism, and good judgement and maintain confidentiality.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, demanding environment.
