The Role

Voltus is the leading DER technology platform and virtual power plant operator, connecting distributed energy resources to electricity markets to deliver less expensive, more reliable, and more sustainable electricity. We hire teammates who are bright, gritty, and good, with a genuine passion for a cleaner energy future.

MISO is one of our fastest growing markets, and we're looking for a Manager to help lead that charge. MISO is the frontier of our industry today, and this role means embracing ambiguity and uncharted territory as the market matures around us.

You'll serve as a key relationship-builder and figurehead for our MISO strategy, working directly with utilities, grid operators, and policymakers to track and react to changing market design. You'll synthesize what those changes mean for our existing customers, new deals, product roadmap, and sales approach, and communicate that clearly across the org. This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role where relationship building, project management, and the judgment to prioritize matter more than day-to-day operational or dispatch management experience.

Responsibilities

  • Share ownership of our MISO book. Be accountable for the revenue and profitability of our MISO DER portfolio: including financial modeling, forecasting, customer settlement, capacity position management, and performance optimization.

  • Do everything in your power to make sure Voltus delivers on our commitments to grid operators: maintain rigorous compliance with the MISO Tariff and take all steps necessary to ensure our DER portfolio is ready to perform at 100% when called upon.

  • Be the eyes, ears, and voice on market design. Work directly with MISO and other RTO/ISO staff to track and give feedback on evolving market rules; translate what's changing into clear implications for customers, Product, and the rest of the Voltus team.

  • Build and maintain external relationships. Develop and sustain relationships with MISO staff, utility representatives, and DER/technology partners; use those relationships to move things forward for Voltus and represent us well externally.

  • Manage and develop people. Directly manage a small team, delegate effectively, coach, and grow their skills while staying close enough to the work to unblock them.

  • Lead cross-functionally. Act as a general project manager across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Operations. Your goal is to bring groups together, driving decisions, and keeping initiatives on track without waiting for someone else to own it.

  • Prioritize ruthlessly and adaptively. Know when something needs to happen now versus when it can wait, and be willing to change course quickly as market conditions or priorities shift.

  • Grow the portfolio by guiding our regional sales strategy, directly supporting new VIP sales, and onboarding new asset types and programs.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in energy markets, demand response, or a closely related field.

  • A track record of effectively managing a team.

  • A natural relationship-builder with real charisma. You build trust quickly with internal and external teams, communicating effectively in both directions.

  • Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills. Preference for experience with SQL and/or Python.

  • Excellent cross-functional project management instincts. You can coordinate across teams, delegate effectively, and drive ambiguous initiatives to resolution.

  • Gritty. You've done hard things, and you're not afraid to put in the work. You’re energized by ambiguity and a fast-changing market landscape.

  • You don't need hands-on dispatch or ops management experience, we're prioritizing market and relationship instincts here.

  • Bonus experiences: managing or onboarding battery storage assets, experience working directly with an RTO/ISO (MISO experience a strong plus)

Please note that at this time, we do not sponsor visas or transfers for new hires. Voltus teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location (in the US or Canada, unless otherwise indicated on the role description).
Additionally, while Voltus is an all-remote workplace, we have limitations on where employees are able to work for regulatory and security reasons. We expect that Voltans are working primarily from their home country. Working while traveling to other countries must be approved as per our Global Remote Travel Policy.
At Voltus, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer because we recognize that a diverse organization begins with a diverse candidate pool. This means we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of your gender identity, race, nationality, religion, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status, or marital status.

jobs.description:
Build our future together:

The Neurology Account Director (NAD) is a field-based institutional key account role responsible for driving the launch and ongoing commercial performance of Regeneron's C5 inhibitor for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) within approximately 10 - 12 assigned academic medical centers (AMCs) infusion centers, and neuromuscular specialty centers. The account director serves as a Regeneron commercial point of contact within targeted institutions, responsible for formulary access, infusion suite education and pull-through, and long-term institutional partnership development. The AD combines deep MG clinical acumen, institutional navigation skills, financial acumen, and cross-functional coordination to maximize patient access and revenue within their assigned territory.

When & where:

  • Remote role

  • Location: Northeast (New York, Pennsylvania, Massachusetts, Vermont, New Hampshire, Maine)

  • Travel: Up to 60–70%, including overnight travel within assigned territory

Discover your role:

Institutional Account Management

  • Own and manage a portfolio of approximately 10 -12 AMCs and neuromuscular specialty centers within an assigned U.S. region, serving as the institutional commercial lead.

  • Develop and execute comprehensive account plans for each institution, including formulary strategy, stakeholder mapping, competitive positioning, and patient access pathways.

  • Navigate complex institutional buying environments including P&T committees, pharmacy contracting, hospital administration, and infusion center operations.

  • Build and maintain deep, trust-based relationships with neurology department heads, treating neurologists, clinical pharmacists, infusion nurses, and medical directors.

Formulary & Market Access Pull-Through

  • Lead formulary and pathway submissions and P&T committee presentations at targeted institutions, positioning the C5 inhibitor for preferred or unrestricted formulary status.

  • Partner with Market Access National and Payer Account Directors to align institutional contracting with broader payer strategy and resolve prior authorization barriers.

  • Coordinate with specialty pharmacy partners and Patient Services hub to ensure seamless reimbursement workflows for buy-and-bill infusion products.

  • Track formulary status, pull-through metrics, and access barriers across all assigned accounts; escalate systemic issues with data-driven recommendations.

Stakeholder & KOL Engagement

  • Identify, develop, and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) in neuromuscular medicine within assigned territory, in coordination with Medical Affairs.

  • Represent Regeneron at national and regional neurology congresses (AAN, MGFA), medical education events, and institutional grand rounds as appropriate.

Analytics, Planning & Reporting

  • Maintain detailed CRM records and account intelligence; leverage IQVIA/Symphony Health data for prescriber-level targeting and performance measurement.

  • Track and report on KPIs including accounts engaged, formulary inclusions achieved, patient switches, revenue per account, and competitive share of voice.

  • Prepare and present quarterly business reviews to the Executive Director, highlighting account progress, barriers, competitive dynamics, and resource needs.

  • Contribute to territory realignment recommendations and Year 2 expansion planning based on field-level market intelligence.

This role requires:

  • Bachelor's degree required; PharmD, RN, or advanced degree in life sciences strongly preferred.

  • Minimum 10-12+ years institutional sales, market access, or account management experience inpharmaceutical/biotech.

  • Demonstrated experience with hospital/AMC formulary processes, P&T committee engagement, and institutional buy-and-bill contracting.

  • Track record of success in rare disease, neurology, or specialty biologic sales/account management, ideally including launch experience.

  • Strong clinical acumen with the ability to engage physicians, pharmacists, and medical directors in scientifically rigorous conversations.

  • Experience executing competitive switch or conversion strategies in institutional settings.

  • Proficiency with CRM systems and commercial analytics platforms (IQVIA, Symphony Health, specialty pharmacy data).

  • Ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder account relationships independently with minimal supervision.

  • Willingness to travel 60–70% within assigned territory, including overnight travel.

  • Candidates must reside within the assigned territory.

Preferred:

  • Experience in complement biology, neuromuscular disease, or C5/FcRn inhibitor markets.

  • Existing relationships with neurology KOLs or MGFA-recognized center-of-excellence leadership.

  • Prior experience with infusion biologic launches in hospital/outpatient infusion settings.

  • Knowledge of specialty pharmacy hub operations, patient assistance programs, and prior authorization workflows.

  • Understanding of medical benefit (Part B) reimbursement, ASP pricing dynamics, and buy-and-bill economics.

Core Competencies:

  • Clinical Credibility – Translates C5 mechanism of action, dosing differentiation, and clinical evidence into compelling value propositions that resonate with treating physicians and institutional decision-makers.

  • Institutional Account Navigation – Expertly engages across all levels of AMC hierarchies, from neurology fellows to C-suite administrators, pharmacy directors to infusion center leadership.

  • Strategic Account Planning – Builds data-driven, multi-quarter account strategies that address formulary access, competitive positioning, and patient journey barriers.

  • Patient Journey Management – Coordinates cross-functionally with Patient Services, specialty pharmacy, and market access to remove barriers and ensure seamless treatment initiation and continuation.

  • Relationship Building – Develops deep, trust-based institutional partnerships that create long-term competitive advantages in rare neuromuscular disease.

  • Results Orientation – Drives measurable outcomes through disciplined account planning, KPI tracking, and relentless follow-through on formulary wins.

jobs.excerpt: Buscamos um profissional de nível sênior ou especialista em identidade e acesso para atuar no suporte, na sustentação e na melhoria contínua de ambientes CyberArk.
jobs.description:
Buscamos um profissional de nível sênior ou especialista em identidade e acesso para atuar no suporte, na sustentação e na melhoria contínua de ambientes CyberArk.

A atuação será concentrada na operação da plataforma, no atendimento de chamados, na investigação e resolução de problemas e na identificação de melhorias que contribuam para a estabilidade, a segurança e a qualidade do ambiente.

Conhecimento prévio em CyberArk é um diferencial de grande relevância, mas não é obrigatório. Consideramos profissionais com experiência sólida em outras soluções de identidade, capazes de utilizar esse conhecimento como base para aprender CyberArk e desenvolver autonomia na sustentação da plataforma.

Procuramos alguém que combine maturidade técnica, boa comunicação e interesse genuíno em estudar e se especializar em CyberArk, que será o foco tecnológico da posição.

  • Realizar o suporte e a sustentação de ambientes CyberArk, atendendo chamados, incidentes e solicitações, executando rotinas operacionais e acompanhando as demandas até sua resolução.
  • Investigar e solucionar problemas técnicos, analisando comportamentos da plataforma, configurações, registros de eventos e integrações, com acionamento e acompanhamento do fabricante quando necessário.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua do ambiente, identificando problemas recorrentes, propondo ajustes e implementando melhorias para aumentar a estabilidade, a segurança e a eficiência da operação.
  • Manter uma comunicação clara com clientes e equipes internas, alinhando expectativas, informando impactos e riscos e apresentando o andamento das atividades e as recomendações técnicas.
  • Documentar e desenvolver conhecimento sobre CyberArk, mantendo procedimentos, registros de solução e base de conhecimento atualizados, além de estudar continuamente a plataforma e compartilhar aprendizados com a equipe.
  • Mínimo de cinco anos de experiência profissional em tecnologia da informação ou segurança da informação, sendo pelo menos três anos de atuação direta com identidade e acesso.
  • Experiência técnica sólida com soluções de identidade, em pelo menos uma das frentes: gestão de identidades e acessos — IAM; gestão de acessos privilegiados — PAM; ou governança e administração de identidades — IGA. Não é necessário dominar todas essas frentes.
  • Conhecimento dos fundamentos de autenticação, autorização, permissões, ciclo de vida de identidades e princípio do menor privilégio.
  • Capacidade de investigar problemas complexos, avaliar impactos, organizar prioridades e conduzir demandas com autonomia e responsabilidade compatíveis com a senioridade.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, colaboração e disposição para estudar e se especializar em CyberArk, aplicando o aprendizado no atendimento e na operação dos ambientes.

Diferenciais

Experiência com CyberArk — diferencial prioritário: vivência prática com operação, suporte, sustentação, administração ou resolução de problemas na plataforma.

Experiência com outras soluções de identidade: atuação com Segura/senhasegura, SailPoint, Ping Identity ou outras plataformas de PAM, IAM e IGA. Essa experiência será valorizada como base técnica para o aprendizado de CyberArk, sem expectativa de atuação nessas outras ferramentas no cargo.

Conhecimentos complementares: experiência com atendimento técnico a clientes, interação com suporte de fabricantes, documentação operacional e automação de atividades, além de certificações e treinamentos relacionados a identidade e acesso.

Informações adicionais

Perfil comportamental

Buscamos alguém com postura colaborativa e consultiva, que saiba ouvir, fazer perguntas, explicar situações técnicas com clareza e alinhar expectativas durante a condução de problemas.

Valorizamos iniciativa, organização, compromisso com a resolução das demandas e maturidade para reconhecer limitações, buscar apoio e desenvolver novos conhecimentos. A curiosidade técnica e a disposição para aprender devem se traduzir em evolução consistente na operação do CyberArk.

Você não precisa chegar como especialista em CyberArk. Precisa trazer experiência sólida em identidade, maturidade para atuar na sustentação de ambientes e interesse em construir essa especialização.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: We have a demand generation and expansion engine that’s already running.
jobs.description:
We have a demand generation and expansion engine that’s already running. What we need now is someone who can design the campaign strategies behind it, make the commercial trade-off decisions that determine where we invest, and take ownership of the outcomes across the full customer lifecycle.

This is a strategic digital marketing role for someone who doesn’t just run campaigns — you design them. You decide what we run, why we run it, where we spend, and what we stop doing. You will own the strategic planning and optimization of global digital campaigns — from paid media and nurture programs to ABM plays and customer expansion campaigns — making the calls on channel mix, audience strategy, and budget allocation that determine whether our marketing investment converts into pipeline and revenue.

You will sit within the Growth Marketing team, reporting to the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, and working closely with Digital Marketing, Customer Marketing, and Content and Creative. This role strengthens the strategic engine of our demand generation and expansion motion — you’re the person who decides what campaigns we build, how we structure them, and where we make trade-offs to maximize commercial impact across acquisition and growth.

If you’re a digital strategist who designs campaign architectures rather than just executing them, makes data-informed trade-off decisions with confidence, understands that marketing’s job doesn’t stop at the closed deal, and wants to be a key contributor in a high-performing growth team — this is your role.

What you’ll work on

Campaign strategy and design

  • Design the strategic framework for global multi-channel digital campaigns — defining audience strategy, channel mix, sequencing, and budget allocation across paid search, paid social, display, email, and content syndication to hit pipeline and expansion targets
  • Make commercial trade-off decisions on where to invest and where to pull back — you’re expected to analyze performance, identify diminishing returns, and reallocate spend and effort based on what’s actually driving outcomes
  • Define campaign architectures across the full bow-tie — designing how campaigns work together from awareness and lead generation through to nurture, conversion, and customer expansion, not just launching them one at a time
  • Brief the Content and Creative team on what’s needed and why — setting clear strategic direction for campaign assets based on audience insight, channel requirements, and commercial goals

Account-based marketing strategy and execution

  • Design and execute digital ABM campaign strategies targeting named accounts and account segments — defining the engagement model, channel approach, and success criteria in collaboration with the enterprise and sales teams
  • Architect multi-touch ABM plays that blend paid media, personalized content, email sequences, and retargeting — making deliberate decisions about where to invest across new logo and expansion opportunities
  • Stay current on the latest ABM tactics, platforms, and approaches — from intent data providers and programmatic ABM to personalization at scale — and make recommendations on what Duetto should adopt, test, or stop doing
  • Define ABM measurement frameworks at the account level — tracking engagement, pipeline influence, and progression rather than just lead volume, and using those insights to reshape strategy

Nurture, conversion, and expansion strategy

  • Design and optimize nurture strategies across both acquisition and expansion — deciding what workflows we run, how they’re structured, and where we need to fix friction across the full bow-tie
  • Define the campaign strategy for customer expansion — designing upsell, cross-sell, and adoption campaigns that support the commercial goals of the customer success and sales teams, not just repeating acquisition tactics
  • Make data-informed decisions on where to focus conversion optimization effort — prioritizing the stages and segments where improvements will have the greatest commercial impact
  • Own the analysis of campaign and channel performance — turning data into strategic recommendations on what to change, scale, or retire across the full lifecycle

Regional strategy and localization

  • Define how global campaign strategies should be adapted for local markets — making decisions on where to localize messaging, creative, and channel strategy versus where to maintain global consistency
  • Provide strategic performance analysis by territory that helps regional teams and leadership understand what digital marketing is delivering — and what needs to change — across both demand generation and expansion

MarTech and data operations

  • Identify gaps and improvement opportunities in the marketing technology stack — making recommendations on how to improve integration between campaign platforms, CRM, and lead routing systems
  • Ensure campaign infrastructure supports the strategic ambitions of the growth team — you’re the person who sees where the tech is limiting execution and makes the case for fixing it
  • Champion clean data practices and campaign hygiene — because the quality of strategic decisions depends on a database you can trust

AI-first campaign operations

  • Use AI as a core part of how you design, plan, and optimize campaign strategies — from audience research and competitive analysis to performance modeling and scenario planning
  • Bring an AI-native mindset to campaign strategy — always asking how automation, smarter tooling, and agentic workflows can raise the quality and speed of strategic decision-making, not just execution
  • Contribute to how the Growth Marketing team adopts AI in day-to-day work — testing new approaches, sharing what works, and helping build practices that make the whole team faster and sharper
  • Treat AI as a force multiplier, not a shortcut — the bar for strategic quality, targeting precision, and commercial impact stays high regardless of the tools used

What we’re looking for

Experience

  • 5+ years in digital marketing, growth marketing, or marketing operations — with demonstrable experience designing campaign strategies that have driven measurable pipeline and expansion revenue, not just executing plans built by others
  • Demonstrable experience designing and owning digital ABM campaign strategies — defining targeting, engagement models, and measurement frameworks for named accounts or account segments
  • Proven ability to make commercial trade-off decisions across paid media, email, nurture, and content syndication — you know how to read performance data and decide where to invest, scale, or cut
  • Experience designing marketing campaigns across both acquisition and customer expansion — you understand the bow-tie and know how to architect campaigns that drive growth on both sides of it
  • Experience with marketing technology platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, and programmatic/ABM tools — you understand the strategic possibilities and limitations of the stack, not just how to operate it
  • Background in B2B SaaS preferred — but strong strategic thinking and commercial instinct matter more than sector match

Skills and capabilities

  • Strong campaign strategist — you design campaign architectures, define audience and channel strategies, and make the decisions that shape what gets built and launched
  • Data-informed decision maker — you don’t just report on performance, you interpret it, draw conclusions, and make strategic recommendations that change what the team does next
  • Commercially minded — you understand that every campaign decision is a trade-off and you make those trade-offs with pipeline and revenue outcomes in mind
  • Clear communicator — able to present strategic recommendations, brief creative teams with precision, and articulate the rationale behind campaign decisions to senior stakeholders
  • Curious and proactive — you stay ahead of what’s changing in digital marketing and bring strategic recommendations to the team without being asked

How you operate

  • You think about campaigns in terms of pipeline contribution and expansion revenue, not just clicks and impressions
  • You’re a strategist who ships — you design campaigns with commercial intent and then make sure they get executed at the standard you set
  • You’re comfortable with complexity — balancing multiple campaign strategies across multiple channels, regions, and commercial objectives at the same time
  • You understand the bow-tie — you see acquisition and expansion as two halves of the same commercial motion and design campaign strategies accordingly
  • You embrace AI as part of how you work — using it to think faster and make better strategic decisions, not as a replacement for judgment

What success looks like in year one

  • Campaign strategies in place across acquisition and expansion that are clearly driving measurable pipeline contribution and revenue
  • ABM campaign strategies running against named accounts with defined engagement models and account-level progression metrics — not just awareness impressions
  • Nurture and expansion strategies optimized with measurable improvements in conversion rates across both sides of the bow-tie — based on trade-off decisions you made and can evidence
  • Clean, strategic campaign reporting that gives leadership and regional teams confidence in where digital marketing is delivering and where investment should shift
  • You are a key strategic contributor the Growth Marketing team relies on — trusted by the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, the wider growth team, and the sales function as someone who designs what we do and owns the outcomes

About Duetto

Duetto is the Revenue and Profit Operating System for the global hospitality industry — a PE-backed SaaS business with customers across hotels, casinos, and hospitality groups worldwide. We’re building a marketing function that matches our ambition: world-class, commercially driven, and genuinely category-defining.

With a focus on individual revenue and expense goals tied to the assigned portfolio, the PGO will manage a portfolio of rising to signature donors (cumulative gifts of $5,000+), ensuring high retention, increased giving, and enhanced donor involvement. jobs.excerpt: As a GRC Security Analyst, you will serve as a fully qualified, experienced professional responsible for ensuring Clear Capital adheres to all relevant security standards, regulations, and policies within the highly regulated mortgage lending and appraisal industry.
jobs.description:
As a GRC Security Analyst, you will serve as a fully qualified, experienced professional responsible for ensuring Clear Capital adheres to all relevant security standards, regulations, and policies within the highly regulated mortgage lending and appraisal industry. You will play a critical role in maintaining our Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) posture. Working independently with review at critical points, you will assess unusual circumstances, identify root causes using sophisticated analytical techniques, and devise creative solutions to complex compliance issues. You will help to coordinate internal and external security audits, define audit scopes, act as an organizational representative for information security compliance, and effectively adapt your communication style to influence and advise internal and external partners.

What You Will Work On

  • Monitoring and enforcing compliance with critical security frameworks (such as NIST CSF, NIST RMF, ISO 27001/27002, SOC 2, ISO 42001) and industry-specific regulations (such as GLBA, CCPA, GDPR) pertinent to the financial services and real estate valuation sectors.
  • Conducting comprehensive risk assessments of diverse scope to identify security vulnerabilities, evaluating the effectiveness of existing controls, and resolving a wide range of issues using judgment and interpretation.
  • Developing, maintaining, and adapting security policies, procedures, and guidelines in alignment with industry best practices, client contractual requirements, and mortgage lending regulatory standards.
  • Leading preparation and participation for internal and external security audits, adapting existing approaches to resolve audit findings based on limited information and precedent.
  • Enhancing relationships with cross-functional teams to develop and implement remediation plans for identified security gaps and weaknesses.
  • Evaluating the security posture of third-party vendors and assessing their compliance with contractual security requirements to protect sensitive financial and property data.
  • Maintaining accurate records of compliance activities, findings, and remediation efforts, creating comprehensive reports for management, clients, and regulatory authorities as needed.
  • Defining qualitative and quantitative metrics to assess the success of the security program and provide regular reports to security and business leadership.
  • Staying abreast of emerging security threats, technologies, and regulatory changes in the financial and real estate tech space.
  • Other relevant duties as assigned.

Who We Are Looking For

  • A minimum of 5 years of related experience in GRC, security compliance, or risk management roles with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or equivalent work experience.
  • Complete knowledge and full understanding of relevant security frameworks and standards (e.g., NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001) and data privacy regulations (GLBA, GDPR, CCPA).
  • Relevant industry certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional (AIGP), or equivalent.
  • Sophisticated analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess diverse, unusual, and complex security issues and develop effective solutions independently.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to persuade differing audiences and advise senior stakeholders on difficult compliance matters.
  • Familiarity with GRC technologies (i.e., Vanta, Drata, OneTrust, etc.), risk assessment tools, and practices specific to maintaining data integrity and confidentiality in the financial services or appraisal management industry.
  • Detail-oriented focus on accuracy and thoroughness in documentation, reporting, and policy formulation.
  • Commitment to maintaining the highest standards of confidentiality, integrity, and professionalism.
  • Capacity to understand legacy and progressive technology and security controls along with respective risks. Working knowledge of technologies such as cloud computing, DevOps, and application security is required.
  • Advanced proficiency in utilizing spreadsheets for comprehensive data analysis, audit metric tracking, and complex compliance reporting.

What You Can Expect

  • Compensation: The base salary for this position ranges from $114,000 to $139,000 annually, depending on your location, experience, and qualifications. Additional compensation offerings include company profit-sharing bonus program, communication stipends, and referral bonuses.
  • Inclusive benefits package offering:
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and company paid vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, voluntary life and AD&D insurance options, voluntary supplemental insurances for accident, critical illness, and legal services, paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays, employee assistance and wellness programs, company paid short term disability coverage, company contributions to health saving funds (with participation in the high deductible health plan). We offer company paid access to Galileo for virtual primary care and Rula for virtual mental health resources.
  • Through our Anniversary Program, we celebrate the meaningful milestones and long tenure that reflect how much we value your contributions and commitment to our team.
  • Career and skill development resources to help advance your career and personal growth.
  • A mission-driven environment where your work makes a measurable impact on the real estate industry.

What We Value

  • Wherever it Leads, Whatever it Takes® - No matter how remote, complex, or unexpected. Our commitment never wavers.
  • Hire NICE people - Skills can be taught but character shines through. We seek those who bring integrity, kindness, and grit.
  • Lift others up - We lead with empathy and strive to improve the lives of those around us.
  • Sweat the details - Excellence lives in the little things. Getting it just so is how we make a big impact.
  • Raise the bar - We don’t settle for industry standards, we redefine them.

About Us

Clear Capital is a national real estate analytics, data solutions and valuation technology company with a simple purpose: to build confidence in real estate decisions to strengthen communities and improve lives. Our goal is to provide customers with a complete understanding of nearly every U.S. property through our AI-driven analytics, data solutions, valuation services and automated appraisal review platforms. Our commitment to excellence - wherever it leads, whatever it takes® - is embodied by our team members across our brands and has remained steadfast in this pursuit since our first order in 2001.

Day

Health care is constantly changing, and at Banner Health, we are at the front of that change. We are leading health care to make the experience the best it can be. We want to change the lives of those in our care – and the people who choose to take on this challenge. If changing health care for the better sounds like something you want to be part of, we want to hear from you.

We are seeking candidates who are motivated and enthusiastic to be part of a dynamic team of Health Schedulers. Within this position you will be responsible for answering inbound calls, scheduling, rescheduling and canceling patient appointments as required. Answering patients' questions regarding basic medical questions and procedures. Providing instructions to patients to ensure that they are prepared for examinations and procedures as well as confirming patient appointments. You must be able to communicate well with our patients and provide extraordinary customer service. There is room for growth and this role offers great stability. Our positions are REMOTE and you can work in any Banner approved states.

A successful candidate should have a designated area away from distractions to complete this job, attend all training sessions, have established internet connection and able to complete a hardwired internet connection. This position also requires someone who is comfortable working with multiple scheduling systems at a time and navigate through the systems effortlessly while staying organized and viewing 8 or more windows at a time. This is a high-volume call center that requires you to be on the phone back-to-back handling inbound calls of 50+. You may be asked to assist/ cross train in other scheduling departments when needed.

Call Center, Health Care, Front Desk, Receptionist OR Customer Service highly desired.

Full Time Shifts: Will vary between the hours of 6:00am-7:00pm, Monday through Friday, depending on the department needs. Saturday 5-hour shift may also be required from 8am-1pm for some departments.

Departments: Hospital Imaging Centralized Scheduling, Banner Imaging, Primary Care, MD Anderson Cancer Center and Specialties such as Orthro, Sports Meds, Urology, Neurology, Peds etc.….

Openings: We currently have a few openings for each department which will be discussed during the interview process.

Training: Remote- M-F 8am-4:30pm, this can change depending on department needs, equipment will be provided. Cameras are required during trainings and meetings.

Shifts are not flexible to accommodate personal appointments during the day. This is a call center role that requires you to work scheduled hours due to business needs.

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for scheduling across the system for physicians, medical facilities and medical practices by coordinating all aspects of scheduling including, but not limiting to, facility resources, physicians, authorizations, insurance verification, benefits and setting payment expectations to ensure an exceptional customer experience at each point of service. Using a broad understanding of customer engagement strategies, clinical procedures and company facilities, this position provides accurate and timely information to create an experience that is easy, empathetic and differentiated in the marketplace.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Schedules medical appointments through coordination of patients, providers, facility resources, ancillary staff, records, referrals, authorizations and payers. Receives and initiates calls to/from patients, providers, provider offices and facilities, while following all established scheduling procedures and protocols to ensure patients receive the care they need, when and where they need it.

2. Effectively schedules appointments, tests and/or procedures leveraging various electronic medical record / scheduling software systems according to protocols established by clinical staff and scheduling standards. Identifies alternative schedule solutions in the event patient’s preference is not available, while adhering to procedures and protocols and ensuring patient safety.

3. Obtains patient demographics, insurance information and necessary documents required to secure authorizations, referrals, or other data as determined by various facilities and insurance carriers. Responsible for obtaining and properly documenting all necessary and accurate data during the intake/registration process. Acquires and documents pertinent patient medical information in accordance with procedural guidelines.

4. Provides patients with information, pre and post-test instruction, provides location of appointment and directions. This position answers questions as necessary within guidelines and protocols. Refers questions to medical offices as appropriate. Ensures patient has “no surprises” at point of service by setting payment expectations, as well as, providing estimated payment detail where applicable.

5. Effectively communicates and builds impactful relationships through written, digital and verbal channels with patients, facilities, providers and other clinical colleagues to ensure an easy, empathetic, solution-orientated patient experience, included but not limited to phone, chat, email, electronic medical record messaging and other digital channels. Anticipates patient and provider needs and responds accordingly.

6. Solicits, labels, stores and manages scanned documents and orders received from physician offices in the document imaging software system. Ensures that all appropriate documents are received prior to appointments and ensures that orders are compliant with each facility’s policy.

7. Where applicable, collects pre-payments and verifies insurance coverage to ensure “no surprises” and enable patient ease.

8. Services inbound and outbound customer and staff communications for all facilities in the states in which they operate. Works with various departments and staff to provide accurate managed care information.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge.

Requires skills and abilities typically attained with minimum of 1 or more years of customer service or related experience in a healthcare setting, such as medical office/clinic or hospital scheduling. Other acceptable experience includes lab, medical transcription, medical assistant or receptionist in a medical setting or other equivalent experience. Demonstrated ability to provide essential customer service and knowledge in a high paced inbound contact center environment Ability to use technology tools to research and obtain accurate information to respond to customer inquiries via incoming calls, emails and/or instant messaging/chat avenues while maintaining a professional solutions and service-oriented demeanor at all times. Effective ability to build customer loyalty through positive customer interactions and provide an easy experience. Demonstrated ability to utilize computer and typing skills.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to maintain a positive and helpful attitude with customers, providers and clinic operations. Must have the ability to follow oral and written directions as they relate to the functions listed above. Must have the ability to acquire and utilize a sound knowledge of the company’s customer information systems. Must possess excellent organizational and time management skills. Accurate and efficient keyboarding skills, the ability to work effectively with common office software are required. Requires effective teamwork skills and the ability to meet deadlines and productivity standards.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience in an in-bound call center or scheduler in a practice management environment preferred. Knowledge of payor contract terms and processes preferred. Some level of familiarity with medical terminology strongly preferred. Knowledge of payor contract terms and processes is preferred.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

North Star Network (NSN) est un groupe international de médias spécialisé dans le sport et les paris en ligne. Nous développons et opérons des marques digitales leaders qui connectent les passionnés de sport et les parieurs dans plus de 30 pays.

Notre mission est de transformer la passion pour le sport et le gaming en information fiable, analyses basées sur la donnée et divertissement responsable.

Entreprise internationale et entièrement remote, NSN rassemble plus de 50 collaborateurs internes et plus de 200 experts externes issus de plus de 20 nationalités à travers l’Europe, l’Afrique et les Amériques.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre Business Unit Africa, nous recherchons un Rédacteur de contenu spécialisé sur le marché africain francophone.

À propos du poste

Rattaché à un Content Manager, le Rédacteur de contenu est responsable de la production d’articles engageants, précis et optimisés pour le référencement naturel (SEO).

Votre mission principale sera de produire du contenu de qualité pour nos sites dédiés au marché africain francophone, tout en respectant les standards éditoriaux, le ton des marques et les objectifs business de l’entreprise.

Ce rôle est clé pour maintenir un haut niveau de qualité, d’autorité et de pertinence sur nos plateformes dans les secteurs très compétitifs des paris sportifs et du iGaming.

Création de contenu

  • Rédiger des articles originaux et de haute qualité en respectant les briefs éditoriaux, le ton et la structure demandés.

  • Adapter le style rédactionnel aux audiences et aux spécificités du marché africain francophone.

  • Garantir l’exactitude des informations et la clarté du contenu tout en maintenant un ton engageant et professionnel.

  • Produire un volume régulier de contenus dans le respect des délais, des standards de qualité et des exigences SEO.

  • Effectuer des recherches approfondies sur les thématiques, tendances et opérateurs afin de proposer des informations fiables et à jour.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

About the team

The Customer Service team at Nebius handles thousands of requests every month — quota applications, billing operations, planned enterprise cluster upgrades, and incident notifications. Volume has grown 130% over seven months and continues to grow alongside our customer base.

We are building a dedicated automation team to turn repetitive manual work into scalable, maintainable systems: LLM-powered agents, self-service flows, and infrastructure tooling.

The role

We are looking for an Automation Engineer to design and build systems that move repetitive Customer Service work into automated flows. You will work directly with ticketing system data, build LLM agents, develop self-service flows, and integrate solutions with internal Nebius systems.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build agents and scripts to automate quota request processing — the largest single category of manual engineer work in the queue
  • Develop self-service flows for billing and DSR requests: payment method updates, account deletion, marketing opt-out, invoice retrieval
  • Build and maintain LLM-powered agents that help support engineers handle complex tickets in real time
  • Develop N8N workflows for customer notifications and event-driven processes
  • Integrate solutions with Jira API, billing API, and internal Nebius systems
  • Contribute to tooling for planned cluster operations (Terraform, runbooks)
  • Maintain and improve existing automation as ticket volumes grow

We expect you to have:

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on automation, backend development, or system integrations
  • Strong Python skills
  • Hands-on experience working with REST APIs and integrating external systems
  • Practical experience with LLM APIs or building AI agents
  • Understanding of how to build reliable, maintainable automation systems
  • Working proficiency in English

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with N8N, Temporal, or similar workflow automation tools
  • Knowledge of Jira API or other ticketing systems
  • Experience with Terraform or cloud infrastructure
  • Understanding of Kubernetes and containerization
  • Background in support engineering or adjacent functions

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

JOB TITLE: Associate Procurement Manager

DEPARTMENT: Platform Procurement

REPORTS TO: Platform Procurement Manager

SUMMARY

The Associate Procurement Manager will support the strategic planning and management of Aligned’s data center critical power and cooling equipment supply chain. Working under the guidance of the Platform Procurement Manager, this role will support vendor management, equipment sourcing, commercial analysis, procurement planning, and execution across assigned equipment categories.

This is a hands-on role requiring strong technical curiosity and a willingness to develop a detailed understanding of the equipment and systems being procured, in addition to their commercial and supply-chain considerations. A successful candidate will have strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, demonstrated initiative, and the ability to quickly learn complex technical and commercial concepts in a fast-paced environment.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the management of assigned data center equipment categories, including sourcing, commercial evaluation, vendor management, and procurement execution.
  • Work closely with strategic vendor partners to ensure alignment with Aligned’s programmatic needs, technical requirements, and long-term procurement strategy.
  • Develop working relationships with vendor account management, sales, operations, and technical teams, with increasing responsibility for independently managing vendor interactions.
  • Support and eventually lead competitive sourcing activities, including RFPs, bid evaluations, commercial comparisons, vendor recommendations, and award documentation.
  • Collaborate with construction, engineering, finance, accounting, and other internal stakeholders to align procurement activities with project and business requirements.
  • Support the creation and processing of purchase orders, change orders, and other commercial documentation while maintaining visibility into approved purchasing budgets.
  • Track, analyze, and report on equipment pricing, cost drivers, market conditions, lead times, capacity constraints, and other factors affecting current and future equipment purchasing.
  • Prepare commercial analyses, bid leveling, pricing comparisons, and cost models to support procurement recommendations and decision-making.
  • Assist with commercial negotiations, including equipment pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, commercial terms, and other supplier commitments.
  • Support commercial agreement activities by coordinating vendor inputs, tracking open items, and assisting with commercial reviews and documentation.
  • Support long-term equipment demand, capacity, and procurement planning across Aligned’s development pipeline.
  • Develop a strong working knowledge of Aligned’s data center equipment, including its function, application, key technical requirements, and relationship to broader data center electrical and mechanical systems.
  • Take a hands-on approach to learning assigned equipment categories through collaboration with internal engineering teams, vendor technical resources, manufacturing facility visits, equipment reviews, and other technical learning opportunities.
  • Review equipment specifications, technical proposals, and vendor offerings to develop an understanding of technical differences and their potential commercial and procurement implications.
  • Maintain accurate procurement data, vendor documentation, commercial records, and reporting associated with assigned equipment categories.
  • Prepare and present procurement analyses, recommendations, vendor updates, and other information to internal stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of Platform Procurement processes, tools, standards, and reporting.
  • Take increasing ownership of assigned equipment categories and procurement initiatives as experience and capabilities develop.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 1-3 years of experience in procurement, supply chain, engineering, construction, manufacturing, project management, data/information systems, or another relevant field.
  • Strong technical aptitude and curiosity, with a demonstrated interest in learning how complex equipment and systems function and interact.
  • Ability and willingness to develop a working understanding of technical specifications, equipment documentation, engineering drawings, and other technical information relevant to assigned equipment categories.
  • Strong Excel skills, including the ability to organize and analyze large data sets, develop formulas and analytical models, perform data comparisons, and clearly present findings.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to organize, evaluate, and draw conclusions from quantitative and qualitative information.
  • Hands-on, self-directed approach to learning and problem solving, with a willingness to ask questions, investigate unfamiliar topics, and actively develop technical and commercial subject-matter knowledge.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of broader project and business objectives.
  • Demonstrated initiative and willingness to take ownership of work.
  • Ability to work effectively across technical, commercial, financial, and operational teams.
  • Ability to travel as required to support vendor relationships, manufacturing activities, and technical learning opportunities.

ADDITIONAL DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Experience in procurement, supply chain, engineering, manufacturing, construction, or another technically oriented environment.
  • Exposure to data center, electrical, mechanical, or other mission-critical infrastructure equipment.
  • Experience supporting RFPs, bid evaluations, supplier negotiations, or purchasing activities.
  • Familiarity with equipment manufacturing, production planning, or supply-chain management.
  • Experience with commercial or financial analysis, including pricing comparisons, forecasting, or cost modeling.
  • Familiarity with construction drawings, specifications, equipment schedules, or technical scopes.

COMPETENCIES

This is a remote position.

About TransLash

Fueled by a team of journalists and media makers, TransLash is a multi-platform, award-winning organization with deep credibility and impact in the trans community and beyond.

TransLash has grown into a bold, wide-ranging producer of media that centers the lives and stories of TGNC people, adding critical nuance and depth to the issues that shape national headlines. We’ve created award-winning podcasts, critically acclaimed films, community-sourced zines, and a growing library of personal essays and journalism by TGNC contributors. We document, create, and influence trans culture for TGNC people and those who love them. We investigate and share the bold stories that others can’t—or won’t—in order to present trans lives in their fullness and complexity. Our work sparks new conversations, builds community, and supports an expanding network of allies. Together, we’re imagining new futures for trans people—and bringing those futures to life.

Our coverage centers trans communities and communities of color, and we especially encourage applications from people with lived experience in those communities, including trans people and trans people of color.

Job Summary

The Director of Podcast Production leads the podcast department and provides strategic, editorial, and operational oversight across all podcast initiatives. This role is responsible for the overall direction, quality, and accuracy of podcast content, ensuring projects are clearly scoped, aligned with organizational priorities, and executed at a high editorial standard.

Serving as the direct supervisor of Senior Producers, the Director oversees team management, workload delegation, and performance accountability. They work closely with Senior Producers and the Operations Team to assess project viability, align on scope, and determine production feasibility based on team capacity and resources.

At the show level, the Director partners with the Executive Producer and Senior Producers to define and articulate creative vision and direction. On scripted projects, they provide editorial review to ensure narrative clarity, alignment with the agreed upon vision, and consistency with the broader TransLash voice prior to Executive Producer review.

The Director also collaborates cross-functionally with leadership across other TransLash verticals to support integrated storytelling initiatives and coordinated content strategies.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the podcast department, directly supervising Senior Producers and ensuring effective oversight of all active podcast projects

  • Oversee project intake, assessing feasibility, scope, and alignment with organizational priorities

  • Formalize and refine scalable systems that support structured intake, workflow clarity, and production efficiency

  • Partner with executive leadership to align podcast strategy with broader organizational goals

  • Review scripts and key editorial materials to ensure factual accuracy, alignment with organizational voice, and adherence to editorial standards prior to executive review

  • Ensure all projects are delivered on time and in alignment with approved scope

  • Guide scheduling, resource allocation, and budgeting in partnership with Operations and Senior Producers

  • Continually refine workflows across development, production, editorial review, & delivery

  • Delegate responsibilities appropriately and provide ongoing coaching, feedback, and performance evaluation for Senior Producers

  • Manage relationships with external partners, platforms, and collaborators

  • Collaborate with internal departments to ensure effective cross-functional coordination.

The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor.

Qualifications

  • 7–10+ years of experience in podcasting, audio production, or related media, including at least 3 years of direct team leadership experience managing experienced producers or cross-functional creative teams, is required

  • Demonstrated strong editorial judgment, including substantial experience reviewing scripts and content for factual accuracy, narrative clarity, consistency, and alignment with organizational voice

  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects, ensuring delivery on time, on budget, and to high editorial and production standards

  • Experience managing budgets, workflows, and departmental resources while fostering cross-functional collaboration

  • Strategic thinker with the ability to align departmental objectives with broader organizational goals and build internal and external partnerships

  • Experience working directly with high-profile executives and senior leadership in a collaborative yet accountable structure

  • Demonstrated ability to create and oversee culturally competent coverage, ensuring editorial sensitivity and alignment with trans and LGBTQ+ communities

  • Willingness and availability to travel occasionally for leadership alignment and team-building initiatives.

Physical Requirements

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often sitting or standing for prolonged periods.

  • Prolonged periods working on a computer.

  • Communicating with others to exchange information.

  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers.

  • Must be able to lift 15 pounds at a time.

Location

This is a fully remote position. TheDirector of Podcast Productionmay be based anywhere within the United States.

Salary

$135,000 annuallyplus benefits.

Why TransLash

At TransLash Media, we don’t just tell stories—we create impact. Our award-winning journalism challenges misinformation, elevates trans voices, and strengthens democracy. By joining our team, you’ll contribute to groundbreaking investigative work that informs, empowers, and transforms public discourse.

Here’s why working with TransLash is an opportunity unlike any other:

Mission-Driven Work:Every project we undertake is rooted in a commitment to trans justice, truth, and democracy. Your work will directly contribute to a larger movement for equality and human rights.

Meaningful Impact:Our audience is highly politically engaged and civically minded, meaning the work we produce extends far beyond storytelling—it influences policy, public opinion, and advocacy work.

Innovative Storytelling:We push the boundaries of journalism through documentary podcasts, digital media, and multimedia storytelling, ensuring that critical narratives reach the widest possible audience.

Collaborative & Inclusive Culture:We believe in fostering an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and empowered. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do.

Staff Engineer

About LaunchDarkly Engineering

LaunchDarkly helps engineering organizations ship software and AI with speed, safety, and control. Our platform gives teams the confidence to release gradually, target experiences to the right audiences, learn through experimentation, understand what is happening in production, and respond quickly when risk appears.

Our engineers build the systems, services, SDKs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, and product experiences that make this possible. The work spans high-scale distributed systems, reliable data and event pipelines, intuitive enterprise workflows, and AI-powered capabilities that help teams manage the next generation of software delivery.

LaunchDarkly’s SDKs are used in systems that perform trillions of feature flag evaluations each day, giving our engineering work a direct connection to the reliability and customer experience of software around the world. As the company grows, we are expanding beyond traditional feature management into experimentation, observability, and AgentControl—helping customers control more of the software and AI lifecycle. That creates an unusually broad set of technical challenges, visible customer impact, and room for engineers to shape what comes next.

We believe in the power of teams. We work with humility, openness, curiosity, and care; we value clear communication, thoughtful technical judgment, inclusive collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership. Staff scope at LaunchDarkly is defined by impact rather than title alone. The specific domain may include platform infrastructure, APIs, SDKs, data systems, observability, experimentation, feature management, or AI/agent capabilities.

As a Staff Engineer at LaunchDarkly, you will provide technical leadership beyond a single team. You will help define direction for important systems or product areas, guide complex initiatives, and create leverage by enabling other engineers to make better decisions and deliver with confidence.

Staff Engineers at LaunchDarkly are trusted for their judgment, influence, and ability to connect customer needs, business goals, product strategy, and technical execution. You may lead architecture across multiple teams, establish durable patterns, improve developer effectiveness, or help the organization navigate a significant change in technology or product direction.

This is an individual contributor role. You will lead through expertise, communication, and influence rather than through direct people management.

What you’ll do

Geramos insights, recomendações e coordenamos ações cross-funcionais relacionadas à experiência dos clientes, a fim de alavancar a geração de valor através da melhoria contínua na sua jornada.

The role is responsible for leading interactions with the FDA Office of Product Prescription and Drug Promotion be responsible to function as a leader during review and escalation meetings to assure compliance with and evolution of the applicable Review process enabling business needs to be met in a compelling, compliant, and timely way.

  • Provides vision, strategy and leads the adpromo team reporting into them

  • Lead interactions with OPDP/APLB, including proactive engagement with OPDP/APLB in support of business needs, and as needed, response to regulatory inquiries.

Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know:

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. For Real World Late Phase, the CRA II will use the business card title of Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include:Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs.Chart abstraction activities and data collection
    Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
  • US ONLY: As part of your employment with Syneos Health, you may be deployed to Sites that require certain medical and other personal information to gain facility access. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Hartford Investment Management Company (HIMCO)

Internship, Business Operations

Hartford Investment Management Company (HIMCO), a subsidiary of The Hartford Insurance Group, is committed to being a leading provider of investment management solutions.

About HIMCO

Hartford Investment Management Company (HIMCO) has been providing investment advice for over 35 years. With more than 130 investment professionals and approximately $120 billion in assets under management (AUM) across the fixed income, equity, and alternatives markets, we deliver tailored strategies to insurance companies as well as retail and institutional clients. Our mission is the pursuit of investment excellence centered on each client's success, and we have developed a culture that fosters debate and collaboration in an effort to drive value and results.

Why intern in Business Operations?

This is a great hands-on opportunity at a growing investment management company with affiliate and third-party assets under management. Interns will work across Business Operations, data, and technology initiatives, helping analyze processes, support reporting and data needs, and identify practical opportunities to improve efficiency, controls, and decision-making. This internship offers students a firsthand look at how business processes, data, and technology support investment management, with opportunities to collaborate across Business Operations, Portfolio Management, Trading, and IT through meaningful project work, networking, and a capstone presentation. Interns will also gain knowledge of fixed income, equity, derivative, and alternative assets with varying degrees of complexity.

About the internship

This is a 10-week experience designed to immerse interns in the buy-side investment management industry by working alongside one of HIMCO’s Business Operations teams. Assignments may include performance measurement and attribution, investment reporting, trade operations, data integrity, reconciliation and controls, valuations, or business process improvement. Interns may help document current-state processes, analyze data quality or reporting needs, support workflow improvement efforts, and contribute to initiatives that connect business requirements with technology-enabled solutions. Interns are offered development opportunities through mentoring, networking, business unit reviews, executive speakers, volunteering, and social events. Each intern’s contributions will culminate in a capstone project presentation to HIMCO senior leaders. Successful summer interns may be invited back for a full-time Business Operations position.
