jobs.description:
Fireclay Tile is here to revolutionize the tile and design industry. By implementing an innovative digital platform paired with unmatched artisan-crafted products and client service, we've made it easier than ever to specify and purchase beautiful, sustainable tile sourced and handcrafted in the US. Our tireless commitment to innovation, transparency, and sustainability has not gone unrecognized. We aim to grow 25-35% annually and are the first tile company recognized as a B Corp for how we use Business as a Force for Good. With an innovative product, an ambitious team, and an inspiring mission, we're changing the way you think about tile. Come join the makers who support the dreamers!

Location: San Francisco Bay Area preferred. Remote U.S.- based candidates considered, with occasional San Francisco Bay Area travel.

The Team You’ll Work With …

As Director of Growth, you will lead Fireclay’s growth engine across homeowner, Trade, and commercial customer journeys. You will own the growth roadmap for fireclaytile.com and lead the connected work across performance marketing, lifecycle, E-Commerce conversion, SEM, SEO, GEO, affiliate and partner growth, site experience, measurement, and AI-enabled workflows.

This role reports to Eric Edelson, Fox Marble and Fireclay’s CEO, and will partner closely with the VP of Technology, VP of Sales, VP of Brand & Product, and VP of Client Success. Technology owns engineering and delivery. Brand & Product retain final creative and product direction. You own the growth strategy, media budget, website growth roadmap, performance priorities, and operating cadence that connect those efforts to commercial outcomes. You will inherit an agency and part of a team, then build the capability around you. This is a salary role, target total annual compensation of $150,000–$250,000, inclusive of base salary, bonus, and equity, depending on experience and scope.

The Challenge

Fireclay is working to double revenue over the next 24 months. As Director of Growth, you will help build the demand engine to make that possible. Your mandate is to scale media investment from low six figures today toward mid- and high-six figures over time, but only where the data proves we can do so profitably. You will build the measurement, customer journeys, website experience, creative-learning system, and operating rhythm that turn more demand into qualified samples, new customers, Trade relationships, and revenue.

This role is for a builder who wants to join a team and help shape a brand. You care about the product, the customer, and the people making it. You know that durable growth comes from understanding a brand deeply and working exceptionally well with the people responsible for product, technology, sales, service, and creative, not optimizing channels in isolation. You will not inherit a finished machine. You will help build one.

The Opportunities You’ll Have …

  • Build the growth engine required to help double Fireclay revenue in 24 months.
  • Own the growth funnel from investment and qualified traffic through sample order, purchase, Trade engagement, revenue, and contribution.
  • Lead paid-media strategy, agency management, budget allocation, creative learning, and performance accountability. Define when Fireclay should spend more, hold, or pull back using customer quality, conversion, revenue, and contribution guardrails—not platform ROAS alone.
  • Own the growth roadmap for fireclaytile.com, including customer journeys, landing pages, merchandising, UI/UX improvements, site performance, and conversion opportunities.
  • Build an integrated sample-to-purchase system across paid acquisition, lifecycle, on-site experience, sales and client-success handoffs, and post-sample communications.
  • Activate profitable growth opportunities beyond conventional paid media, including Trade affiliate and partner programs, post-sample print and direct-mail programs, referral opportunities, and other testable acquisition channels.
  • Build a lean, high-performing growth operating model. Use the right mix of in-house leadership, agency partners, specialist vendors, and global/offshore talent to expand SEM, SEO, GEO, analytics, creative production, and lifecycle capacity cost-effectively—without compromising quality, security, brand, or accountability.
  • Turn Fireclay’s Trade member audience into a stronger growth engine. Build and scale affiliate, referral, partner, education, lifecycle, and engagement programs that create incremental qualified demand and durable member value.
  • Build lifecycle programs that make the next best action clear for homeowners, designers, Trade customers, and commercial accounts—from discovery and sampling through purchase, engagement, and reactivation.
  • Establish a reliable measurement foundation across analytics, advertising platforms, CRM, sales, and financial outcomes. Improve the data before drawing conclusions from it.
  • Create a disciplined experimentation cadence: clear hypotheses, high-value tests, success metrics, guardrails, decision thresholds, and recommendations on what to scale, stop, or learn next.
  • Use AI tools—including Claude, ChatGPT, and emerging systems—to accelerate analysis, creative development, workflow design, testing, and team productivity without compromising judgment, privacy, or customer experience.
  • Build, coach, and lead the team required to scale the function.

What Success Looks Like Early

  • First 15 days: Diagnose the funnel, media mix, agency performance, customer journeys, and measurement gaps; establish the commercial baseline.
  • First 30 days: Present the growth roadmap and investment thesis; reallocate budget where warranted; launch the first high-priority conversion, lifecycle, and acquisition tests.
  • First 60 days: Put a trusted growth scorecard and operating cadence in place; show early performance movement; establish the hiring, agency, and technology plan required to scale.

About You …

  • You have helped scale a consumer, home, design, or adjacent business from approximately $50M to $250M in revenue. You know how to grow with constraints—not merely with large teams and large budgets.
  • You have deep experience across DTC E-Commerce and B2B, Trade, or commercial customer journeys. You understand their different needs, buying cycles, and definitions of success.
  • You are AI-native. You live in Claude, ChatGPT, or comparable tools and have used them to make your own work and your teams meaningfully faster and better. You know the difference between real leverage and AI theater. You will be asked to demonstrate your AI workflow.
  • You have personally led work across SEM, SEO, GEO, paid acquisition, lifecycle marketing, affiliate and partner growth, conversion-rate optimization, E-Commerce merchandising, and website performance.
  • You are analytically rigorous and commercially minded. You can work from imperfect data, reconcile sources, identify the real constraint, and turn insight into action.
  • You know the difference between an ad-platform metric and a business outcome. You care about qualified demand, revenue, contribution, and customer quality—not vanity metrics.
  • You have operated across an omni-channel business, connecting digital demand with sales, service, showrooms, or other human-assisted customer experiences.
  • You are a missionary, not a mercenary. You want to become part of a brand and a team—not simply optimize another media account.
  • You are a collaborative, resourceful leader who earns trust across technology, sales, brand, product, and client-success teams. You bring strong points of view while respecting functional expertise.
  • You bring established, high-quality relationships with agency, technology, affiliate, publisher, and specialist partners. You know when to build in-house, when to use flexible expertise, and how to hold every partner accountable to commercial outcomes.
  • You have direct experience using specialized global and offshore talent effectively. You can create clear standards, workflows, QA, and accountability that make distributed capacity an advantage rather than a source of rework.
  • You have built or scaled affiliate and partner-growth programs, ideally involving a Trade, professional, design, or member audience. You know how to drive engagement and profitable growth without treating a valued community as a cheap acquisition channel.
  • You have a high bar for customer experience. You know how to improve conversion without compromising trust, clarity, design quality, or the Fireclay brand.

Why Fireclay?

Beyond the role itself, here’s what makes Fireclay Tile a special place to work:

  • Our Mission: We are on a mission to do good by crafting products intentionally, collaboratively, and transparently. We are the makers, who support the dreamers.
  • Our Values: We live by Kindness, Honesty, Tread Lightly on the Earth, Measure Twice, Cut Once, and Ganas (Desire).
  • Our Commitment: We are accountable to the B Corp standards, prioritizing People and Planet alongside Profit.
  • Growth and Innovation: We are committed to "25-35% annual growth" and are revolutionizing the tile and design industry.
  • Our Culture: We foster a culture of professional development, ongoing training, and opportunities for growth.
  • Our Benefits: We offer a comprehensive compensation package, including medical, dental, vision, a 4% 401(k) match, PTO (non-exempt) or FTO (exempt), sick time, and other perks. Visit Fireclaybenefits.com to view details of our benefits and perks offered.

Serving as a Fireclay Tile Brand Ambassador, representing our core values including:

Kindness ○ Honesty ○ Tread Lightly on the Earth ○ Measure Twice, Cut Once ○ Ganas (Desire)

Accountable to the B Corp standards, we take care of our People and our Planet while turning a Profit.

jobs.excerpt: POSITION PURPOSE The Client Onboarding Analyst – New Plans supports the end-to-end onboarding of newly sold 401(k) plans onto Ubiquity’s recordkeeping platform.
jobs.description:
POSITION PURPOSE

The Client Onboarding Analyst – New Plans supports the end-to-end onboarding of newly sold 401(k) plans onto Ubiquity’s recordkeeping platform. Working within the New Plan team and reporting to the New Plan Team Lead, this role is responsible for executing plan setup tasks, preparing plan documents, coordinating payroll integration, and managing an active pipeline of new plan cases from contract through go-live. The Analyst serves as the primary point of contact for plan sponsors, financial advisors, and Third Party Administrators throughout the setup process, providing proactive communication, ongoing platform education, and compliance-aware guidance at every milestone. All complex issues, escalations, and cross-functional blockers are routed through the New Plan Team Lead.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

New Plan Setup & Document Preparation

  • Manage an assigned pipeline of new 401(k) plan cases from initial contract through go-live on Ubiquity’s platform, tracking each case against established milestones and SLAs using Salesforce and internal case management tools; proactively flag cases at risk of delay to the New Plan Team Lead.
  • Draft plan documents for new clients based on their selected plan design elections, ensuring all provisions are accurately reflected and in compliance with ERISA, IRS, and DOL requirements.
  • Review and verify plan design elections submitted by plan sponsors and advisors, identifying and clarifying any inconsistencies or missing information before plan document preparation begins.
  • Establish trust accounts and confirm investment elections are properly configured in accordance with the plan document and client instructions.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date case records, notes, and milestone documentation in Salesforce and Ubiquity’s recordkeeping system throughout the plan setup lifecycle.

Payroll Integration & Contribution Setup

  • Coordinate payroll setup requirements directly with plan sponsors to ensure contribution data, employee census information, and payroll schedules are accurately configured prior to the first payroll submission.
  • Guide plan sponsors through the process of connecting their payroll system to Ubiquity’s platform, explaining integration steps, expected timelines, and required actions clearly and proactively.
  • Monitor initial payroll submissions after go-live to confirm contributions are processing correctly; identify and troubleshoot discrepancies in contribution amounts, employee eligibility data, or payroll file formats, escalating to the New Plan Team Lead when issues cannot be resolved at the analyst level.
  • Document payroll setup configurations and any integration issues encountered for each case, maintaining a clear record in Salesforce for the plan’s ongoing service history.

Client & Advisor Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for plan sponsors, financial advisors, and Third Party Administrators throughout the new plan setup process, providing proactive, milestone-based updates on outstanding items and next steps.
  • Conduct plan setup kickoff calls to establish expectations, review the onboarding timeline, confirm required actions from each party, and introduce plan sponsors to the Ubiquity platform.
  • Deliver ongoing platform education throughout the onboarding lifecycle, including portal navigation, contribution submission, employee enrollment, and plan reporting, ensuring sponsors are fully equipped to manage their plan independently at go-live.
  • Follow up in a timely and organized manner to obtain required documentation, signatures, and plan elections, creating appropriate urgency to minimize time to first contribution.
  • Escalate complex plan design questions, unresolved setup issues, or cross-functional blockers to the New Plan Team Lead rather than attempting to resolve them independently or routing directly to other departments.

Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Ensure all plan setup tasks are completed in accordance with ERISA, IRS, and DOL requirements, including plan document provisions, required notices, contribution limits, and eligibility rules.
  • Review completed plan setup work for accuracy before submission, identifying errors or omissions and correcting them prior to plan go-live.
  • Stay current on changes to IRS and DOL regulations, plan contribution limits, and SECURE Act provisions that affect new plan setup and plan document preparation.
  • Maintain, follow, and enforce all Ubiquity security policies and procedures at all times.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Escalation

  • Coordinate directly with internal teams on routine plan setup tasks and approvals within established processes and authority levels, routing escalated issues or items requiring leadership judgment to the New Plan Team Lead.
  • Partner with Sales and Client Experience to ensure a smooth handoff from the point of sale through plan setup, with client expectations clearly established from day one.
  • Contribute to team process improvement efforts by identifying recurring setup issues, documentation gaps, payroll configuration challenges, or workflow inefficiencies and surfacing them to the New Plan Team Lead.
  • Support the team during high-volume periods by assisting colleagues with case overflow and contributing to shared team priorities as directed by the New Plan Team Lead.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Experience in the 401(k) or retirement plan industry preferred, including exposure to new plan setup, plan implementation, plan documents, or plan design.

  • Working knowledge of 401(k) plan design and administration, including Safe Harbor, traditional 401(k), Profit Sharing, ERISA requirements, and IRS contribution limits preferred.

  • Familiarity with payroll integrations, contribution files, census data, and digital plan onboarding workflows a plus.

  • Experience in a fintech, SaaS, or technology-driven environment, including API-based integrations or cloud-based recordkeeping platforms, preferred.

  • Experience conducting client-facing onboarding or plan setup consultations with plan sponsors and financial advisors preferred.

  • Proficiency with CRM and workflow management tools such as Salesforce and Asana; experience with recordkeeping, plan document, compliance testing, or Form 5500 platforms (e.g., FT Williams, ASC) a plus.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Excel, and Word.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage a high-volume case pipeline while maintaining accuracy and meeting SLAs.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a professional, client-focused approach.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, exercise sound judgment, and escalate issues appropriately within established protocols.

  • QKA designation or active pursuit of ASPPA or NIPA credentials a plus.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Benefits & Perks

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage — 90% of your premium covered, 60% for dependents
  • 401(k) with company match up to 4% of your gross annual pay
  • $100/month wellness reimbursement + $300 home office stipend
  • Fully remote, flexible work culture

Compensation & Schedule

The annual base salary range for this role is $73,000–$83,000, with the opportunity to earn an additional 5% in variable compensation based on performance.

This role is expected to work 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m or 9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. Pacific Time to ensure alignment and availability with the team.

This is a remote position.

POSITION SUMMARY:

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Product Information Management (PIM) engineering team as a key thought leader and innovator. In this role, you will drive the architectural design and hands-on development of API-first, cloud-ready software to modernize our enterprise product catalog ecosystem across our global retail brands. You will build and scale high-throughput, event-driven microservices that seamlessly synchronize product taxonomy, merchandising attributes, digital assets, and item lifecycles between Akeneo PIM, upstream ERP/Digital Content systems, and downstream real-time consumers/E-commerce engines. Operating under Agile principles, you will translate complex business requirements into robust backend systems and databases, delivering frequent, high-impact releases that power global retail commerce.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support PIM Modernization & Platform Evolution:Support and evolve the Akeneo PIM (SaaS/Enterprise) platform as our live single system of record, maintaining modern cloud-native architectures that replaced legacy workflows (Oracle ATG/BCC, ItemDB, PubDB, and legacy batch jobs).
  • Architect Event-Driven Integrations:Design, develop, and maintain resilient microservices and stream-processing pipelines using Apache Kafka, schema registries, and modern backend frameworks (Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, or Go) to broadcast core catalog events.
  • Engineer Complex Data Models:Implement scalable product hierarchy models, variant structures (CSC/SKU levels), reference entities, category mappings, and delta-calculation engines for real-time and batch synchronization.
  • Orchestrate Cross-System Connections:Build high-reliability connectors and APIs integrating PIM with upstream systems (Intellimas, Creative Force / DAM, ItemDB) and downstream consumers (Product Fulcrum, Constructor/Bloomreach Search, E-commerce storefronts).
  • Optimize Production Stability:Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain the live Akeneo PIM platform to ensure 24/7 availability and minimal downtime across global retail brands.
  • Perform Fine-Tuning & Performance Optimization:Continuously optimize API response times, database query performance, and payload processing within Akeneo to handle rapidly growing catalog data.
  • Drive Continuous Feature Enhancements:Collaborate with business stakeholders to design and deploy incremental features, custom attributes, and localized catalog workflows in the live system.
  • Govern Data Integrity & Upgrades:Partner with the Akeneo SaaS/Enterprise support teams to plan, test, and execute seamless platform upgrades and patches while maintaining data accuracy.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong proficiency in building robust, secure microservices and API architectures (RESTful, SOAP) using Java, Spring frameworks (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud), Node.js / TypeScript, Go, or Python.
  • Deep hands-on experience with distributed streaming platforms and message-oriented middleware. Expert knowledge of the publisher/subscriber model, including Apache Kafka (topic architecture, consumer groups, partition strategies, schema registry, event headers), RabbitMQ, and IBM MQ.
  • Solid experience designing and optimizing relational, NoSQL, and memory-cached databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, CloudSQL, MongoDB, Redis). Expert in query optimization tailored for high-volume catalog, SKU, and enterprise datasets.
  • Practical experience deploying, managing, and orchestrating workloads in agile, cloud-native environments across GCP, AWS, or Azure. Proficient with Kubernetes (GKE), Docker, and enterprise CI/CD automation tools (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Bamboo).
  • Strong foundational understanding of modern security concepts, including authentication protocols, Single Sign-On (SSO), and secure data transmission.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working with enterprise Product Information Management (PIM) and catalog management solutions such as Akeneo.
  • Background in data migration strategies (delta loads, reconciliation scripts, and dual-entry cutover planning)
  • Knowledge in API security Gateway Frameworks/ concepts
  • Experience in application serves such as weblogic, tomcat etc

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking an Analytics Engineer to join our Analytics Platform team to design, build and maintain scalable data products that power our Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) and Care Navigation organizations. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming complex healthcare data into trusted, analytics ready datasets that support operational reporting, client insights, financial analysis and strategic decision-making. You will partner closely with Analytics, Data Engineering, Clinical, Client Success, Product and Operations teams to build reliable and scalable data models within our data foundry.

This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about analytics engineering, has strong dbt expertise, enjoys solving complex healthcare data challenges and thinks beyond individual requests to build reusable and maintainable systems.

You will play a key role in shaping the future of our data platform by developing high-quality data products, establishing engineering best practices, and helping the organization evolve toward AI-enabled and self-service analytics capabilities.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Apply hands on analytics and data expertise to solve complex, fast moving financial and operational problems in the health tech space
  • Design, develop and maintain scalable, analytics ready data models (primarily in dbt) that power a PBM and care navigation data ecosystem that support client reporting, performance analytics, operational analysis and self-service business intelligence.
  • Translate complex pharmacy benefits and healthcare navigation workflows, business rules and operational processes into transparent, maintainable, and auditable data models.
  • Partner closely with data and analytics engineers, data analysts and business stakeholders to deliver reliable data products that can be leveraged across multiple use cases and continuously optimize data models and warehouse performance to support large-scale PBM/care navigation datasets and growing business needs.
  • Implement automated data quality checks, testing frameworks and reconciliation processes to ensure data reliability.
  • Establish documentation standards, lineage and analytics engineering guardrails that promote transparency and auditability.
  • Contribute to engineering best practices including version control, CI/CD, incremental models, code reviews, and observability.
  • Contribute to data governance by establishing modeling standards, documentation and guardrails that support auditability, explainability and long term maintainability.
  • Build data foundations that enable future agentic analytics engineering use cases, including self-service analytics and AI-assisted insight generation.
  • Stay informed on emerging technologies and identify opportunities to incorporate AI into analytics engineering workflows.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data modeling, data warehousing or a related field.
  • Strong experience with dbt (core or cloud) and modern analytics engineering best practices (required).
  • Advanced SQL proficiency and experience developing data transformations and workflows using python.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, medallion architecture, semantic modeling and scalable data architecture principles.
  • Experience building and maintaining production-grade data models, data quality tests, and documentation.
  • Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery.
  • Experience orchestrating and monitoring data pipelines using tools such as Apache Airflow., Dagster etc.

  • Interest or experience in leveraging AI-enabled development workflows and analytics tooling, including experience with or willingness to learn technologies such as claude, claude skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and AI assisted engineering practices.

jobs.title: Senior Offensive Security Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewProCircular is a cybersecurity firm that helps organizations see where they’re vulnerable, understand how those gaps get exploited, and build a security program grounded in the real world.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

ProCircular is a cybersecurity firm that helps organizations see where they’re vulnerable, understand how those gaps get exploited, and build a security program grounded in the real world. We invest in advanced cybersecurity and AI research, then translate complex findings into practical guidance and solutions our clients can actually use. Across assessments, monitoring, incident response, advisory, AI risk, and compliance, ProCircular brings deep technical expertise, practical judgment, and a team that stays involved from initial findings through response and longer-term program development.

Trusted by organizations across healthcare, finance, manufacturing, education, transportation and logistics, and government, where downtime and risk carry real operational weight, ProCircular helps teams move from reactive security work to confident decisions, stronger readiness, and better follow-through.

Position Summary

You will run network penetration tests for organizations across the Midwest, and you will help us build our artificial intelligence (AI) red team practice from the ground up.

Most of your first year is traditional offensive work: internal and external network testing, owned end to end. The AI side is real and growing, and the person in this seat gets to define how we do it. We are not looking for someone to execute a playbook that already exists. We are looking for someone to write it.

Essential Job Functions (including but are not limited to the following)

  • Plan and execute internal and external network penetration tests, from scoping through remediation guidance.
  • Run engagements independently. You own the scope, the testing, the report, and the client readout.
  • Write findings a system administrator can act on and an executive can understand.
  • Present results to technical teams and to leadership, including IT directors, executive sponsors, and boards.
  • Retest remediated findings and help clients actually close gaps rather than just cataloging them.
  • Contribute to purple team exercises and adversary simulation work as engagements call for it.

Building the AI red team practice:
This part is greenfield. You will be building the offering, not inheriting it.

  • Design our testing methodology for AI systems: chatbots, autonomous agents, retrieval augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
  • Test for prompt injection (both direct and indirect), tool abuse and excessive agency, guardrail bypass, sensitive data exposure through agent tool chains, and unsafe handling of model output.
  • Assess MCP servers and agent integrations for authorization gaps, over-permissioned tools, tool poisoning, and insecure defaults.
  • Map our work to recognized references including the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications, MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
  • Turn what you learn into a repeatable service: scoping questions, test plans, report templates, and input on how we price the work.

Tooling and automation:
We expect our senior engineers to build, not just run other people's tools.

  • Write and ship internal tooling that makes testing faster and more consistent across the team.
  • Automate the repetitive parts of reconnaissance, validation, and reporting.
  • Bring an offensive perspective to our internal security products and help make them better.
  • Python is the common language on our offensive team.

Position Requirements

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge skills and abilities required. Employees who do not have the requirements for a job at the time of hire will not be considered for the position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Five or more years of hands-on offensive security experience.
  • OSCP or an equivalent hands-on, practical certification. We care about the exam you had to actually pass, not the number of acronyms.
  • Real depth in internal and external network penetration testing, including Active Directory attack paths, credential attacks, privilege escalation, and lateral movement.
  • The ability to carry a client engagement solo from kickoff through readout.
  • Strong written English. Reporting is a large part of this job, and we do not hand it off to someone else.
  • Comfort working remotely on a distributed team.
  • Ability to pass the background checks our education and public sector clients require.

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • Web application and application programming interface (API) testing.
  • Cloud testing in Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Microsoft 365.
  • Any hands on experience attacking or defending AI systems, agents, or MCP servers, whether professional, research, capture the flag, or bug bounty.
  • Experience with agent harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, or OpenClaw is strongly preferred.
  • Development experience in Python, TypeScript, or Go.
  • Additional certifications such as OSWE, OSEP, CRTO, GPEN, or GXPN.
  • Social engineering or physical security testing experience.

What we do not require

You do not need prior professional AI red teaming experience. Almost nobody has it yet, and we are not going to pretend otherwise.

If you are a strong network tester who has been taking language models and agent frameworks apart on your own time, you are exactly the person we want to talk to. We would rather teach a great operator the AI material than teach an AI enthusiast how to run a penetration test.

Language Requirements

The primary language of ProCircular is English. Excellent communication skills are required, defined as the ability to:

  • Actively listen for total comprehension.
  • Ask questions that enhance the understanding of a certain topic.
  • Relay information and/or instruction in a descriptive and understandable fashion in both written and verbal format.

Reasoning Ability Requirements

High-functioning reasoning abilities are necessary to meet deadlines, prioritize company and customer needs, and work in a collaborative team environment.

Physical Requirements

Occasional lifting up to 40 lbs. may be necessary from time to time. Must be able to sit for long periods of time, view a computer monitor, and type frequently/constantly (up to 8 hours a day).

Travel Requirements

A valid driver's license is required for occasional travel (under 10%).

Schedule Expectations

Our normal hours of operation are from Monday through Friday, from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm. Central Time.

Full-Time: Full-Time employees are defined legally as working at least 30 hours per week. However, full-time positions at ProCircular require at least 40 hours. This position requires 40 hours worked within a regular workweek. Occasionally, time over 40 hours may be necessary to meet the requirements of the position. If performance expectations are met, employees may flex his or her schedule, subject to preapproval of one's direct supervisor. Candidates must be located in the United States and legally authorized to work without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future. ProCircular is unable to provide employment sponsorship for this role.

Supervision Requirements

This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.

Performance Expectations

All teammates are evaluated at least annually on their performance based on the essential job functions in this job description, along with ProCircular's Core Values:

It's about people
People define every part of our business. Growth potential is based on the abilities and personalities of the people involved. Technology solutions are a part of the equation, but it's the people in an organization that define its true security. We work hardest when we're supporting one another. We take care of each other; we take care of our families, and in doing so we take better care of our customers.

Fear is the mind killer
We don't let fear define the need for our services and we don't present a problem without discussing realistic response or mitigation options. There's more than enough to worry about in life and plenty of people telling us to be afraid. We're solutions people, not fear mongers.

Strong opinions lightly held
Opinions are important - they coalesce facts, reason, experience, and judgment into actionable points of view. We present our opinions with logic and reason rather than emotions, offering several alternatives to each challenge and the supporting data. The rejection of an idea is not a rejection of the individual or their merit. Everyone has a voice and a chance to speak, regardless of title, station or seniority.

Quality over speed, speed over cost
Every organization must consciously balance quality, speed, and cost. We will always put the quality of our work first. We make great efforts to move quickly, but never at the expense of quality. While we strive to keep our services affordable, we never choose an inexpensive alternative that will adversely impact quality or speed.

Cool heads, warm hearts
We keep a cool head and help others do the same, especially in a crisis. We approach adversity with patience, logic, and understanding. Mistakes happen; we don't hide, ignore, condemn, or fear them. Mistakes are opportunities to exemplify honesty, accountability, professionalism, tolerance, and grace. Instead of pointing a finger, we use humor, empathy, and fun when it matters most.

R-E-S-P-E-C-T
We treat each other how we hope to be treated. We don't yell; we aren't condescending, and we always try to understand the other person's perspective, before reacting to it. We keep it light and we listen. We extend this principle to our customers, and we understand that talking down to them is the easiest way to send them to a competitor.

Tomorrow just happened
Life is what happens when we're busy making other plans. We work hard on today but we're always thinking about the future. We take extra time to make sure we're learning and looking ahead. No matter what your discipline or area of expertise, you're adding your capabilities to the long-term plan for the organization and its clients.

What success looks like in year 1:

  • You use data to find insights before anyone has to ask for them.

The Senior Power Conversion Engineer is responsible for the performance, reliability, and lifecycle management of power conversion systems across the operating fleet, including inverters, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and related AC equipment.

This role serves as the technical owner of power conversion system performance—bridging field execution, engineering analysis, and vendor engagement. The position informs equipment selection and design standards for new projects while driving resolution of both systemic and site-specific issues.

· Own the performance and availability of inverter and BESS systems across the fleet.

· Drive the resolution of major failures, sustained underperformance, and serial defects.

· Provide technical oversight of vendor performance, ensuring equipment issues are properly diagnosed, addressed, and resolved.

· Develop and implement strategies for managing power conversion systems across their lifecycle, including spare parts planning, repowering analyses, and monitoring capabilities.

· Review and validate inverter and BESS firmware, controls logic, and operating parameters to ensure proper system performance and grid compliance.

· Support analysis of inverter and BESS interactions with plant-level controls and grid events to improve system response and stability.

· Identify and evaluate key failure modes and develop mitigation strategies to reduce recurrence and fleet-wide risk.

· Support long-term planning for major component replacements and fleet upgrades.

· Drive reliability improvements through PM optimization, failure trend analysis, and standardization of best practices.

· Support development of condition-based maintenance approaches.

· Provide operational insight to Delivery teams to inform equipment selection and specifications.

Skills

· Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.

jobs.description:
Senior Accountant, US (Full time – Remote)

The senior accountant is a key member of IEEFA's US-based Finance team, responsible for day-to-day accounting operations including accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll support, and financial reporting. This role ensures the accuracy and integrity of financial records across the organization's accounting systems and supports consolidated reporting across IEEFA's global entities. The senior accountant reports to the Finance Manager and works closely with the CFO and Finance Team to maintain consistent financial operations.

This is a remote position, based anywhere in the United States with opportunities to travel for in-person meetings and events. This position collaborates with international colleagues and IEEFA produces consolidated financials with its subsidiary, IEEFA Australia Ltd.

IEEFA is an NGO/not-for-profit that research and analyses financial and economic issues related to energy markets, trends, and policies. Headquartered in the United States, IEEFA has a team of 90+ analysts and communications personnel located in 16 countries across the globe. IEEFA produces a significant volume of original research and ongoing analysis and reports on issues affecting energy industries. Our major research reports, daily analysis, press coverage, and other resources can be found on our website: .

Roles and Responsibilities

Accounts Receivable

  • Maintain and ensure accuracy of accounts receivable and grants receivable aging reports.
  • Review grant agreements to determine proper revenue recognition and appropriately record and code all revenue in the accounting system.
  • Create grant and program codes in the accounting system for new grants/programs, ensure codes are properly maintained in the purchase card and accounts payable systems, and close out grant and project codes as needed.

Accounts Payable

  • Maintain the accounts payable system and ensure it properly syncs with the accounting system. Troubleshoot sync issues as needed. Manage bank feed processing in the accounting system.
  • Review and support the AP Administrator's management of bank feed processing into the accounting system
  • Serve as backup to process incoming vendor bills in the accounts payable system, ensuring proper coding, obtaining proper approvals, and verifying all invoices.
  • Review and support the AP Administrator's management W-8/W-9 updates and file maintenance, and support year-end 1099 preparation, review, and submission.
  • Pay all approved vendor bills via the accounts payable system, ACH, wire transfer, or bank’s foreign currency payment system.
  • Assist in maintaining positive pay and ACH control systems.
  • Maintain and ensure accuracy of the accounts payable aging report.
  • Ensure expenses incurred by CEO are reviewed by the Treasurer on a quarterly basis.
  • Send monthly reports to the CFO on all payments processed through organization’s accounts payable system.

Payroll

  • Verify W-2s and W-3s prior to filing by the payroll provider.
  • Enter payroll transactions into the accounting system, including related labor, functional expense, and grant allocations.
  • Perform quarterly 941 payroll reconciliations.

General Ledger, Financial Statements & Support Schedules

  • Maintain the accuracy of the general ledger by generating monthly reports to review transactions for consistent coding and reclassing improperly coded transactions as needed.
  • Review closed grants as part of the month-end close process to ensure integrity of the grant accounting module in the accounting system.
  • Review IEEFA Australia’s accounting system for accurate reporting and consolidation of monthly revenues and expenses.
  • Track the organization's net assets with and without donor restrictions.
  • Generate monthly support schedules and reconcile applicable asset and liability accounts. Maintain deferred revenue and conditional review schedules and record revenue when required. Value contract deliverables and release from restrictions when earned.
  • Generate monthly and year-end financial reports, including consolidated year-end financial statements, and provide them to the CFO and Finance Manager for review.
  • Participate in meetings with the CFO and Finance Manager as needed to review the organization's financial performance and reports.

Additional Finance & Accounting Support

  • Perform monthly bank and purchase card reconciliations and close the fiscal period in the accounting system.
  • Serve as backup to manage uploads of IEEFA Australian and Employer of Record (EOR) transactions, and monthly functional allocations into the accounting system.
  • Handle all currency exchange and valuation issues within the accounting system, financial statements, and support schedules.
  • Review Form 990 and state returns for accuracy prior to filing. File certain state returns on behalf of the organization.
  • Enter annual operating budgets, program budgets, and IEEFA Australia budgets into the accounting system.
  • Provide support during the annual audit process.
  • Participate in departmental and administrative meetings.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in nonprofit accounting or finance operations including multi-currency accounting.
  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or business, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Proficiency with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting software.
  • Experience with accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payroll functions.
  • Familiarity with grant-funded organizations, grant accounting, and revenue recognition for restricted and unrestricted funds.
  • Experience with financial statement preparation and month-end/year-end close processes.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Effective communicator who can work across teams, time zones, and cultures.
  • Flexible, team-oriented approach with willingness to work as part of a diverse global workforce.
  • Highly organized; able to check work products for accuracy, set priorities, and meet objectives and deadlines with limited direction while working remotely.
  • Commitment to IEEFA's mission to accelerate the transition to a diverse, sustainable and profitable energy economy.
  • Authorization to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Global and/or multi-entity finance experience, including preparation of consolidated financials.
  • Experience with bill payment platforms (e.g., Bill.com), expense management tools (e.g., Dext), Xero and/or foreign exchange platforms (e.g., CBForex).
  • Experience with Form 990 preparation and review.
  • Experience working with external auditors.
  • Experience with consolidated financial reporting across international entities.

Compensation and Benefits

Full-time employment with a salary range of $84,228 - USD 101,652 USD. Our competitive benefits package includes paid time off, sick leave, paid parental leave, a Professional Development Allowance, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), a home office set-up stipend, a co-working space stipend, a monthly mobile phone allowance, technology equipment provided, and a 401(k)-retirement plan.

Work Schedule

Full-time, 40 hours/week. Due to required collaboration with international colleagues and IEEFA's global subsidiaries, the schedule may include occasional early morning or evening hours. Time off will be provided elsewhere in the schedule to compensate.

Travel

The senior accountant will work remotely and may be based anywhere in the United States. Some travel is required. Attendance is required at team retreats two to four times a year, some domestic and some international.

Physical Demand and Work Environment.

Must be able to work for prolonged periods at a computer. Computer work can involve repetitive motion, eyestrain, back, and neck strain.

EOE Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at IEEFA. All members of under-represented groups are especially encouraged to apply. We are committed to providing all team members with a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy/parental status or disability status.

jobs.description:
Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards.
Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).

Jeeves has grown fast, and our core product — cards, cross-border payments, and spend management — now serves thousands of businesses across three continents. That growth has outpaced the consistency and craft of our core user experience. We’re hiring a Senior Product Designer to change that: to raise the bar on quality, coherence, and usability across the flows our customers touch every day.

You’ll own design for our core product surfaces end to end — from discovery and research through shipped, measured outcomes — working directly with product leadership, PMs, and engineers. You’ll be the voice of the customer in a payments platform with real complexity: multiple currencies, multiple countries, and finance teams who depend on us to get it right. Our Design team’s mission is to provide a voice of empathy and develop the most engaging user experiences within the Jeeves product, and this role is at the center of that mission.

This is a hands-on senior IC role, not a management position. You’ll operate with high autonomy inside a globally distributed team — we’re looking for someone who moves work forward independently, not someone who needs a design manager to set direction. Jeeves is an AI-forward company, and we expect our designers to work that way too: using AI tools daily to explore more directions, prototype earlier, and synthesize research faster — and helping define what AI-assisted design looks like at Jeeves.

Location: This role is a full-time remote position.

What You’ll Do:

  • Product Design

    • Design across the full Jeeves platform, from mobile to desktop, with a focus on our core card, payments, and spend management flows

    • Own projects end to end: framing the problem, exploring solutions, shipping with engineering, and measuring outcomes

    • Elevate the craft and consistency of the core product experience — identify UX debt and drive a plan to pay it down

    • Promote the product vision through design exploration, documentation, and presentations to leadership

    • Use AI tools throughout your workflow — generative exploration, AI prototyping, and LLM-assisted copy and documentation — to test more directions faster without sacrificing craft

    • Apply payments and fintech domain expertise to design for real-world financial complexity, including AI-powered product experiences within Jeeves (intelligent expense review, automation, insights)

      • Design Systems

      • Use and extend Jeeves’s existing design system and standards

      • Identify gaps and inconsistencies across product surfaces — using AI tooling to audit at scale — and drive systematic fixes

      • Establish design principles and patterns that other designers and engineers can build on, including patterns for AI-driven features (confidence, explainability, human review)

        • Research & Validation

        • Plan and run your own research — including personally recruiting participants when needed

        • Use AI to accelerate research synthesis and analysis — while keeping human judgment on what customers actually need

        • Validate design decisions with customers before and after shipping

        • Advocate the customer perspective across Jeeves, grounded in evidence

          • Cross-Functional Collaboration

          • Partner daily with product managers, engineers, UX researchers, and product marketers

          • Create and collaborate on the product vision with core product leadership, reporting directly into it

          • Influence design practices and team operations within a distributed, global team — including how the design team adopts AI in its workflows

          • Participate in cross-functional interviews and help raise the design bar in hiring

Minimum Requirements:

    • 5+ years of professional product design experience, with senior-level scope on multiple high-impact projects you were directly responsible for

    • Experience designing for fintech, payments, or financial services products

    • A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership: problem framing, exploration, shipped outcomes — not just final screens

    • Demonstrated ability to drive projects forward independently in ambiguous environments, without heavy direction

    • Working fluency with AI tools in your design process — demonstrated by how you actually use them today for exploration, prototyping, research synthesis, or documentation (be ready to show this, not just name tools)

    • Experience working within and improving design systems at scale

    • Hands-on research experience, including recruiting your own participants and synthesizing findings into design decisions

    • Track record of close collaboration with PM and Engineering through to shipped product

    • Professional working proficiency in English

Preferred Qualifications:

    • Deep knowledge of the payments ecosystem — networks, issuers, partners, and how platforms like Jeeves differentiate within it

    • Experience designing for B2B or finance-team users (controllers, CFOs, ops teams)

    • Experience designing AI-powered product experiences — copilots, agents, or intelligent automation — especially patterns for trust, explainability, and human oversight in financial products

    • Experience working in a globally distributed product organization across time zones

    • Experience mentoring other designers or shaping design team practices

    • Native or professional English and Portuguese, Spanish preferred

jobs.description:
About Mactores

Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most enterprise modernization stalls at pilots and handoffs; ours ships, production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, Aedeon Inc. Aedeon absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, mapping, validation, test generation, while forward-deployed engineers own architecture, judgment, and cutover. Mactores is Aedeon's flagship deployment partner: field delivery informs the platform roadmap, and the platform shapes how we deliver.

About Aedeon

Aedeon is the agent platform for enterprise modernization, built by Aedeon Inc., a separate product company founded by the same team that founded Mactores. Aedeon turns the systems already running a business applications, databases, data platforms, business rules, workflows into governed AI agents, grounded in a persistent Code Intelligence Graph of the customer's own code and verified through behavior-equivalence proof. Aedeon is delivered as a product, not a services engagement, and runs without mandatory forward-deployed engineers.

Role at a glance
You'll join the team building Aedeon. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role, not a management or lead position, for someone who wants to stay close to the code and the infrastructure. You'll work across our Python services and the Kubernetes infrastructure they run on, and you'll take real ownership of how Aedeon ships: release calendar, deployment coordination, and being there when production needs you.

What you'll do?

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services in Python (FastAPI) powering Aedeon.
  • Design and expose clean, well-documented REST APIs for frontend consumption.
  • Own the release cycle end-to-end, release calendar, versioning, and coordinating deployments across staging and production.
  • Manage and evolve Kubernetes deployments, including writing and maintaining Helm charts.
  • Understand CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, even without having built a lot of them.
  • Work with AWS infrastructure supporting Aedeon's services.
  • Monitor production health via CloudWatch and take part in on-call/incident response when things break.
  • Work with PostgreSQL, including query optimization.
  • Build and maintain durable workflows using Temporal for long-running or fault-tolerant processes.
  • Collaborate closely with frontend engineers on API design and contracts, you won't own frontend code, but you'll understand how it consumes your services.

What we're looking for?

  • 4 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong Python skills, ideally with FastAPI (Django/Flask experience also considered).
  • Solid, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes deployments, services, config, debugging, and performance & cost improvements.
  • Experience writing and maintaining Helm charts.
  • Working knowledge of AWS services.
  • Comfortable designing REST APIs with frontend consumers in mind.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL.
  • A genuine ownership mindset, comfortable being accountable for a release going out clean and on time.
  • Docker and general containerization fundamentals.
  • Strong collaborator, comfortable working closely with the frontend team to align on API contracts and integration needs.
  • Working knowledge of RabbitMQ (or similar message queuing systems).
  • Experience with Temporal (temporal.io) or a similar durable workflow orchestration engine, you'll be defining and running long-running, fault-tolerant workflows, not just calling APIs directly.

You'll be preferred if you

  • Have experience with CloudWatch or similar observability/monitoring tools
  • Have exposure to Terraform or other infra-as-code tools
  • Have experience with additional message queues (e.g., SQS, Kafka)
  • Have experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions a plus)

Life at Mactores

We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference in the lives of every Mactorian. Our 10 Core Leadership Principles that honor Decision-making, Leadership, Collaboration, and Curiosity drive how we work.
1. Be one step ahead
2. Deliver the best
3. Be bold
4. Pay attention to the detail
5. Enjoy the challenge
6. Be curious and take action
7. Take leadership
8. Own it
9. Deliver value
10. Be collaborative

We're hiring an ML Engineer II to help expand and scale our Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence capabilities. In this role, you will work on core AI initiatives across multiple business units, execute against established engineering standards for production AI systems, and help build and harden our AI Agents for Healthcare.


As an ML Engineer II, you should love building simple solutions to solve hard customer problems, crafting reliable code in an agile environment, and taking ownership of software quality from end to end. You will work within our existing Java and Spring-based platform, adding and modernizing enterprise application features with advanced AI capabilities while growing your software engineering expertise alongside senior team members.


What You'll Do

  • Build, test, and deploy production-ready AI agents and agentic workflows that integrate seamlessly with enterprise applications and business processes.
  • Implement robust evaluation, monitoring, guardrail, and safety frameworks defined by senior team members to de-risk LLM-powered applications.
  • Develop and maintain AI-enabled features within our existing Java/Spring platform and distributed microservices ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with AI Scientists and ML Engineers to productionize models and translate experimentation into reliable software.
  • Staying up to date with emerging AI technologies and recommending pragmatic adoption strategies that improve product capabilities and developer productivity.
  • Work closely with, and incorporate feedback from other specialists, tech-ops, and product managers
  • Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, and requirement planning to continuously grow technical skills and domain knowledge.
  • Attend daily stand-up meetings, collaborate with your peers, prioritize features, and work with a sense of urgency to deliver value to your customers
  • Finding quick ways to prototype and test possible solutions to large problems

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2–5 years of hands-on experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, with a proven track record of designing, building, and optimizing ML models using frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow for production environments.
  • Solid Computer Science fundamentals in data structures, algorithm design, complexity analysis, and performance optimization.
  • Strong proficiency in object-oriented design and development using modern programming languages such as Python, Java, or C#.
  • Hands-on experience developing, testing, and supporting applied machine learning services within enterprise software ecosystems.
  • Practical experience building and maintaining software components for AI-enabled applications or distributed systems.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI capabilities into existing enterprise applications rather than building standalone AI prototypes.
  • Experience implementing and deploying production-grade LLM applications using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Spring AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or similar technologies.
  • Solid working knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool calling, prompt engineering, and core AI agent principles.
  • Experience in observability, CI/CD, automated testing, and production operations for AI applications.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Databricks, vector search technologies, embedding models, conversational AI, and evaluation strategies for AI agents.
  • Experience working with AI developer tooling and platform capabilities that accelerate feature delivery.
  • Experience building large-scale Java microservices using Spring Boot.
  • Experience with cloud-native platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), Kubernetes, and containerized deployments.

Job Title: Technical Support & Solutions Engineer, Mobile Security (LATAM)

Location: LATAM (Remote) (Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Peru or Brazil)

Type of Contract: Full-Time | Employed

Salary Range: Market Rates

Language Requirements: Fluent English and Spanish; Portuguese is a plus

Our client is seeking a bilingual Technical Support & Solutions Engineer with experience supporting mobile SDK integrations and customer-facing technical issues to join their growing team. You will play a key role in diagnosing L1/L2 technical issues, supporting mobile integrations, and assisting with technical demos and proof-of-concept projects. Your work will directly impact customer satisfaction, successful product integrations, and sales opportunities across LATAM and the US.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own first response and resolution for L1/L2 customer support tickets through Zendesk and Jira, handling approximately 5–10 issues per day as the customer base grows.
  • Analyze device and remote logs, crash reports, ANR traces, and stack traces to identify likely root causes and reproduce customer-reported issues.
  • Build and run sample iOS and Android applications using Xcode and Android Studio to validate integrations and reproduce reported issues across native and hybrid environments.
  • Troubleshoot mobile SDK security-related issues involving encryption, certificate pinning, obfuscation, and jailbreak/root detection without modifying the underlying product implementation.
  • Gather and organize diagnostic information for Engineering teams in South Korea and India, escalate confirmed defects, and prepare root cause analysis documentation.
  • Deliver technical product demonstrations, build proof-of-concept integrations, and support customers through their initial successful integration.
  • Partner with the sales team on technical questions, customer presentations, POCs, RFP technical responses, and opportunities across LATAM and the US.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Fluent written and verbal English and Spanish, with the ability to support Spanish-speaking LATAM markets and collaborate with English-speaking teams.
  • Experience in a technical customer support role, preferably with defined SLA and response-time expectations.
  • Comfortable building and running simple iOS and Android applications on physical devices using Xcode and Android Studio.
  • Working familiarity with native and hybrid mobile architectures, including Flutter and React Native.
  • Ability to read and interpret crash logs, ANR traces, and stack traces from device and remote sources.
  • General understanding of mobile application security concepts, including encryption, certificate pinning, obfuscation, and jailbreak/root detection.
  • Experience with technical support and ticketing platforms such as Zendesk and Jira, combined with strong customer-facing presentation and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Portuguese proficiency.
  • Experience with crash reporting or monitoring tools such as Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry, Bugsnag, or Datadog.
  • Exposure to DRM, content protection, or mobile application security SDKs.
  • Experience supporting sales teams through technical pre-sales activities, including demos, POCs, and RFP technical responses.
  • Experience collaborating with distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones.

Success in the Role

  • Within the first 90 days, independently deliver product demos, support at least one customer through a POC, build and run sample iOS and Android applications, and effectively collaborate with Engineering teams across South Korea and India.
  • Within six months, actively support LATAM and US sales opportunities through successful demos, POCs, and technical product support while responding to customer tickets within SLA during LATAM business hours.

jobs.description:
AskBio Inc., a wholly owned and independently operated subsidiary of Bayer AG, is a fully integrated gene therapy company dedicated to developing life-saving medicines and changing lives. The company maintains a portfolio of clinical programs across a range of neuromuscular, central nervous system, cardiovascular, and metabolic disease indications with a clinical-stage pipeline that includes investigational therapeutics for congestive heart failure, limb-girdle muscular dystrophy, multiple system atrophy, Parkinson’s disease, and Pompe disease. AskBio’s gene therapy platform includes Pro10™, an industry-leading proprietary cell line manufacturing process, and an extensive array of capsids and promoters. With global headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, and European headquarters in Edinburgh, Scotland, the company has generated hundreds of proprietary capsids and promoters, several of which have entered pre-clinical and clinical testing.

Our vision: Pioneering science to create transformative molecular medicines.

Our mission: Lead innovative science and drive clinical outcomes to transform people's lives.

Our principles:

  • Advance innovative science by pushing boundaries.

  • Bring transformative therapeutics to patients in need.

  • Provide an environment for employees to reach their fullest potential.

Our values:

  • Be a Pioneer. We are not afraid of the impossible and to innovate to make gene therapies accessible to those in need.

  • Cultivate Collaboration. Strive to be the best teammate, actively listen, openly communicate, and embrace diverse points of view.

  • Embrace Responsibility. We are humbled by the enormity of our mission. We hold a relentless commitment to advance science and clinical outcomes for our patients, families, and caregivers.

  • Raise the Bar. Continuously drive improvements and efficiencies. Seek and provide constructive feedback. Have a bias for learning and action.

  • Act with Uncompromising Integrity. Be honest, transparent, and committed to doing what’s right in every situation. Make clear commitments and follow through.

Position Summary

The Medical Director, Movement Disorders Specialist, GDNF Program will provide strategic and hands-on clinical leadership for gene therapy programs targeting CNS movement disorders across Phase 1–3 development. This role has study-level accountability for clinical strategy, benefit–risk assessment, and execution, and serves as a medical leader within the organization. The Movement Disorders Specialist Medical Director will guide cross-functional teams, support regulatory interactions, and ensure inspection-ready, high-quality clinical development from first-in-human studies through registrational trials and long-term follow-up.

Job Responsibilities

  • Drive the overall clinical development strategy in alignment with function, program team and timelines for the GDNF gene therapy program across Phase 1–3 with specific focus on movement disorders

  • Serve as a Parkinson’s clinical expert in state-of-the-art, randomized, double-blind clinical trials with emphasis on maintenance of the blinding status of the trial

  • Serve as the medical lead for clinical trial design, protocol development, and endpoint strategy for movement disorders indications

  • Provide medical oversight for clinical trials, ensuring patient safety, data integrity, and regulatory compliance

  • Lead clinical risk–benefit assessments, including safety signal evaluation, dose escalation decisions, and go/no-go recommendations

  • Authoring support for regulatory interactions, including FDA meetings, briefing documents, and inspection readiness activities

  • Oversee long-term follow-up (LTFU) strategies required for gene therapy products, including delayed safety monitoring and post-treatment commitments

  • Guide and mentor Medical Directors and other clinical team members; contribute to clinical capability building

  • Partner with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory, and CMC to ensure integrated program execution

  • Present clinical strategy and data to senior leadership, governance committees, and external stakeholders

  • Ensure a culture of inspection readiness, quality, and continuous improvement across the clinical organization

  • Support the strategic vision for clinical development for the GDNF program and contribute to broader organizational clinical strategy as appropriate

  • Foster and maintain strong relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), investigators, and external scientific and clinical stakeholders

  • Oversee the integration of clinical development activities with cross-functional partners, including Regulatory, CMC/Manufacturing, Commercial, and Research, to ensure seamless program advancement

  • Represent the organization as a clinical and scientific leader in high-level industry forums, scientific meetings, advisory boards, and conferences

Minimum Requirements

  • MD from an accredited U.S. medical school or equivalent international medical degree with 6+ years relevant clinical experience with Movement Disorders patients

  • Completion of clinical training with board certification or eligibility in Neurology or a closely related specialty with movement disorders specialization and clinical experience

  • Minimum of two years of industry experience or related experience in clinical development within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or CRO/CDMO environment

  • Demonstrated leadership in the design and execution of clinical trials across multiple phases, including oversight of clinical monitoring activities

  • Proven experience supporting FDA or global health authority inspections, audits, or formal inspection readiness initiatives

  • Working knowledge of GCP, regulatory requirements, and trial quality management systems

  • Ability to independently lead clinical programs and make program-level medical decisions in a regulated development environment

  • Strong strategic leadership and cross-functional influence.

  • Ability to support FDA inspection readiness activities, including review of critical trial documentation, monitoring outputs, and CAPAs

  • Expertise in risk-based monitoring and clinical trial quality oversight

  • Strong analytical judgment applied to complex clinical and safety issues

  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving biotech environment

  • Proven track record of successful clinical program leadership, including advancing programs through critical development milestones

  • Exceptional strategic and operational planning skills, with the ability to translate long-term vision into executable clinical plans

  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence, inspire, and align cross-functional teams

  • Established professional network within the gene therapy and/or CNS development community

  • Understanding of market dynamics, competitive landscape, and evolving trends relevant to gene therapy and movement disorders

Preferred Education, Experience and Skills

  • Prior experience in CNS, neurology, or movement disorders clinical development

  • Experience leading or significantly contributing to Phase 1+2 and Phase 3 registrational trials for Parkinson’s disease or similar disorders

  • Experience in gene therapy, cell therapy, or advanced therapeutic modalities, including long-term safety considerations

  • Direct experience overseeing long-term follow-up (LTFU) studies for gene therapy products

  • Experience working in rare disease or small patient population settings

  • Experience mentoring Medical Directors & clinical staff with non-neurology background

Accountant – Accounts Receivable, QuickBooks & Financial Operations

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Accountant to manage accounts receivable, invoicing, payment tracking, cash flow reporting, and day-to-day financial operations.

This is a hands-on accounting role with a strong focus on Accounts Receivable (AR), QuickBooks, invoicing, collections, financial reporting, and process improvement.

You’ll be responsible for keeping financial records accurate, ensuring invoices and payments stay on track, providing leadership with clear cash flow visibility, and improving accounting workflows through better systems and automation.

This is ideal for someone who enjoys both accounting execution and improving how financial operations work.

What You’ll Own

Accounts Receivable & Invoicing

  • Prepare and issue accurate, timely client invoices
  • Manage accounts receivable and payment follow-ups
  • Monitor AR aging reports, outstanding balances, payment statuses, and collections
  • Confirm incoming payments and maintain accurate transaction records
  • Proactively follow up on overdue invoices
  • Resolve payment discrepancies and maintain organized supporting documentation
  • Help maintain healthy cash flow through consistent AR management

QuickBooks & Accounting Operations

  • Maintain accurate financial records in QuickBooks
  • Record and organize day-to-day financial transactions
  • Support account reconciliations and financial reporting
  • Ensure consistency between invoices, payments, accounting records, and financial trackers
  • Support migration from legacy or manual accounting systems when required
  • Maintain clean and organized accounting workflows

Cash Flow & Payment Tracking

  • Monitor cash flow activity and payment schedules
  • Track incoming and outgoing financial transactions
  • Maintain accurate payment and cash flow trackers
  • Support banking and treasury-related activities
  • Provide leadership with visibility into:
    • Cash position
    • Outstanding receivables
    • Payment priorities
    • Collections
    • Operational finance activity

Financial Reporting & Documentation

  • Prepare financial summaries and operational reports
  • Maintain accurate and organized accounting documentation
  • Keep financial records clean and audit-ready
  • Support reporting and reconciliation processes
  • Ensure financial data remains accurate across accounting systems and internal trackers
  • Provide timely financial information to leadership

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify repetitive or inefficient accounting processes
  • Recommend and implement improvements to financial workflows
  • Use automation and AI-assisted tools to reduce manual work
  • Streamline invoicing, payment tracking, reporting, and reconciliation workflows
  • Improve accounting SOPs and documentation
