jobs.description:
Description

Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.

Our focus on data science, machine learning, and generative AI helps tech-forward companies level up their employees' skills and drive innovation.

We are looking for an Application Security Engineer to own product security end to end — from threat modelling and secure design reviews to vulnerability management and security controls embedded into CI/CD.

You will work closely with product and platform teams to make security part of the engineering process, building secure defaults and helping prevent vulnerabilities from reaching production without slowing development down.

What you will do

  • Own application and product security end to end, from design reviews and threat modelling to vulnerability remediation and follow-up.
  • Partner with product and platform teams to embed security into the development lifecycle rather than treat it as a final review step.
  • Build and improve security controls in CI/CD, including SAST, dependency, secrets, container, and IaC scanning.
  • Review application designs and code where security risk is meaningful, and turn recurring findings into secure defaults, shared libraries, lint rules, and CI gates.
  • Drive vulnerability management across application code and cloud posture, including triage, risk-based prioritisation, remediation timelines, and external pentest findings.
  • Strengthen security in multitenant B2B systems, including tenant isolation, authentication, authorization, RBAC / ABAC, and access controls.
  • Work on cloud and Kubernetes security across AWS environments, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
  • Help translate GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 requirements into practical engineering controls and system properties.
  • Develop and support a security champions programme to help engineering teams adopt secure practices in their day-to-day work.
  • Address security risks specific to AI and LLM-powered features, including prompt injection, data leakage, and untrusted model output.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of engineering experience, including at least 2 years focused on Application Security or Product Security.
  • Strong software engineering background with the ability to read, review, and write production code; Python experience is highly preferred.
  • Deep practical knowledge of web application security, including OWASP Top 10, ASVS, authentication and session management, OAuth2 / OIDC / SAML, and authorization issues such as IDOR and broken access control.
  • Experience securing multitenant or B2B SaaS products, including tenant isolation, RBAC / ABAC, and access control models.
  • Hands-on experience embedding security into CI/CD, including SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container scanning, and IaC scanning.
  • Strong experience with threat modelling, secure design reviews, and secure code reviews in collaboration with product and engineering teams.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities based on risk, criticality, and exploitability, including remediation prioritisation and escalation when needed.
  • Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes security, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security risks clearly to engineers, product managers, and auditors.
  • Fluent Russian and English at B2 level or above.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building a DevSecOps practice from scratch.
  • Experience running or participating in a Security Champions programme.
  • Hands-on penetration testing experience.
  • Experience securing LLM-powered or AI products.
  • Experience with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 from an engineering perspective.
  • Knowledge of software supply chain security, including SBOMs, SLSA, image signing, or similar practices.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 4000-6000 EUR Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Site Safety and Health Officer IV
Location: Remote with travel to project sites

Description/Job Summary

POSITION DESCRIPTION

Are you ready to take on a new job that provides a perfect platform to grow yourself and your career? HydroGeoLogic, Inc. (HGL) has a position open for a Senior Site Safety and Health Officer to support HGL’s ongoing projects across the United States. As a Senior Site Safety and Health Officer IV, you will work with our high performing HGL Team and be responsible for being onsite during field activities and will require responsibility for overall project safety performance. HGL is flexible regarding the actual physical location of a candidate. Projects may include in situ thermal treatment, remediation, demolition, waste cleanup, landfill cap construction, contaminated sediment removals, and groundwater treatment (both in-situ and pump-n-treat) and stabilization projects.

Responsibilities/Duties

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

The Safety and Health Officer IV responsibilities include:

  • Developing and reviewing project planning documents pertaining to health and safety (APPs, AHAs, HASPs, etc.) to ensure safe project execution by the field team.
  • Serving as the primary health and safety compliance point of contact with field teams consisting of HGL staff, subcontractors, and client personnel.
  • Providing on-site daily safety and health briefings to HGL and subcontractor personnel.
  • Generating and maintaining accurate and detailed health and safety documentation, including daily health and safety reports, inspection logs, non-conformance/deficiency logs, and required corrective actions.
  • Updating AHAs as work progresses and communicating those updates with the project team.
  • Communicating with HGL’s construction and health and safety management teams to ensure compliance with project-specific and corporate procedures.
  • Implementing and enforcing on-site emergency response procedures.
  • Maintaining all required on-site health and safety documentation, including personnel certifications, sign-in/orientation sheets, required OSHA signage, planning documents, and safety data sheets.
  • Leading internal and client-facing meetings pertaining to planned and completed health and safety activities.

Minimum Requirements

WHAT YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

The ideal candidate will need the following as a foundation for success in this role:

  • The ability to travel at least 70% of the time to support projects ranging in duration from approximately 1 month to 1 year.
  • Minimum of 6 years’ experience serving as health and safety officer at construction projects, with minimum 3 years’ experience on projects involving environmental contamination.
  • Proficient knowledge of USACE Safety and Health Requirements Manual EM 385-1-1.
  • Able to meet class I SSHO Qualifications under USACE Safety and Health Requirements Manual EM 385-1-1.
  • Experience with health and safety procedures related to: air quality, hazardous waste, universal waste, investigation derived waste, wastewater, stormwater, spill prevention, decontamination, and health and safety inspections.
  • Experience working on environmental construction/remediation projects involving demolition, excavation, grading, and environmental sampling.
  • Working knowledge of Federal (OSHA) and state occupational and health and safety regulations.
  • Experience performing project safety audits.
  • Excellent communication, writing, and organization skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced group setting with corporate, project, and technical management staff.
  • Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite of software, specifically in Excel and Word.
  • 40-hour OSHA HAZWOPER and current 8-hour OSHA HAZWOPER refresher certifications.
  • OSHA 30-hour Construction Safety certification.
  • Current CPR/First Aid training certificate.

Desired Qualifications

WHAT YOU NEED TO STAND OUT – Preferred, not required

  • 8- hour OSHA HAZWOPER Supervisor Training
  • Excavation Competent person certification
  • Fall Protection Competent Person certification
  • Confined Space Supervisor certification
  • Rigging training certification
  • Experience working with USACE and EPA clients

Physical & Environmental Requirements

PHYSICAL & COGNITIVE REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to lift/move/relocate items up to 50 lbs
  • Prolonged sitting up to 70% of the time; Prolonged standing up to 70% of the time
  • Walking long distances; Walking over uneven or mountainous terrain
  • Repetitive hand motions (typing/tool use/etc.)
  • Ability to see details at close range; Ability to see details at a distance; Ability to interpret and analyze visual data (maps/graphs/warning indicators/etc.)
  • Driving a company or personal vehicle
  • Climbing ladders or stairs
  • Complex problem solving and decision making
  • Reading and interpreting technical documents or regulations
  • Writing reports/proposals/or technical documentation
  • Leading a team or coordinating multiple priorities
  • Communicating effectively with clients/team members/and stakeholders
  • Managing competing deadlines and shifting priorities

WORK ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be able to work outdoors in adverse weather conditions (heat/cold/rain/snow/etc.)
  • Must be able to travel up to 70% yearly
  • May work in environments with loud noises/dust/or hazardous materials
  • Must wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE)
  • Remote work environment
  • Potential for longer days up to 12 hours in duration

This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required of the employee. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice.

Details

Work Schedule:This position is primarily field oriented and will range from 8-12 hours daily. HGL remediation projects typically occur 5 to 6 days per week. Projects are long duration and HGL attempts to maintain rotations for work life balance approximately every 4 weeks for a duration of 1 week off. This rotation is a target and not guaranteed.

Office Type: Project site, field work. Office work is minimal.

Travel:A minimum of 70% of each month is onsite.

A favorable pre-hire drug test and physical are required.

All positions are subject to a pre-hire education and driving record verification.

MORE ABOUT HGL AND THE OPPORTUNITY

At HGL, we share a drive and vision to restore natural resources and provide ongoing stewardship of our environment to benefit present and future generations. We believe that we can make a difference in improving the world we live in through collaboration, teamwork, and a positive work environment. This unites and empowers us to strive for excellence in all our endeavors.

HGL - WHO WE ARE

The exceptional quality of our people is key to our strength. We value our employees as individuals and as important members of our team. We offer a work environment that is flexible, inclusive, and dedicated to creating a sustainable future. By cultivating a culture of innovation, we’re able to adapt and augment our services to solve complex environmental and natural resources challenges.

Projects at HGL primarily span the United States and its territories, tackling problems associated with emerging contaminants (like PFAS), radiological contamination, and military munitions, along with chemical contamination in groundwater, surface water, sediments, and soil.

With over 550 employees, HGL is large enough to execute high-profile projects, but small enough to develop personal working environments with our talented team members. By joining HGL, you will be working toward restoring the environment and protecting our future.

HGL - WE INVEST IN YOU

It’s not just a job, it’s your career. HGL provides career growth opportunities via mentoring, training, education, and support for your certifications and licenses. Achieve your career goals and help HGL achieve its mission of restoring the environment to beneficial use for our clients and communities.

jobs.description:
Engagement Details:
  • Employment type: Temporary contract
  • Contract Duration: 6 months
  • Work Schedule: Full-Time, Start ASAP
  • Work Location: USA Remote

Summary:
We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented specialist with deep expertise in OpenText Extended ECM and SAP SuccessFactors. This role involves designing, implementing, and optimizing integrated content management solutions to support HR business processes. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge, consulting experience, and a strategic mindset to align technology with HR operational needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement integrations between OpenText Extended ECM and SAP SuccessFactors, ensuring seamless data and content flow.
  • Configure and customize Extended ECM solutions to support document management, records management, archiving, and HR workflows.
  • Optimize SuccessFactors modules such as Employee Central, Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance & Goals, and Learning by linking them with ECM content.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to map metadata and ensure consistency between HR data and content repositories.
  • Ensure compliance with regulations such as GDPR, HIPAA, and EEOC through robust content retention and security strategies.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues, develop tailored integration solutions, and deliver enhancements based on user feedback.
  • Lead or support implementation projects using SAP Activate, Agile, or similar methodologies.
  • Conduct workshops, gather business requirements, and provide training and support to HR and IT stakeholders.
  • Communicate technical solutions effectively to non-technical audiences, emphasizing HR and business impact.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Human Resources Technology, or a related field.
  • Equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree

Required Technical Skills:
  • OpenText Extended ECM Expertise
    • In-depth knowledge of features such as document and records management, workflows, and content archiving.
    • Experience with Content Server, Business Workspaces, and Archive Center.
    • Ability to configure and customize ECM for HR use cases, especially in SuccessFactors environments.
  • SAP SuccessFactors Knowledge
    • Proficiency with modules including Employee Central, Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance & Goals, and Learning.
    • Familiarity with SuccessFactors data model, APIs (OData, SFAPI), and HR objects.
    • Understanding of UI elements like People Profile and document embedding.
  • Integration Skills
    • Hands-on experience integrating OpenText ECM with SuccessFactors via pre-built connectors or custom APIs.
    • Proficient with SAP Integration Suite, MuleSoft, or Dell Boomi for middleware integration.
    • Skilled in metadata mapping between HR systems and content platforms.
  • Document and Records Management
    • Management of HR-related unstructured content (e.g., resumes, contracts, certifications).
    • Familiarity with compliance frameworks and content lifecycle governance.
  • Programming and Scripting
    • Working knowledge of JavaScript, Python, or Java for ECM customization and API interaction.
    • Experience with OData query language and basic SQL for metadata and content queries.
  • Cloud and Deployment
    • Understanding of cloud, hybrid, and on-premises deployment models for OpenText Extended ECM.
    • Familiarity with SAP BTP services, including SAP Cloud Integration and Document Management.
Domain Knowledge:
  • HR Business Processes
    • Deep understanding of recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and learning workflows.
    • Insight into how integrated content supports and enhances these processes.
  • Business Process Optimization
    • Ability to streamline HR operations by aligning structured data and unstructured content.
    • Experience in automating approvals and reducing manual content handling.
Soft Skills:
  • Strong problem-solving skills to address integration and configuration challenges.
  • Excellent communication skills to work across HR, IT, and business teams.
  • Experience managing projects, including scope, timeline, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Client-facing consulting experience, including requirements gathering, stakeholder engagement, and user training.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Certifications in OpenText Extended ECM or SAP SuccessFactors (e.g., SAP Certified Associate – Employee Central).
  • Familiarity with related tools such as SAP Document Management Service or OpenText Documentum.
  • Experience in change management to support user adoption and organizational transformation.
  • Analytical mindset to monitor system usage, performance, and optimization opportunities.

Benefits

Benefits are not available for this position.

TEHORA est présentement à la recherche d’un(e) conseiller (e) en gestion de projets ayant d’excellentes aptitudes techniques, d’excellentes connaissances et qui souhaite mettre à profit ses compétences au sein d’une équipe polyvalente.

Description des travaux ou des biens livrables :

  • Charte de projet (manuel d’organisation de projet);
  • Convention de mise en œuvre d’un projet;
  • Planification globale et détaillée incluant la structure des équipes et leurs responsabilités respectives;

  • Tableau de bord;
  • Registre des points de suivi et des points en suspens;

  • Registre de suivi des approbations de biens livrables;
  • Tableau des indicateurs de gestion;
  • Bilan de projet;
  • Stratégies de mise en œuvre;
  • Planification globale et détaillée du projet d’envergure incluant la structure des équipes et leurs responsabilités respectives;
  • Registre des demandes de changement;
  • Mécanismes de gestion des risques (évaluations des risques, tableau de bord de suivi des risques, etc.);
  • Documents exécutifs.

Profil

1)Détenir un diplôme universitaire de premier cycle (baccalauréat) dans le domaine des technologies de l’information, en informatique, en administration, en ingénierie ou en mathématiques;
2)Posséder quatre (4) années d’expérience à titre de chargé de projet ou de conseiller en gestion de projets, dans le domaine des technologies de l’information.
3) Posséder deux (2) années d’expérience avec l’outil de planification de projet MS Project.
LIEU DE TRAVAIL
Le lieu de travail sera déterminé selon le mandat, il peut être en télétravail ou chez le client.
POURQUOI SE JOINDRE À TEHORA?
TEHORA est une firme québécoise multidisciplinaire reconnue pour l'excellence de ses services professionnels, de nature technique et de gestion de projets à l'échelle nationale et internationale. Notre mission est d'accompagner nos clients dans la concrétisation de leurs projets par l'excellence de notre savoir-faire et de notre créativité.
Depuis sa création en 2017, notre équipe de professionnels connait une croissance exponentielle en répondant aux besoins importants en gestion de projets multidisciplinaires, dans le domaine des transports, du génie civil, du TI et plus.
Nos collaborateurs travaillent sur des mandats aussi bien à l’interne que chez des clients d’envergures.
TEHORA se distingue par sa culture d’entreprise, axée sur le bonheur de ses employés et la diversité.

Chez TEHORA, chaque collaborateur est un membre important de l'équipe qui contribue à notre succès collectif. Nos membres ont la flexibilité requise pour avoir un équilibre entre le travail et leur vie privée, tout en menant une carrière enrichissante.

Nous offrons un environnement de travail motivant. La diversité des projets, la grande autonomie et l’interaction directe avec les clients sont appréciées. Une telle proximité est possible en raison de notre structure organisationnelle horizontale, qui se traduit par des relations de confiance et une communication efficace entre notre équipe et les clients.

AVANTAGES

  • Du télétravail et de la flexibilité pour s’adapter à vos obligations familiales

jobs.description:
The Semiconductor Key Account Manager III will drive sales growth and market expansion for INFICON products within key End Users and OEM accounts located primarily in Arizona while supporting others in California and Oregon. This role focuses on identifying growth opportunities, building strong customer relationships, and strategically aligning sales efforts with INFICON’s business objectives. By leveraging deep industry expertise, particularly in Semiconductor processes and vacuum physics, the Key Account Manager will position INFICON as a trusted partner in enhancing operational efficiency and quality for OEM clients.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve sales goals and market expansion within assigned accounts.
  • Identify growth opportunities for INFICON’s product portfolio, including software solutions, gauges, ALD coating solutions, and Smart Sensors.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships by addressing the specific needs of semiconductor OEMs.
  • Provide technical guidance and expertise on the application of INFICON products to meet customer requirements.
  • Manage comprehensive account activities, including preparing quotes, negotiating sales contracts, submitting forecasts, and creating key account plans and monthly reports.
  • Provide valuable feedback to Business Units regarding product introduction strategies, market trends, competitive analysis, and application requirements.
  • Support pricing adjustments, product recommendations, and updates to sales policies.
  • Collaborate with the Segment Manager and Strategic Account Director to input annual sales goals and refine strategic objectives for the sales territory.

Marketing and Industry Engagement:

  • Contribute to the development and execution of territory-specific sales and marketing plans.
  • Represent INFICON at trade shows, participate in strategic industry committees, and support marketing campaigns to drive brand visibility and engagement.
  • The ideal candidate will hold a bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics, Materials Science or Chemistry
  • 7-10+ years of account management experience.
  • Extensive technical expertise in semiconductor processes, vacuum physics, and related applications.
  • A proven track record in sales, account management, and business development within the semiconductor industry.
  • An exceptional ability to present technical solutions to diverse audiences.
  • Strong negotiation, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across assigned territories to support customer engagement and drive business success.

The expected salary range for this position is between $105,000 and $150,000 per year plus commission opportunities and additional transportation allowances.In addition, INFICON employees are eligible for a profit sharing bonus with a target of 5%. The actual compensation will be determined based on experience, location, and other factors permitted by law.

INFICON provides a dynamic work environment that promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our employees experience ongoing green initiatives, flexible work hours, and a variety of health and wellness programs.

INFICON’s forward-thinking approach offers countless opportunities to design, support, and manufacture a diverse product portfolio that expands globally. Our Lean and Agile work environment offers competitive compensation, relocation assistance, a discretionary bonus, and generous employee benefits; major medical, dental, health, vision, 401K, vacation and sick time, tuition reimbursement, and more!

INFICON is committed to ensuring that our online application process provides an equal opportunity to all job seekers that apply without regard to race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, gender, age, protected veteran status, disability status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. A notice describing Federal equal employment opportunity laws is available here to reaffirm this commitment. Any contact that would like to request a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application process should contact .

INFICON, Inc. strictly complies with all aspects of the Export Administration Regulations ('EAR'), including those sections dealing with deemed exports to foreign nationals.

INFICON is a leading provider of innovative instrumentation, critical sensor technologies, and Smart Manufacturing/Industry 4.0 software solutions that enhance productivity and quality of tools, processes, and complete factories. These analysis, measurement and control products are essential for gas leak detection in air conditioning/refrigeration and automotive manufacturing. jobs.title: Grants Manager
jobs.excerpt: The Purpose of ZearnZearn is the nonprofit educational organization whose mission is to inspire all kids to love learning math.
jobs.description:
The Purpose of Zearn

Zearn is the nonprofit educational organization whose mission is to inspire all kids to love learning math. Everything we do is driven by our belief that every kid is a math kid.

Our top-rated learning platform is designed to catch kids up and move them forward in grade-level math. And it works. Large-scale efficacy research shows students who use Zearn make significant gains in math proficiency, including the students who start multiple grade levels behind.

As a nonprofit, all of our work is driven by what is best for kids. At the same time, we operate as an intense and fast-moving technology company, inclusively solving hard problems that will impact current and future generations. The problems we solve require expertise in teaching, learning science, software development, design, video production, and countless other disciplines. As an organization that is always stretching to get to the next level of impact, every single person owns mission critical work.

If you’re ready to join our Team of problem solvers, and own work that will drive us to achieve impact at scale, we are looking for you.

Learn more about us at .

The purpose of the Grants Manager at Zearn is to ensure our philanthropic funding against strategic investments are managed with absolute rigor, which includes effective communication back to the philanthropic organizations on how their support is enabling Zearn to achieve its organizational goals and pursue its mission to make all kids math kids.

This role is critical to sustaining Zearn’s growth as we enter a new phase of scale focused on driving Zearn implementation and impact on math achievement. Reporting to the Director of Strategic Projects, you will be the primary engine for grant execution and the lead day to day contact for our program officers. You will manage grant commitments, optimize management processes, and craft compelling donor communications that clearly convey how philanthropic support helps all kids love and learn math.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Manage funder relationships and proactive reporting for strategic grants ensuring Zearn is viewed as a highly organized and trusted partner by our program officers.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for program officers, managing day to day communications and responding to inquiries with professional maturity.
  • Own the reporting lifecycle for a small number of high dollar, multi-year grants, ensuring every deliverable is submitted with high-quality and ahead of schedule.
  • Lead the writing for bimonthly, quarterly, and annual funder reports, translating complex product and implementation data into clear narratives.
  • Anticipate funder questions before they are asked, preparing the Director of Strategic Projects, CEO, and executive leadership team with the data and talking points needed for high-stakes check-ins.
  • Maintain visibility into Zearn's current and prospective strategic grants, helping forecast upcoming reporting, proposal, and funding milestones to support long-term planning and strategic decision-making.
  • Manage the grant application process for new strategic opportunities, coordinating inputs from cross-functional teams to ensure all submissions reflect Zearn’s collective impact.

Operationalize cross functional project management across the grant lifecycle to provide internal teams with the clarity and lead time they need to meet every commitment.

  • Drive transparency and accountability across the grant lifecycle by tracking commitments, identifying risks early, and ensuring internal teams have the lead time necessary to resolve blockers.
  • Establish and manage scalable operating infrastructure to streamline grant coordination and maintain high standards of execution across the organization.
  • Collaborate with Finance to ensure grant spending and budgets are tracked accurately against funder requirements.
  • Develop and maintain a content library of standard narratives and data points to streamline reporting and proposal development.
  • Create and maintain a rigorous grants procedure manual and documentation system to maximize cross-team efficiency and ensure accuracy for compliance requirements.
  • Audit and maintain the fidelity of grant records in the CRM, ensuring that every interaction, deadline, and reporting obligation is documented as the organization’s source of truth.

Effectively communicate how philanthropic support is advancing Zearn's strategic goals, ensuring funders clearly understand the progress, impact, and learning enabled by their investment, and enabling our funders to recognize the strategic intent behind our work and its role in improving math outcomes.

  • Build deep familiarity with Zearn’s strategic goals and platform to ensure our reporting reflects the strategic intent behind our work, not just a list of tasks.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to gather raw data and layer on the strategic context that makes our impact resonate with sophisticated philanthropic partners.
  • Ensure all external communications reflect a strategic understanding of Zearn's mission, even when the underlying work is tactical or procedural.
  • Synthesize learnings and trends from current grants to identify opportunities for strategic narrative shifts that elevate Zearn’s positioning with sophisticated philanthropic partners.

The Next Problems for this Role to Solve

  • How do we build a reporting cadence that feels proactive rather than reactive for our most complex multi-year grants?
  • What is the most efficient way to gather qualitative impact stories from across the organization without creating friction for other teams?
  • How can we use AI tools to automate the tactical parts of reporting so more time can be spent on strategic narrative and data analysis?
  • How do we systematically capture learnings from individual grants to synthesize patterns across the full portfolio, surfacing the strategic narrative shifts that elevate Zearn's positioning with funders?

Skills You Bring to the Table

  • Reporting Powerhouse: You have a specific expertise in grantee report outs and a passion for translating technical work into funder narratives.
  • Dots Connector: You have the intellectual curiosity to understand the "why" behind the work and can see how a product update relates to a long term grant goal.
  • Execution Rigor: You thrive on hitting milestones and ensuring no detail is missed in a fast moving environment.
  • Relationship Owner: You are comfortable being the face of an organization to external partners, managing communications with professional maturity and proactivity.
  • Operational Empathy: You know how to get what you need from busy cross functional teams by being organized, clear, and helpful.
  • Evidence Based Storyteller: You are comfortable with data and use it to build trust with funders.

Potential Markers of these Skills

  • 4-6+ years of experience in grant management or project management, with a heavy emphasis on reporting and execution (ideally in the nonprofit or edtech sector).
  • Prior experience as a grantee with a focus on managing report-outs to funders, rather than experience coming solely from the grant-making or foundation side.
  • Exceptional writing and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to synthesize technical information into clear narratives for program officers or clients.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating complex, multi-stakeholder projects with many moving parts and cross-functional inputs.
  • Technical proficiency in data analysis, basic financial tracking (budgets/spend), and the use of AI tools to accelerate coordination and writing.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related field.
  • Familiarity with compliance structures of large national philanthropic foundations.

This is an Individual Contributor role.

  • Title: Grants Manager
  • Reports to: Director of Strategic Projects

How We Work:

  • We aim to create a numeracy movement. This is no easy feat, and no one of us can solve this on our own. Given that, Zearn is a transparent, collaborative, and open-to-feedback culture.
  • Our work is often collaborative in nature:
    • We own our deliverables in close collaboration with others
    • We communicate openly, and share early thinking and drafts often
    • We seek ways to create and improve systems, and work with each other to contribute thinking in both asynchronous and synchronous discussions.
    • We create a sense of community through regularly sharing context so we can collectively solve problems to drive Zearn’s velocity.

Location:

This role is remote and can be performed in any of the following states/locations:

CA, CT, FL, IL, LA, MA, MD, NC, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX, VA, WA, WI and Washington D.C.

Compensation & Benefits

The compensation range for this role is $80,000 - $100,000 per year.

We offer a competitive benefits package, including comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, short- and long-term disability, life insurance, 401K matching, parental leave, and a flexible PTO policy. We also offer a collegial and passionate culture and the potential to positively impact the lives of millions of children.

TO APPLY:

Zearn is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Campaign Execution, Optimization & Financial Performance

What We’re Looking For

Familiarity with advertising research, identity solutions, and standard verification/measurement vendors — such as Nielsen, ComScore, Moat, Integral Ad Science, DoubleVerify, and Kantar — is a significant asset.

jobs.description:
À propos du poste :

Le Spécialiste des Opérations Commerciales soutient l'ensemble du moteur de revenus en garantissant que les équipes commerciales, les partenaires de canal et les parties prenantes internes disposent des processus, outils et données nécessaires pour fonctionner efficacement. Dans un environnement télécom, ce rôle est essentiel pour maintenir des devis précis, des données CRM propres, un flux de commandes fluide et une coordination étroite entre le provisionnement, la facturation, l'ingénierie et le support client.
Vous serez la colonne vertébrale opérationnelle de l'organisation commerciale — améliorant les flux de travail, éliminant les frictions et permettant une exécution des transactions plus rapide et plus propre.

Responsabilités clés

Processus de vente & gestion des CRM
  • Maintenir et optimiser les données CRM (Salesforce, Dynamics, HubSpot) afin d'assurer la précision, l'exhaustivité et la conformité.
  • Surveiller l'hygiène des canalisations, appliquer les normes de données et soutenir les affectations de territoires et de comptes.
  • Construisez et maintenez des manuels de ventes, la documentation des processus et les procédures opérationnelles opérationnelles internes.

Reporting & Analytics
  • Produire des tableaux de bord hebdomadaires/mensuels couvrant le pipeline, la précision des prévisions, les réservations, le churn et la performance des partenaires.
  • Analysez les tendances de vente et fournissez des informations aux dirigeants pour soutenir la prise de décision.
  • Soutenir la planification des quotas, la modélisation territoriale et le suivi des performances.

Support QuotetoOrder (TelecomSpecific)
  • Validez les devis pour leur exactitude, la conformité tarifaire, la disponibilité et la configuration des produits.
  • Coordonner la saisie des commandes, les demandes de portage, les LOA, les vérifications de service et les transferts de provisions.
  • Assurez-vous que tous les documents requis (contrats, MSA, addendums, formulaires de partenariat) sont complets et conformes.
  • Suivez l'état des commandes, résolvez les divergences et communiquez les mises à jour aux ventes et aux partenaires.

Coordination interfonctionnelle
  • Servir de liaison opérationnelle entre les ventes, l'ingénierie, le provisionnement, la facturation, le support client et le produit.
  • Résoudre les problèmes liés à la disponibilité des services, aux codes de facturation, aux retards de commande ou aux incompatibilités de configuration.
  • Soutenez les partenaires de canal avec des devis, des documents et des conseils opérationnels.

Habilitation et formation des ventes
  • Formez les nouvelles recrues et partenaires à l'utilisation du CRM, aux outils de devis, au catalogue de produits et aux flux de travail internes.
  • Créez et maintenez des supports d'habilitation, des fiches de conseils et des guides de processus.
  • Soutenir l'adoption de nouveaux outils, systèmes et améliorations opérationnelles.

Amélioration des processus et optimisation des systèmes
  • Identifiez les goulets d'étranglement dans le cycle de vente et proposez des améliorations du flux de travail.
  • Collaborez avec l'informatique/produit pour mettre en place des améliorations CRM, des mises à jour CPQ et des opportunités d'automatisation.
  • Participer à des projets interdépartements pour améliorer le flux de commandes, l'expérience des partenaires et la précision des revenus.

Qualifications

Obligatoire
  • 2 à 5 ans d'expérience en opérations commerciales, opérations de revenus ou support commercial.
  • Expérience dans les télécommunications, UCaaS, VoIP, mobilité, fibre optique ou autres secteurs de communication.
  • Solide maîtrise des plateformes CRM et des outils de reporting.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication, organisation et résolution de problèmes.
  • Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement en constante évolution.

Préféré
  • Expérience avec les systèmes CPQ, les flux de travail de provisionnement ou les plateformes de facturation télécom.
  • Familiarité avec Power BI, Tableau ou des outils d'analyse similaires.
  • Compréhension des concepts télécom (DID, portage, SIP, facilité de service, decks de tarif, etc.).
  • Expérience en gestion de projet ou amélioration des processus.
  • Francophone a un avantage (bilingue)

Indicateurs de réussite
  • Intégrité des données CRM élevée et prévisions précises.
  • Délai de devis à commande plus rapide avec moins d'erreurs.
  • Forte satisfaction des partenaires et réduction des escalades opérationnelles.
  • Un reporting clair et exploitable qui guide les décisions de leadership.
  • Amélioration de la productivité commerciale grâce à des processus simplifiés et à l'automatisation.

About the Role:

The Sales Operations Specialist supports the full revenue engine by ensuring sales teams, channel partners, and internal stakeholders have the processes, tools, and data needed to operate efficiently. In a telecom environment, this role is critical for maintaining accurate quoting, clean CRM data, smooth order flow, and tight coordination across provisioning, billing, engineering, and customer support.
You’ll be the operational backbone of the sales organization — improving workflows, eliminating friction, and enabling faster, cleaner deal execution.

Sales Process & CRM Management

Reporting & Analytics
  • Produce weekly/monthly dashboards covering pipeline, forecast accuracy, bookings, churn, and partner performance.

  • Ensure all required documents (contracts, MSAs, addendums, partner forms) are complete and compliant.
  • Track order status, resolve discrepancies, and communicate updates to sales and partners.

Cross‑Functional Coordination
  • Serve as the operational liaison between Sales, Engineering, Provisioning, Billing, Customer Support, and Product.

  • Support channel partners with quoting, documentation, and operational guidance.

Sales Enablement & Training
  • Train new hires and partners on CRM usage, quoting tools, product catalog, and internal workflows.
  • Create and maintain enablement materials, cheat sheets, and process guides.
  • Support adoption of new tools, systems, and operational enhancements.

Process Improvement & Systems Optimization
  • Identify bottlenecks in the sales cycle and propose workflow improvements.
  • Partner with IT/Product to implement CRM enhancements, CPQ updates, and automation opportunities.
  • Participate in cross‑department projects to improve order flow, partner experience, and revenue accuracy.

Qualifications

Required
  • 2–5 years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales Support.
  • Experience in telecom, UCaaS, VoIP, mobility, fiber, or other communications‑based industries.
  • Strong proficiency with CRM platforms and reporting tools.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑moving environment.

Preferred
  • Experience with CPQ systems, provisioning workflows, or telecom billing platforms.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytics tools.
  • Understanding of telecom concepts (DIDs, porting, SIP, serviceability, rate decks, etc.).
  • Project management or process improvement experience.
  • French speaking a plus (bi-lingual)

Success Indicators
  • High CRM data integrity and accurate forecasting.
  • Faster quote‑to‑order turnaround with fewer errors.
  • Strong partner satisfaction and reduced operational escalations.
  • Clear, actionable reporting that drives leadership decisions.
  • Improved sales productivity through streamlined processes and automation.

jobs.title: Senior Paralegal
jobs.excerpt: What We Can Achieve Together: The Senior Paralegal, with minimal supervision from a TNC attorney, will provide an advanced level of expertise to support and coordinate legal services on complex and/or high value matters for assigned business units or projects, ensuring that transactions and activities are legally sound and consistent with TNC’s mission, authority, policies, and procedures.
jobs.description:
What We Can Achieve Together:


The Senior Paralegal, with minimal supervision from a TNC attorney, will provide an advanced level of expertise to support and coordinate legal services on complex and/or high value matters for assigned business units or projects, ensuring that transactions and activities are legally sound and consistent with TNC’s mission, authority, policies, and procedures. They apply advanced knowledge and skills to serve organizational needs in a highly efficient and effective manner. They will need to effectively articulate relevant legal concepts and internal policies and procedures to others and have a solid understanding of the concept of legal liability and risk management. They should have strong analytical skills, people skills and situational awareness to navigate complex projects, structures and relationships.


We’re Looking for You:


Are you looking for work you can believe in? At TNC we strive to embody a philosophy of “Work that You Can Believe In.” This is a place where you can feel like you are making a difference every day. Your legal and organizational skills will provide necessary support for our ongoing mission to preserve the land and waters on which all life depends! As Senior Paralegal you will work with other members of the legal team to acquire and protect conservation real property, review grant agreements for funds that support protection work, draft and revise contracts for implementing nature-based solutions to climate change, and work with preserve staff to ensure preserve activities function safely and smoothly. Commercial transactional legal experience is essential and should include familiarity with both real estate and corporate legal concepts and due diligence. You will have exceptional communication and organizational skills, be self-motivated, detail oriented and able to track and prioritize many items concurrently. Location within the Southeastern U.S. is preferred as you will work closely with legal team members based primarily in that region.


What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree plus 5 years of combined legal and administrative experience OR equivalent qualifications acquired through coursework and/or related job experience that demonstrates (i) the assumption of significant responsibilities for supporting and coordinating complex or specialized legal work and (ii) ability to engage in legal analysis.
  • Experience drafting and revising complex legal documents and transactions including real estate agreements and/or grant agreements.
  • Critical thinking and communication skills.
  • Writing, editing and proofreading skills.
  • Experience conducting research on the Internet and in other legal resources.
  • Experience with MS Office, Word, Excel, Teams, SharePoint, iManage, and any other relevant technology.

Salary Information:


This is an hourly position with a starting pay range for a candidate selected for this position generally within the range of $50,000 – $80,000 annually. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. Where a successful candidate’s actual pay will fall within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including, for example, the candidate's location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment.

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers a competitive, comprehensive benefits package including health care benefits, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with an 8% employer match, parental leave, accrued paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, other life and work well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports of the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

Do you have military experience? Visit our U.S. Military Skills Translator to match your military experience with our current job openings!

TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

jobs.excerpt: Point Wild helps customers monitor, manage, and protect against the risks associated with their identities and personal information in a digital world.
jobs.description:
Point Wild helps customers monitor, manage, and protect against the risks associated with their identities and personal information in a digital world. Backed by WndrCo, Warburg Pincus and General Catalyst, Point Wild is dedicated to creating the world’s most comprehensive portfolio of industry-leading cybersecurity solutions. Our vision is to become THE go-to resource for every cyber protection need individuals may face - today and in the future.

Join us for the ride!

About the Role:

As a Senior MLOps Engineer, you will play a critical role in architecting, building, and maintaining the infrastructure, pipelines, and tooling that enable complex AI models to be deployed, scaled, and monitored in production on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with AI Researchers, Data Engineers, and Backend teams to bridge the gap between experimentation and high-performance, enterprise-grade production systems.

Your Day to Day:

  • GCP ML Infrastructure: Architect and manage scalable GCP-based ML infrastructure using Vertex AI, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Google Cloud Storage (GCS), Cloud Run, and GPU/TPU compute instances.
  • Model Deployment & Serving: Own the end-to-end deployment lifecycle for machine learning models. Build high-throughput, low-latency inference services using containerization and specialized serving frameworks (e.g., Triton Inference Server, vLLM, MLflow).
  • Continuous Integration & Training (CI/CD/CT): Build automated, reproducible pipelines for model training, testing, evaluation, and deployment using tools like Airflow, Vertex AI Pipelines, and GitHub Actions.
  • Production Observability & Monitoring: Implement robust monitoring systems for both system health (latency, throughput, uptime) and ML-specific metrics (feature drift, prediction accuracy, and data distribution shifts) to enable automated retraining triggers.
  • Supporting AI & Research Engineers: Provide scalable training environments, optimized runtime infrastructure, and standardized deployment templates that allow AI engineers to move fast without compromising reliability.
  • Data & Feature Engineering Support: Collaborate with Data Engineers to integrate model pipelines with feature stores, dataset versioning, and stream/batch data processing workflows.
  • Scaling PoCs to Production: Lead the technical transition of raw AI prototypes and notebooks into resilient, secure, and auto-scaling microservices.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Senior MLOps Experience: At least 5 years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, and maintaining production ML workloads in cloud environments.
  • GCP Ecosystem Mastery: Deep, practical experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Vertex AI, Cloud Storage, GKE, Cloud Run, and IAM/VPC configurations.
  • Model Serving & Tooling: Expertise with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/GKE) and specialized serving tools (Triton, vLLM, MLflow).
  • Orchestration & CI/CD: Proven track record with workflow orchestrators (Airflow, Vertex AI Pipelines) and modern CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD).
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Solid experience managing cloud resources using Terraform.
  • Software Development Skills: Proficiency in Python and SQL for scripting, automation, API development, and data manipulation.
  • ML Observability: Hands-on experience with logging, telemetry, and drift detection tools (Grafana, Prometheus, GCP Cloud Monitoring, or specialized ML observability frameworks).

Nice to Have:

  • Experience running large-scale LLM or Deep Learning inference/training workloads.
  • GCP Professional Machine Learning Engineer or GCP Professional Cloud Architect certifications.
  • Familiarity with feature stores (e.g., Feast, Vertex AI Feature Store).

Why This Role Matters:

  • Operationalizing AI: AI models only create value when they operate reliably at scale. You are the architect making production AI possible.
  • Infrastructure Backbone: You provide the core practices, automation, and tooling that empower AI teams to innovate rapidly while maintaining system stability.
  • Cross-Functional Bridge: You connect the worlds of data science, cloud operations, and software engineering to maintain production reliability.

As part of Point Wild, you will:

Solve real customer problems. Point Wild’s point solutions allow consumers to address their immediate cyber protection needs. Our mandate is to continuously anticipate our customers’ evolving digital security needs to create best-in-class solutions aimed at keeping them safe.

See your impact. We are a scrappy, nimble organization where individual contributions are needed and valued. You will see your impact every day.

Accelerate your career. As we expand, you will have the opportunity to learn new technologies, products, and markets in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Most importantly, you’ll get to work with other talented people at a company where people matter. If you want to put your fingerprint on an organization and leapfrog your growth, this is the place for you.

In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination or harassment based on “protected categories,” Point Wild is committed to being an inclusive community where all feel welcome. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at Point Wild.

You are fluent in using AI to accelerate productivity. You improve the quality of output, shorten time to completion, and translate manual workflows into automated ones with appropriate human oversight. You apply these tools to raise the standard and pace of work across all three channels while keeping quality, accuracy, and brand integrity firmly under human control.

This is a hands-on specialist role built on deep channel expertise. You are the team’s expert on LinkedIn, brand websites, and PowerPoint, and you are accountable for channel performance: growing visibility and engagement on LinkedIn, driving the right audiences to convert through the websites, and using PowerPoint to create a premium, persuasive brand experience. You will not define the brand’s core positioning. LinkedIn: organic and paid

PowerPoint design and visual storytelling

IP Character Valuation Consultancy

Ubongo Kids — Intellectual Property Valuation of Original Characters

1. BACKGROUND & ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT

Ubongo is Africa's leading edutainment company, producing award-winning educational media content for children across Sub-Saharan Africa. With flagship productions including Akili and Me, Ubongo Kids, and Akili Academy, Ubongo has built a portfolio of beloved animated characters that resonate with millions of children and families across the continent and globally.

As Ubongo advances its intellectual property (IP) strategy, the organization seeks to unlock the commercial potential of its character portfolio through licensing, merchandise, co-branding, and international distribution deals. To effectively negotiate these opportunities, Ubongo requires a rigorous, defensible, and market-aligned valuation of its core IP characters.

This consultancy will produce a comprehensive IP character valuation report that establishes the monetary worth, licensing rate benchmarks, and commercial positioning of Ubongo's primary characters — providing the evidentiary foundation for licensing negotiations, partnership discussions, and investment conversations.

2. OBJECTIVES

The primary objectives of this consultancy are:

  • Establish the fair market value of Ubongo's core IP characters using internationally recognized valuation methodologies
  • Benchmark Ubongo's character portfolio against comparable African and global children's entertainment IP
  • Develop licensing rate recommendations (royalty percentages, flat fees, minimum guarantees) by product category and territory
  • Assess the brand equity, audience reach, and commercial potential of each character
  • Provide a forward-looking valuation model that can be updated as the IP portfolio grows and market conditions evolve
  • Identify key value drivers and potential risks that affect IP character valuation

3. SCOPE OF WORK

3.1 Phase 1: Discovery & Data Collection (Weeks 1–2)

  • Conduct structured interviews with Ubongo's leadership, creative, and commercial teams
  • Review existing audience data, viewership metrics, social media analytics, and brand health studies
  • Collect financial data including past licensing revenues, merchandise sales, and distribution agreements
  • Document the character portfolio: origins, story assets, trademark registrations, and existing agreements

3.2 Phase 2: Market & Comparables Analysis (Weeks 3–5)

  • Identify and analyse comparable IP transactions in the children's entertainment sector (African and global)
  • Research licensing rates for analogous characters across relevant product categories (toys, apparel, publishing, digital apps, theme parks, FMCG)
  • Map the competitive landscape of African children's IP and assess Ubongo's positioning
  • Analyse market size and growth projections for target licensing territories (East Africa, West Africa, pan-Africa, diaspora markets, global)

3.3 Phase 3: Valuation Modelling (Weeks 3–5)

  • Apply at minimum three valuation methodologies: Income Approach (Discounted Royalty Stream), Market Approach (Comparable Transactions), and Cost Approach (Replacement Cost)
  • Develop a character-by-character valuation for the core portfolio (minimum 5 characters)
  • Build a dynamic financial model with adjustable assumptions and scenario analysis (base, conservative, optimistic)
  • Calculate recommended royalty rates by product category, geography, and exclusivity tier

3.4 Phase 4: Reporting & Recommendations (Weeks 5–8)

  • Produce a comprehensive IP Valuation Report (executive and detailed versions)
  • Develop a Licensing Rate Card with recommended terms for standard licensing categories
  • Create a presentation-ready deck for use in investor and partner conversations
  • Conduct a debrief session with Ubongo's leadership to present findings and answer questions

4. DELIVERABLES

Deliverable 1: Inception Report: methodology, work plan, and data collection framework (Week 3)

Deliverable 2: Market & Comparables Analysis Report (Week 5)

Deliverable 3: Dynamic IP Valuation Financial Model (Excel/Google Sheets) with scenario analysis (Week 8)

Deliverable 4: Comprehensive IP Character Valuation Report — Executive Summary (≤15 pages) and Full Report (Week 10)

Deliverable 5: Licensing Rate Card by product category and territory (Week 10)

Deliverable 6: Investor/Partner Pitch Deck (PowerPoint, ≤20 slides) (Week 10)

Deliverable 7: Final debrief presentation and Q&A session with Ubongo leadership (Week 10)

5. DURATION & TIMELINE

The consultancy is expected to run for ten (10) weeks from the date of contract signing.

Total Duration: 8 weeks

Expected Start: July 1st

Inception Report: End of Week 2

Draft Final Report: End of Week 5

Final Deliverables: End of Week 8

6. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

Proposals are invited from individual consultants, firms, or consortia with the following qualifications:

Essential Requirements

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in IP valuation, brand valuation, or intangible asset assessment
  • Demonstrated experience valuing media, entertainment, or consumer brand intellectual property
  • Proficiency in recognised IP valuation methodologies (Income, Market, Cost approaches)
  • Strong financial modelling skills with ability to build dynamic scenario models
  • At least 2 references from comparable IP valuation assignments with entertainment or media companies

Highly Desirable

  • Experience working with African media, entertainment, or consumer goods companies
  • Experience working with animation valuation, character valuation and IP Licensing
  • Familiarity with licensing deal structures in the children's entertainment sector
  • Membership or certification from a recognised valuation body (e.g., CFA, CVA, ASA, RICS)
  • Understanding of the East or Sub-Saharan African market landscape

7. EVALUATION CRITERIA

Technical Approach & Methodology 30% 30

Team Qualifications & Expertise 20% 20

Understanding of Ubongo's Context 10% 10

8. PROPOSAL REQUIREMENTS

Proposals must include the following:

  • Technical Proposal: approach, methodology, work plan, and team composition (maximum 20 pages)
  • Financial Proposal: itemised budget with daily rates, total fees, and payment schedule (submitted separately)
  • Firm/Consultant Profile: overview of the organisation or individual, relevant credentials, and client list
  • Samples of Work: at least 2 examples of prior IP or brand valuation reports (may be anonymised)
  • References: minimum 2 professional references from comparable assignments
  • Conflict of Interest Declaration

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

The Technical Enablement team at Cloudera is the engine behind our field’s competitive edge. We don't just deliver training; we architect the frameworks that transform complex data product capabilities into field-ready value propositions. As the Senior Director of Global Sales Technical Field Enablement, you will be a critical executive leader responsible for building, scaling, and leading the global organization that drives technical readiness across our Solution Engineering and other customer facing organizations.


Reporting directly to the VP of Global Sales Enablement, you will own the end-to-end technical readiness lifecycle. You will lead a high-performing team of enablement managers and strategists, acting as the strategic liaison between executive leadership in Product Engineering, Marketing, and Sales to ensure our technical sellers are elite consultants capable of navigating the most complex enterprise data architectures.


Strategic Responsibilities

Global Organizational Leadership & Scale

  • Build & Lead the Team: Recruit, mentor, and develop a world-class global team of technical enablement managers and instructional designers. Foster a high-performance culture aligned with Cloudera's strategic growth.
  • Budget & Resource Management: Own the global budget for technical enablement, including software vendor management (LMS, lab environments) and external content partnerships. Ensure maximum ROI on enablement spend.

Executive Stakeholder & Strategy Realization

  • Sales Alignment: Partner directly with the VPs and SVPs of Worldwide Sales, Solution Engineering, and Product Management to diagnose global skill gaps, align on corporate KPIs, and deploy targeted enablement interventions.
  • Product-to-Field Pipeline: Serve as the executive bridge to Product Engineering. Ensure your team transforms roadmap features into comprehensive, "Value-Based Technical Demo" frameworks that articulate how Cloudera beats the competition at an architectural level.

Governance & Competency Frameworks

  • Global Certification Ownership: Design, govern, and scale a sophisticated, role-based technical competency matrix. Own the global "Certification" strategy that validates the field’s ability to execute high-stakes technical validations (PoCs) and architectural designs.
  • Onboarding & Time-to-Value: Standardize and evolve the "First 90 Days" technical journey globally. Move beyond completion metrics to directly impact executive KPIs: Time-to-First-Deal and Technical Proficiency Benchmarks.

Enablement Innovation

  • Tech Stack & AI Transformation: Champion and fund next-generation learning modalities. Drive the adoption of AI-driven coaching tools, automated advanced lab environments, and "just-in-time" enablement triggers tied to CRM data.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 12+ years of experience in Technical Sales, Sales Engineering, or Technical Enablement within the Big Data, Cloud, or SaaS space, with at least 5+ years of direct people management experience leading global, multi-tiered teams.
  • Leadership Track Record: Proven success leading enablement or technical pre-sales organizations through massive corporate transformations (e.g., shifting a global field team from legacy on-premise to Hybrid Cloud/SaaS selling models).
  • Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with a proven track record of influencing, challenging, and collaborating with C-suite stakeholders, VPs, and external partners.
  • Deep Technical Fluency: Ability to "speak engineer" and command respect from highly technical teams. Strong conceptual understanding of data lifecycles, Kubernetes, Cloudera/Hadoop ecosystems, and hyperscale cloud providers (AWS/Azure/GCP).

jobs.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. As a Client Program Manager in Picarro’s Gas Business Unit, you will partner with senior utility leaders to align programs, outcomes, and strategy. You will play a key role in ensuring our largest and most complex clients realize measurable value from their investment in Picarro technology.

This role blends technical understanding, business acumen, and program leadership. You will guide long-term customer success by helping utilities translate data and insights into action plans that reduce risk, manage emissions, and improve operational performance.

  • Lead client programs from initial planning through long-term success, including pilots, production rollouts, integrations, and executive reviews.

  • Serve as the primary strategic interface for assigned accounts, engaging with director- and executive-level stakeholders to review progress, set goals, and define outcomes.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to communicate client needs, influence product direction, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Support business development and proposal efforts by defining customer goals, success metrics, and implementation plans.

What You Bring

  • Strong understanding of pipeline safety, emissions management, and regulatory frameworks.

The Senior Manager, Commercial Systems is responsible for owning and evolving the commercial systems that power EnableComp's go-to-market engine — Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Clay, and Accord. This role treats the commercial stack as a product: a connected operating system that should get smarter, faster, and more automated every quarter, not just kept running.   • Real, demonstrated experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to build workflows, automate tasks, or transform how a system or team operates — not just casual use
  • Strong SQL/SOQL or equivalent query fluency, and comfort translating messy business asks into clean data models
  • Experience writing technical specs and partnering with developers or implementation vendors to ship system changes
  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills; healthcare, RCM, or complex B2B sales environment experience is a plus
  • Timely and regular attendance.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered
  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS & PREREQUISITES

  • Minimal travel required (occasional on-site collaboration or team events).

  • A product mindset — comfortable owning a roadmap, prioritizing competing requests, and iterating based on feedback; genuine curiosity about applying AI to eliminate manual, repetitive work

jobs.excerpt: About NOCD NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).
jobs.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About The Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, NOCD, wants our Therapists to focus on what's most important – treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LCPC, LMFT, LCSW) in Maine to join our network.
We will provide the training necessary to become a specialized therapist and ensure you are fully equipped to deliver effective, evidence-based treatment.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources. Providers will collaborate with our network of psychiatrists and therapists to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
    • Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • Maine: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Clinical Professional Counselor, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Clinical Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT) preferred
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, 401(k) match, and paid parental leave for eligible employees
  • PTO based on an accrual system
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Specialized ERP training with experienced OCD providers
  • Work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases

  • identifiant les bonnes pratiques issues des initiatives en cours et en les complétant par les meilleures pratiques du marché afin de définir un standard suivi et contrôlé ;

NL :

Deze opdracht heeft als doel de CI/CD-aanpak van een overheidsorganisatie verder te professionaliseren door :

  • bestaande initiatieven in kaart te brengen;
  • best practices uit lopende initiatieven te distilleren en aan te vullen met marktstandaarden, zodat een bewaakte standaard wordt vastgelegd;
  • de nodige herbruikbare tooling op te zetten;
  • samen met elk team een stappenplan uit te werken, te beginnen met de grootste of recentste initiatieven, om de omschakeling te realiseren;
  • documentatie op te bouwen over de standaard en de voortgang van de transitie;
  • ontwikkelteams te ondersteunen tijdens deze overgang.

  • teams begeleiden bij de uitvoering van het verbeterplan;

  • Minimum 1 an d’expérience avec la stack ELK, y compris Kibana ;
  • L’expérience de l’intégration, via des pipelines, d’outils SCA (par exemple CAST Highlight) et SAST constitue un atout ;
  • Solides compétences en communication et en conduite du changement avec les équipes de développement, les équipes d’infrastructure et le management ;
