jobs.description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with a wide range of flexible payment options designed to give customers more choice, accessibility, and a smarter overall experience. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a curious, driven, and thoughtful Product Intern to join our Payments & Fees team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

If you want to truly understand how fintech works, there's no better place to start than payments — and no better seat than product. The Payments & Fees team sits at the intersection of technology, data, and business, working with payment processors, payment method providers, and cross-functional partners across the company. As a product intern here, you won't be watching from the sidelines. You'll be in the room (or the channel) where decisions get made, picking up context fast and contributing to a team that moves quickly and takes its craft seriously.

You'll support the product manager across a high-throughput environment: helping keep the backlog organized, digging into data to understand payment flows, and working alongside an efficient and technically sharp engineering team, as well as Design and Data teams. Product management is one of those rare roles where no two days look the same — you're constantly context-switching between technical conversations, business problems, and user needs, and that's exactly what makes it exciting.

What You'll Do:

Ticket Management & Product Support

  • Assist the product manager in drafting, organizing, and tracking tickets for changes and improvements to the payments service. Help ensure work is well-documented, properly prioritized, and moving through the backlog. Follow up on status and surface blockers when needed.

Context Gathering & Stakeholder Support

  • Help the product manager stay on top of inputs from multiple stakeholders by gathering background context, summarizing key information, and preparing materials ahead of provider meetings. Respond to routine internal questions by pulling the right information from available resources.

Payment Workflow Analysis

  • Learn and apply SQL to query payment data and support the creation and maintenance of dashboards that track payment performance, processing failures, and operational health. Help flag anomalies in payment flows and assist in assembling data for reviews and investigations.

Documentation & Process Tracking

  • Maintain clear internal documentation for payment flows, fee structures, and operational processes. Help keep cross-functional teams aligned with concise, well-structured written updates.

Agile Meetings

  • Participate in agile meetings and collaborate with engineering, operations, compliance, and support teams. One of the most valuable things a product manager does is serve as a bridge between tech and the business — translating technical challenges into clear language and business needs into actionable requirements. You'll get hands-on experience doing exactly that.

What We Look For:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or a related field
  • A genuine interest in payments, fintech, and how complex financial systems work under the hood
  • Natural curiosity and a logical mindset — you enjoy working through problems, aren't afraid to ask questions, and get satisfaction from figuring things out
  • Strong attention to detail — you notice when something's off and follow through until it's resolved
  • Comfort working with data and a willingness to learn SQL; prior experience is a plus but not required
  • Effective written and verbal communication — you can summarize a complex topic clearly and ask the right questions to fill in gaps
  • Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to product, fintech, data analysis, or startups is a plus — but we hire for potential, not just pedigree.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards — many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You're not bound by convention — your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things.
  • You need action — speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust — you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit — you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results — you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Product Intern is $800 USD Gross as an independent contractor.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionSprout Social is seeking an experienced Product Manager to own the strategy, delivery, and scaling of our partner and platform integration ecosystem.
jobs.description:
Description

Sprout Social is seeking an experienced Product Manager to own the strategy, delivery, and scaling of our partner and platform integration ecosystem. This role sits at the center of a critical shift for Sprout: moving from bespoke, one-off partner integrations toward a scalable, platform-based integration model that reduces engineering lift per partner while expanding the ecosystem of systems that connect to Sprout.

This is an individual contributor role requiring deep technical fluency in integration architecture (APIs, managed packages, platform events, OAuth/permission models) paired with strong commercial judgment on what's worth building, for whom, and when.

Why join Sprout’s Product team?

Sprout empowers businesses worldwide to harness the immense power and opportunity of social media in today’s digital-first world. Processing over one billion social messages daily, our platform serves up essential insights and actionable information to over 30,000 brands, informing strategic decisions that drive business growth and innovation, and fostering deeper, authentic connections to their end customers. Our full suite of social media management solutions includes comprehensive publishing and engagement functionality, customer care solutions, influencer marketing, connected workflows, and business intelligence. This is an exciting opportunity for a leader to come in and have full ownership of our integrations strategy.

Our Product team operates at the intersection of strategy, innovation, customer value, and go-to-market collaboration. We are focused on delivering unified, data-driven solutions across our multi-product portfolio. As part of the broader R&D organization, our team collaborates closely with Engineering, Product Design, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to create impactful experiences for customers while driving measurable business outcomes. This cross-functional partnership ensures that our products not only meet technical excellence but are also positioned effectively in the market, aligning with customer needs and business growth objectives. You won't just help set the vision for our integration platform, you'll also play a key role in shaping our overall approach to partner and platform strategy and own both strategy, execution, and outcomes.

What you’ll do

  • Own individual integrations strategy end-to-end from pricing and packaging to distribution strategy to GA readiness, including ongoing relationship management with cross-functional teams
  • Partner closely with Engineering to sequence integration investments, balancing near-term customer/revenue commitments against longer-term platform scalability
  • Define and execute platform-based integration strategies (e.g., generalized APIs or connectors) that let customers self-integrate, reducing the need for bespoke builds per vendor
  • Serve as the key driver of integration lifecycle management, from alpha and beta through GA and post-launch scaling, aligning with strategic partners and key customers on roadmap, timeline, and requirements at each stage
  • Own permissioning, security, and licensing model decisions for packaged integrations (managed packages, namespace strategy, license management)
  • Build the business case and prioritization framework for new integration bets, including clear kill criteria and proof points before scaling investment
  • Act as connective tissue between GTM, Partnerships, and Engineering to ensure integration work is commercially viable, not just technically sound
  • Drive the execution of "best-in-class" product delivery, balancing the urgency of immediate customer needs with the long-term scalability and innovation of our core

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for an entrepreneurial and visionary product manager to help our company build the right integrations strategy. If you can work cross-functionally to build, launch, and grow our integrations ecosystem, and align teams around solving hard problems together, we'd love to talk with you!

  • 10+ years of PM experience in ecosystem or integration roles in a B2B product-driven SaaS environment.
  • Proven success leading initiatives in a multi-product portfolio company.
  • Experience collaborating closely with product, design, engineering, and GTM leaders to deliver cohesive solutions.
  • Experience partnering with distributed engineering teams across different time zones
  • A default toward over communication: written specs, recorded walkthroughs, decision logs, and proactive status instead of waiting to be asked.

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Completing Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.
  • Learning the current state of integrations at Sprout, along with future product and technical roadmaps.
  • Diving into our products to learn about what makes our software unique and why customers love our products.
  • Beginning to understand the capabilities and limitations of our integrations
  • Establishing relationships with other product, engineering, design and revenue leaders and identifying areas of opportunity.
  • Get hands-on with Sprout’s products, experiencing them from the customer’s perspective.
  • Establishing a working cadence with your engineering partners in Poland, including how you'll handle handoffs, async decisions, and the daily overlap window.

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Partnering with senior product leaders to define key success metrics for your role and teams and how you will measure against them.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and decisions, asking the right questions to guide your team to successful outcomes.
  • Participating in planning and roadmap processes and helping to shape the product roadmap for long-term success.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Becoming an expert in Sprout's integration ecosystem and confidently speaking to partner strategy, technical tradeoffs, and platform roadmap with internal and external stakeholderS
  • Owning the integration roadmap and delivering measurable results on key strategic initiatives.
  • Identify key opportunities to improve cross-team collaboration and alignment.
  • Standing up working cadences to build and deliver on product roadmap and outcomes in partnership with design, engineering, and GTM teams

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Consistently meeting and exceeding established performance targets.
  • Obtaining (solicited and unsolicited) and acting upon peer, customer, and leadership feedback.
  • Continue to evolve Sprout’s product culture, shaping the next generation of product managers.
  • Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change our integration capabilities at Sprout in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet!

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).
  • Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.
  • Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family.
  • Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.
  • Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations.
  • Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

Whenever possible, Sprout wants to provide our team with the flexibility to work in the location that makes the most sense for them. Sprout maintains a remote workforce in many places in the United States. However, we are not set up in all states, so please look at the drop-down box in our application to see whether your state is listed. Few roles require an office setting. If your position requires a physical presence in a Sprout office, it will be evident in the job listing and your offer letter.

Our salary ranges reflect the expected earning potential for this role. Individual pay is based on geographic zone, relevant experience, and skills.

Our current hiring range for this role: $164,800 – $206,000 annually. Offers are made within this range, with opportunities to grow within the broader band based on performance and impact.

We share both our current hiring range and our broader geographic salary bands to provide transparency into our compensation philosophy. This ensures you understand not only your starting potential but also the long-term growth potential available as you progress in your role.

We have two geographic pay zones in the United States:

These ranges were determined by a market-based compensation approach; we used data from trusted third-party compensation sources to set equitable, consistent, and competitive ranges. jobs.description:
Position Summary 

The Senior Talent Attraction Media Manager is responsible for developing and executing strategic recruitment marketing initiatives that help clients attract, engage, and hire top talent. This role serves as a trusted recruitment marketing consultant to clients and internal stakeholders, aligning employer branding, talent attraction, and recruitment media strategies with workforce planning, hiring priorities, and long-term business objectives. 


This position combines strategic planning with hands-on execution across employer branding, recruitment advertising, social media, talent communities, content strategy, hiring events, creative campaign development, recruitment marketing technology, and performance analytics. Success in this role requires strong project management, consultative communication, strategic thinking, creativity, and the ability to influence stakeholders while managing multiple client accounts in a fast-paced environment.


Fixed-term (4-month contract) based on the needs of the project.


Key Responsibilities 

Recruitment Marketing Strategy 

  • Develop and execute comprehensive recruitment marketing strategies aligned with client hiring goals, workforce planning, and employer branding objectives.  
  • Partner with recruiters and client stakeholders to identify recruitment challenges and recommend strategic marketing solutions.  
  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities that strengthen employer brand positioning and talent attraction efforts.  
  • Develop quarterly and annual recruitment marketing roadmaps that support both immediate hiring needs and long-term employer branding initiatives.  
  • Develop recruitment advertising and media strategies that maximize budget efficiency, candidate quality, and hiring outcomes.  
  • Continuously evaluate recruitment marketing trends and recommend innovative approaches to improve candidate engagement and hiring results.  

Account Management & Program Ownership 

  • Own the overall recruitment marketing strategy and execution for assigned client accounts.  
  • Balance competing priorities across multiple clients while ensuring high-quality execution and stakeholder satisfaction.  
  • Manage project timelines, deliverables, approvals, and communication across internal and external stakeholders.  
  • Anticipate client needs and proactively recommend solutions that support long-term account success and growth.

  

Client Partnership & Strategic Consultation 

  • Serve as the strategic recruitment marketing advisor for assigned client accounts, building trusted relationships with client stakeholders and internal recruiting teams.  
  • Lead recurring client meetings to review campaign performance, hiring priorities, employer branding opportunities, and strategic recommendations.  
  • Align recruitment marketing initiatives with workforce planning, hiring forecasts, budget priorities, and business objectives.  
  • Translate business challenges into actionable recruitment marketing strategies that improve hiring outcomes.  
  • Proactively identify opportunities to expand recruitment marketing support through strategic recommendations and consultative partnership.  
  • Present campaign performance, strategic recommendations, and recruitment marketing insights to client leadership.  

Employer Branding & Content Strategy 

  • Develop and execute employer branding strategies that showcase client culture, employee experience, career opportunities, and employee value propositions.  
  • Develop and oversee recruitment marketing content strategies across multiple channels, including:  

- Social media campaigns  

- Email marketing  

- Talent community communications  

- Recruitment advertising  

- Graphics and creative collateral  

- Video content  

- Blog articles  

- Presentations  

- Recruitment event materials  

  • Partner with client marketing and communications teams to ensure recruitment marketing aligns with broader organizational branding initiatives.  
  • Maintain consistent employer branding, messaging, and visual identity across all recruitment marketing efforts.  

Talent Communities & Candidate Engagement 

  • Manage talent community strategy, audience segmentation, campaign planning, and ongoing engagement initiatives.  
  • Develop email nurture campaigns that strengthen candidate relationships and support future hiring needs.  
  • Monitor engagement metrics and optimize campaigns based on performance insights.  
  • Recommend innovative engagement strategies that strengthen talent pipelines and improve candidate experience.  

Social Media & Recruitment Advertising 

  • Develop and manage organic and paid social media strategies aligned with employer branding and hiring priorities.  
  • Plan, execute, and optimize recruitment marketing campaigns across multiple digital channels.  
  • Collaborate with recruiters to develop recruitment marketing assets that support active hiring initiatives.  
  • Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance through testing, optimization, and emerging recruitment marketing trends.  

Hiring Events & Talent Attraction Initiatives 

  • Own end-to-end recruitment marketing strategy for hiring events and talent attraction initiatives.  
  • Consult with internal stakeholders and clients to determine when hiring events are the appropriate solution and recommend alternative recruitment marketing strategies when appropriate.  
  • Develop event branding, promotional materials, social media campaigns, candidate communications, and creative assets.  
  • Evaluate event performance and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.  

Recruitment Marketing Technology & Innovation 

  • Manage recruitment marketing platforms including Beamery, Greenhouse, Mailchimp, Indeed, Canva, and other recruitment marketing technologies.  
  • Support campaign execution, platform optimization, and troubleshooting while identifying opportunities to improve recruiter and candidate experiences.  
  • Recommend new technologies, workflows, and automation opportunities that improve operational efficiency and recruitment marketing effectiveness.  

Analytics & Continuous Improvement 

  • Monitor recruitment marketing performance across multiple channels and provide actionable recommendations based on campaign results, engagement metrics, and hiring outcomes.  
  • Measure recruitment marketing ROI and identify opportunities to improve campaign performance, media effectiveness, candidate engagement, and hiring outcomes.  
  • Develop executive-ready reporting that communicates campaign performance, business impact, and future opportunities.  
  • Identify operational improvements that increase efficiency, scalability, and overall recruitment marketing effectiveness.  
  • Develop documentation, templates, and best practices that improve consistency and support knowledge sharing across the team.  

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration 

  • Partner closely with recruiters, media specialists, creative teams, and client stakeholders to deliver integrated recruitment marketing solutions.  
  • Provide strategic guidance to recruiters and stakeholders on recruitment marketing best practices, campaign strategy, and employer branding initiatives.  
  • Mentor team members by sharing recruitment marketing best practices and strategic guidance.  
  • Support onboarding and training of new team members through documentation, shadow sessions, and process development.  
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve recruitment marketing operations, processes, and client experience.  
  • Foster collaboration across teams to ensure successful execution of recruitment marketing initiatives.  

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).  
  • Experience in recruitment marketing, employer branding, talent acquisition marketing, or digital marketing.  
  • Experience serving as a strategic advisor to clients or senior stakeholders.  
  • Strong understanding of recruitment marketing strategies, employer branding, recruitment advertising, and candidate attraction techniques.  
  • Experience managing multiple client accounts and stakeholder relationships simultaneously.  
  • Experience managing recruitment marketing media budgets and advertising campaigns.  
  • Excellent written communication, storytelling, content development, and presentation skills.  
  • Strong project management, organizational, and consultative communication skills.  
  • Experience analyzing campaign performance and translating insights into strategic recommendations.  
  • Experience with recruitment marketing platforms such as Beamery, Greenhouse, Mailchimp, Indeed, Canva, and social media management tools preferred.  

Success in This Role 

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker who thrives in both long-term planning and hands-on execution. They are equally comfortable consulting with executive stakeholders, developing employer branding strategies, leading recruitment marketing initiatives, creating compelling content, analyzing campaign performance, and solving operational challenges. 

Success in this role requires curiosity, adaptability, creativity, strong business acumen, and the ability to build trusted client relationships while managing multiple priorities and delivering measurable recruitment marketing results in a fast-paced consulting environment.

jobs.description:
Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

  • Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.

  • Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.

  • Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

The Opportunity:

The Senior Compliance Solutions Engineer is the technical owner and primary engineer for an enterprise compliance and investigation platform built on Microsoft Power Platform. Power Pages provides the application and identity foundation, but this is not a traditional low-code role: the platform includes a substantial custom JavaScript application layer, custom HTML/CSS/Liquid, Dataverse, Power Automate, custom APIs/plugins, and supporting automation. The engineer is responsible for continuing to build, enhance, secure, document, and support the platform across the full software-development lifecycle.


This role uses modern agentic AI coding tools as a core engineering workflow. The engineer will use Claude Code and other AI tools to accelerate architecture, implementation, refactoring, debugging, testing, documentation, and delivery while remaining accountable for the correctness, security, maintainability, and supportability of the resulting code. The successful candidate will combine strong technical judgment with the ability to translate compliance and audit needs into scalable, user-friendly technology solutions.


Essential Job Functions:

  • Serve as the technical owner for the compliance solutions platform, translating business requirements into solution architecture, development plans, production releases, and ongoing enhancements.
  • Design, build, and maintain custom Power Pages experiences that rely on substantial JavaScript rather than only standard low-code forms; develop and troubleshoot asynchronous client-side logic, Dataverse Web API calls, OData/FetchXML queries, dynamic rendering, validation, file handling, and workflow-driven user experiences.
  • Design and evolve Dataverse tables, relationships, configuration data, metadata-driven features, forms, views, security roles, web roles, table permissions, and other data-governance controls.
  • Develop and maintain Power Automate workflows for case processing, approvals, notifications, contributor requests, imports, synchronization, AI-assisted processing, escalations, and operational monitoring.
  • Develop server-side extensions when low-code capabilities are insufficient, including Dataverse plugins/custom APIs using C# and related integration patterns.
  • Create and maintain supporting automation using PowerShell, TypeScript/Office Scripts, Excel/VBA, REST APIs, JSON, and other scripting technologies when needed for migration, administration, testing, reconciliation, or operational support.
  • Use Claude Code and/or OpenAI Codex as an integrated development environment for repo-level engineering work, including solution decomposition, multi-file code changes, debugging, refactoring, test generation, code review, documentation, and Git-based development workflows.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code before deployment; identify insecure, inefficient, brittle, incorrect, or unnecessarily complex implementations and improve them to production standards.
  • Integrate Power Platform solutions with enterprise services and data sources such as Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Workday, Excel, APIs, SQL/data platforms, and other internal or third-party systems.
  • Maintain source control, solution packaging, environment-specific configuration, ALM/deployment processes, release discipline, and technical documentation so changes can be understood, tested, promoted, and supported reliably.
  • Perform hands-on production support and root-cause analysis across Power Pages, Dataverse, Power Automate, identity/security, integrations, custom JavaScript, plugins, and supporting scripts.
  • Plan and execute developer testing, regression testing, role/security testing, integration testing, data-validation testing, UAT support, defect correction, and post-deployment validation.
  • Support historical and ongoing data migration activities, including source-to-target mapping, transformation, cleansing, backloads, reconciliation, and business validation.
  • Maintain architecture documentation, data-model documentation, module/page documentation, implementation guides, migration documentation, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks; use AI to accelerate documentation while keeping it accurate and current.
  • Partner with Compliance, Privacy, Internal Audit, IT, and business stakeholders to understand investigation and operational pain points and identify opportunities to automate repetitive work, improve data quality, and reduce investigation cycle time.
  • Develop and support AI-enabled capabilities such as case summarization, structured narrative generation, intelligent guidance, classification, and other approved uses of generative AI within compliance workflows.
  • Provide user support, technical guidance, training, and knowledge transfer to help operational teams effectively adopt new capabilities.
  • Demonstrate collaboration, accountability, trust, initiative, inclusion, customer focus, innovation, and a consistent commitment to excellence.

Employment Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may substitute for a degree.
  • 7 to 10 years of relevant experience in application development, solution engineering, enterprise systems, or comparable technical roles.
  • 3+ years of hands-on Microsoft Power Platform experience, including Dataverse and Power Automate; meaningful Power Pages development experience is strongly preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge of JavaScript and modern browser application development. The candidate must be able to read, troubleshoot, modify, test, and safely deploy substantial custom JavaScript applications, including code originally generated or accelerated by AI.
  • Demonstrated experience taking ambiguous business requirements from concept through architecture, development, testing, release, and production support.
  • Experience with Git/source control and disciplined software-development practices.
  • Experience leading technical workstreams, mentoring others, or acting as the primary technical owner for an application or platform is preferred.

Required AI-Augmented Development Experience:

  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience using at least one agentic coding environment - Claude Code or OpenAI Codex - to deliver real software changes in a repository. General chatbot use, prompt-only assistance, or generating isolated code snippets does not satisfy this requirement.
  • Experience using Claude Code or Codex for multi-file implementation, debugging, refactoring, code review, test creation, documentation, and source-control workflows, with the ability to explain specific production work completed using the tool.
  • Ability to direct AI agents effectively by decomposing complex work, supplying appropriate repository and business context, reviewing proposed changes, iterating when results are incomplete, and validating the final implementation.
  • Strong engineering judgment when working with AI-generated code, including the ability to recognize hallucinated APIs, security weaknesses, broken assumptions, regressions, performance problems, and maintainability concerns.
  • Commitment to using approved AI tools responsibly and in accordance with organizational security, privacy, data-handling, and software-development requirements.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Advanced Power Pages development, including custom JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Liquid, Dataverse Web API, OData, FetchXML, authentication patterns, web roles, and table permissions.
  • Strong Power Automate skills, including expressions, nested control flow, child flows, error handling, retries, idempotent processing, scheduled automation, and integration patterns.
  • Strong Dataverse design skills, including relational modeling, alternate keys, lookups, metadata/configuration-driven design, security, and performance considerations.
  • Working knowledge of C# and Dataverse plugins/custom APIs, or the ability to maintain and extend existing .NET server-side components with AI assistance and appropriate code review.
  • Working knowledge of PowerShell, TypeScript/Office Scripts, Excel/VBA, SQL, REST APIs, JSON, and data-transformation techniques.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Workday, Azure services, and enterprise identity/integration patterns.
  • Experience with Power Platform ALM, solution packaging, environment variables, PAC CLI, deployment profiles, CI/CD concepts, and environment promotion.
  • Experience with data migration, reconciliation, historical data conversion, and validation of high-volume or sensitive business data.
  • Strong testing and troubleshooting skills across UI, workflow, integration, permissions, data, and production-support scenarios.
  • Ability to create and maintain high-quality technical documentation, architecture decisions, runbooks, and implementation guidance in Markdown or comparable formats.
  • Experience with Copilot Studio, AI Builder, Azure/OpenAI services, or other enterprise AI capabilities is beneficial but secondary to hands-on agentic software development experience.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA, SOX, privacy, compliance, audit, investigations, access controls, and regulated-data handling is preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work directly with business stakeholders, challenge assumptions constructively, explain technical decisions, and independently drive work to completion.
  • Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.
  • This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require.

This role pays between $101,600- $152,400 based on experience and location

We are a healthcare technology company that provides platforms and solutions to improve the management and access of cost-effective pharmacy benefits. Our technology helps enterprise and partnership clients simplify their businesses and helps consumers save on prescriptions.

As a leader in SaaS technology for healthcare, we offer innovative solutions with integrated intelligence on a single enterprise platform that connects the pharmacy ecosystem. With our expertise and modern, modular platform, our partners use real-time data to transform their business performance and optimize their innovative models in the marketplace.

Position Summary

We're adding a director of data and platform architecture to a small, high-leverage AI engineering team. You'll own the full data architecture end to end: how data lands in our systems, how it moves through ETL and transformation, and how it ultimately reaches stakeholders through extracts and dashboards. You'll also own devops and infrastructure for the AI engineering team, meaning you decide how everything gets built, deployed, and kept running. You'll set that architecture and build it yourself. This is a hands-on keyboard role, even at the director level.

This role comes with direct reports from the start. You'll build and lead the team as it grows, while staying close enough to the work to keep shipping code yourself.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own the data architecture end to end, from the moment data lands in our systems through ETL and transformation, extracts, and the dashboards stakeholders rely on.
  • Own devops and infrastructure for the AI engineering team end to end. Design and own the platform architecture underlying our AI engineering systems, from ingestion through serving.
  • Set technical direction and standards for data infrastructure, pipelines, ETL and transformation logic, and platform reliability.
  • Design the extract and reporting layer so downstream dashboards and analytics are accurate, timely, and trusted.
  • Build the systems and infrastructure you design, and make them production grade: deployable, observable, and stable enough to run without hand holding.
  • Write and ship code yourself.
  • Build and lead the data and platform team as it grows, from hiring through day-to-day direction.
  • Mentor engineers on architecture, data design, devops, and/or platform thinking.
  • Communicate tradeoffs clearly to engineers, other architects, and leadership. Turn complex systems into decisions people can act on.
  • Partner with AI engineering leadership to align platform investments with product and research priorities.
  • Translate business and executive priorities into data strategy and architecture decisions, so technical investments map directly to what the business needs next. You own the outcome of those decisions.

Education/Experience/Competencies

  • 8+ years architecting and building platforms in production. Not a hard cutoff: strong candidates with less experience can still be considered.
  • Proven, hands-on experience owning data architecture end to end, including ingestion, ETL and transformation, extracts, and the reporting or BI layer.
  • Proven, hands-on devops experience: you build, deploy, and operate the systems and infrastructure you design, and what you ship performs in production at scale.
  • A track record of writing and shipping production code yourself, not just producing diagrams and design documents.
  • Hands-on depth across the modern data stack: big data/distributed processing (e.g., Spark, Kafka), NoSQL and document stores (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB), data warehousing (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery), and high-throughput transactional databases (Postgres, MySQL) with rigorous PHI/PII handling and detection practices.
  • Hands-on experience with devops tooling and practices: GitOps workflows, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent).
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. You translate complex architecture decisions into terms engineers, other architects, and non-technical leadership can act on, and you do it consistently, not just in big reviews. You work across teams by default, aligning platform and data decisions with product, research, and business priorities rather than building in isolation.
  • Experience mentoring engineers on architecture, data design, devops, and/or platform thinking.
  • Prior experience building and leading a team, or clear readiness to take on direct reports.
  • Comfort working in a small, fast-moving team where you'll wear multiple hats.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience architecting data platforms that support AI or ML workloads.
  • Experience with vector databases for AI/ML retrieval (e.g., Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate).
  • Experience in healthcare, pharmacy benefits, or another regulated data environment.
  • Experience standing up data platforms from scratch (greenfield), not just extending or migrating existing systems.

jobs.excerpt: Who we are:Process Street is an AI software and compliance operations platform startup from San Francisco.
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Process Street is an AI software and compliance operations platform startup from San Francisco. We help our customers build, document, automate, and track recurring workflows. Our platform automates the work, enforces the standards, and proves compliance so our global customers can run their businesses. We service over 3k customers around the world, and are VC-backed by Accel, Salesforce, and Atlassian.

Our Mission:

To make recurring work fun, fast, and faultless for teams everywhere.

Our culture:

Process Street was founded on a strong belief in the work-life benefits of a healthy, collaborative remote culture. We value flexibility because many of us are parents, travelers, or just creatives who aren't inspired by the construct of a mundane 9-to-5. Spread across 9 different time zones, we communicate asynchronously, work autonomously, and take real ownership of our work. We know human connections are what make teams strong, so we regularly do coffee chats, game-playing, story-telling, and more, to build strong relationships.

If you’re entrepreneurial and seek an environment that values impact, ownership, and flexibility we look forward to meeting you!

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help architect and evolve Process Street into an AI-native product and engineering organization.

This is not a traditional “just ship tickets” role. We’re looking for someone who is deeply comfortable working in multi-session coding environments, leveraging tools like Claude Code, Codex, and other agentic workflows to design, build, and iterate faster than conventional development allows.

You’ll operate at the intersection of:

  • Product engineering (React / Scala / APIs)
  • AI-assisted development systems
  • Internal tooling, agents, and developer workflows

You’ll help us rethink how software is built - from how code is written, to how systems evolve, to how teams collaborate with AI.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect and evolve backend systems (Scala / Play / Postgres / AWS)
  • Design and deploy scalable APIs and AI-assisted services
  • Own feature development from end 2 end (ideation to production)
  • Build frontend features using React, Chakra, Storybook, and modern state tools
  • Develop and maintain agent-driven development workflows
  • Use tools like Claude Code / Codex to accelerate implementation, debugging, and refactoring across multiple sessions in parallel
  • Create internal tooling, prompts, and “engineering systems” that improve velocity and code quality
  • Optimize performance across frontend, backend, and AI-assisted pipelines
  • Help define best practices for AI-native software development
  • Eventually lead a small team (2–3 engineers) and shape how they work with AI

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong experience with backend systems (Scala, or Java / Ruby / C#)
  • Strong experience with JavaScript and React
  • Experience building and scaling SaaS products
  • Deep familiarity with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.)
  • Comfort working across multi-session, agent-driven workflows
  • Strong intuition for when to rely on AI vs. manual implementation
  • Experience designing systems, not just implementing features
  • Excellent written communication (async-first culture)

About You

  • You live in a timezone between UTC -6 to UTC+2 (North American Central Time through Central European Summer Time).
  • You think of coding as a collaboration with AI, not a solo activity
  • You’re a Claude Code / Codex power user - you understand configuration deeply, know how to structure contexts, and can reliably steer long-running coding sessions
  • You’ve experimented with or built:
    • Custom dev workflows using LLMs
    • Internal tools, prompts, and “skills” for engineering
    • Agent-like systems that operate across files, repos, or tasks
  • You’re comfortable jumping between:
    • Writing code
    • Designing systems
    • Prompting / guiding AI agents
    • Debugging AI-generated output
  • You care about leverage. Getting more done with smarter workflows, not just more effort.
  • You want agency. PMs provide a problem statement and some guidelines – no tickets, no detailed specs, no high-fidelity solutions, and no estimates. Designers and engineers are trusted to craft the best solution possible in the cycle using user research, data, experience, and grit. During the 2-week cooldowns, you have the autonomy to work on what's important to you – including code maintainability or making the team faster. If a lot of responsibility, freedom, and ambiguity sounds refreshing, this role is for you.
  • You love the process but loathe meetings, bureaucracy, and ceremony. We think process is a tool. Used well, it makes us a better, faster team. But when it's not doing that, we drop it. We avoid unnecessary meetings whenever possible. A typical week for our engineers and designers has fewer than 5 hours of meetings.
  • You want to have a big impact. We're a small team, and we're still at an early stage. We don't have designated areas of responsibility, and everyone wears the product hat. Every cycle brings new challenges, and your sphere of influence is wide. You love the variety and don't want to be shackled to a single project for years.

How We Work

We follow the Shape Up process:

  • 6-week cycles: solve problems, not tickets
  • 2-week cooldowns: improve systems, tooling, or explore ideas

This role is a strong fit if you:

  • Thrive in ambiguity and autonomy
  • Prefer ownership over instructions
  • Care about shipping real outcomes
  • Want to rethink how product and engineering are done in an AI-first world

Tech Stack

  • Backend: Scala 3 / Play 3, Postgres, Redis
  • Frontend: React, Redux, React Query, Chakra, XState
  • Infra: AWS, Docker, CircleCI
  • AI Workflow: Claude Code, Codex, agent-based tooling (evolving rapidly)

What Makes This Role Different

This is not just a “use AI to go faster” role.

You’ll help define:

  • How engineers collaborate with AI
  • How codebases are structured for agent interaction
  • How workflows evolve when AI is a first-class participant

Bonus Points

  • Experience with functional programming
  • Experience building internal dev tools or platforms
  • Experience designing prompt systems or reusable AI workflows
  • Opinions about how coding will change in the next 3–5 years (and the ability to act on them)

Our Benefits

  • “No Meeting” Fridays!
  • Unlimited PTO policy – Most take 3-4 weeks, plus their major holidays, AND a company-wide week off in December.
  • Company offsite – We get together as a whole company to celebrate company milestones as well as encourage and sponsor small group meetups so that you can meet your teammates face-to-face around the world.
  • Social time – We know human connections are what make teams strong. We regularly do coffee chats, game-playing, story-telling, house tours (only if you're comfortable), and more to build connections.
  • Generous health insurance – for US employees and their families, including dental and vision plans.
  • Equity for all full-time roles.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Process Street is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

We welcome remote candidates based in the continental United States


Merkle is a leading data-driven, technology-enabled, global performance marketing agency that specializes in the delivery of unique, personalized customer experiences across platforms and devices. For more than 30 years, Fortune 1000 companies and leading nonprofit organizations have partnered with Merkle to maximize the value of their customer portfolios.


The agency’s heritage in data, technology, and analytics forms the foundation for its unmatched skills in understanding consumer insights that drive people-based marketing strategies. Its combined strengths in performance media, customer experience, customer relationship management, loyalty, and enterprise marketing technology drive improved marketing results and competitive advantage. With 16,000+ employees, Merkle is headquartered in Columbia, Maryland, with additional offices in the US, Europe, and Asia. In 2016, the agency joined the Dentsu Aegis Network.


Job Description


Merkle is seeking a strategic business leader with Adobe Experience Cloud expertise and martech ecosystem knowledge to join the AI Advisory, Enterprise Transformation practice as a Sr. Director, Lead Strategist. This individual will operate at the executive level, combining organizational transformation expertise, change management rigor, and value-driven advisory to anchor the program's strategic direction and drive enterprise client outcomes.


The Lead Strategist is a program-level leadership role operating across two distinct dimensions: as the primary strategic advisor on a large enterprise account and as a senior thought partner providing coverage and oversight across all delivery pods and resourcing groups within a broader client engagement. This individual bridges strategic vision with tactical execution, ensuring the program delivers measurable business value while building client-side organizational capability.


The role combines the advisory mindset of organizational transformation consulting with hands-on accountability for client value realization. There are no immediate direct reports for this role, but the Lead Strategist operates with influence across program leadership, delivery teams, and client stakeholder groups, carrying full ownership of strategic planning and change enablement.

Key Responsibilities


The responsibilities below span strategic advisory, program leadership, and direct enterprise account engagement, reflecting the full lifecycle of client transformation from discovery through sustained value realization.


  • Lead strategic consulting engagements that assess organizational readiness, operating model design, ways of working, governance, and change management within large-scale enterprise transformation initiatives and programs

  • Design governance structures to clarify roles, decision rights, and accountability in transformation programs
  • Serve as a bridge between strategic vision and tactical execution workstreams
  • Develop trusted advisor relationships with client senior executives to influence strategic investments and business decisions
  • Partner with Merkle pods / delivery teams in identifying business value drivers / frameworks that measure impact of agentic technology enablement initiatives
  • Partner with Merkle Innovation Lab Product Owner and Multi-Solution Architect roles on delivery engagements
  • Partner with Merkle business units, sales, growth and account management functions to support expansion and growth opportunities on strategic accounts

  • Bachelor’s Degree required. Master’s degree preferred
  • 15+ years of consulting experience in business transformation, organizational change leadership, and/or integrated marketing strategy, with demonstrated executive-level client management
  • 10+ years working in a top tier consulting firm and/or marketing agency
  • Deep knowledge of end-to-end consulting approaches to solve client problems, from strategy design through execution.
  • Strong experience assessing and recommending optimal team and operating structures to facilitate integrated program execution
  • Familiarity with change management frameworks, shared services models, organizational design, product and portfolio governance
  • Understanding of marketing technologies to orchestrate and activate customer experiences
  • Experience in leading a team and navigating complex projects by providing innovative, actionable solutions
  • Proven experience in developing solutions to support the sale of new services to clients.
  • Strong writing, presentation, and client facing communication skills
  • Problem solving mindset, thrive in ambiguous and fast moving environments, and in informal, loosely structured and creative work environments
  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience distilling complex, multi-threaded engagements into clear executive narratives
  • Familiarity and working knowledge of Adobe platforms and agentic solutions (strongly preferred)

jobs.description:
NVIDIA’s DGX Cloud organization is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to become part of its data team! We develop the reliable data foundation that supports fleet health, capacity, utilization, cost, reliability, and operational decision-making throughout DGX Cloud. Our platform supports engineering, operations, finance, and product teams managing and expanding large GPU fleets across cloud service providers and NVIDIA Cloud Partners. We are looking for a practical engineer and technical lead to take charge of a key part of the Navigator data platform. We develop the systems that transform distributed infrastructure telemetry and operational data into dependable, managed data products that support fleet health, capacity, utilization, cost, and operational decisions.

You will be responsible for the architecture, technical plan, and production results of a major platform area like ingestion and orchestration, data quality and reconciliation, or data serving and consumption. You will clarify requirements with customers, define technical objectives, guide design and development among engineers and partner teams, and stay actively engaged in coding, debugging, and production tasks. Successful candidates have already led complex technical work across team boundaries and delivered improvements that other groups adopted. Our primary implementation environment is Python, SQL, Databricks, and Spark.

What you’ll be doing:

  • You will own a major platform component and its roadmap. For example, define its architecture, interfaces, technical goals, and evolution. Anticipate capacity, compatibility, and operational needs over a multi-year horizon, and translate them into achievable breakthroughs that balance immediate delivery with long-term maintainability.

  • Lead technical delivery across teams. Work with customers and interested parties to clarify vague requirements. Break down design and implementation work for contributing engineers. Establish release turning points and manage dependencies and delivery risks. Guide the work process, revise plans when requirements shift, and keep management and partner teams informed and aligned.

  • Build data pipelines and products. Plan and carry out batch and streaming ingestion, transformation, reconciliation, and serving processes for fleet, capacity, utilization, cost, scheduling, and operational telemetry. Establish data models and agreements that remain stable as sources, consumers, and scale progress.

  • Develop shared platform capabilities. Direct the creation and adoption of libraries, workflow and DAG or comparable experience abstractions, deployment tools, and standard implementation approaches. Partner with related teams to solve shared challenges and evaluate progress in onboarding time, engineering effort, reliability, and cost.

  • Lead complex production investigations. Serve as the technical point of accountability for issues spanning pipelines, applications, SQL engines, Spark, storage, networks, and cloud services. Coordinate investigations across owners, drive resolution of release blockers and critical issues from partners, and implement preventive measures.

  • Define quality, security, and operational expectations. Establish and implement testing, data-quality, reconciliation, lineage, SLO, and release-readiness standards for your platform area. Partner with security and infrastructure teams on trust boundaries, service identities, least privilege, secrets, environment isolation, and auditability, and drive adoption across contributing teams.

  • Make trusted data usable. Deliver well-modeled tables, APIs, automation, dashboards, and focused internal applications. Align with consumers on semantics, access patterns, freshness, compatibility, and ownership so that shared capabilities support dependable operational decisions.

  • Provide technical leadership through others. Guide design reviews, mentor engineers taking on larger ownership, and resolve technical disagreements using evidence and clear tradeoffs. Partner with leadership on priorities and explain how technical investments support DGXC objectives.

What we need to see:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience), and at least 12+ years of equivalent experience

  • A sustained record of building and operating production software, data platforms, databases, or distributed systems. This includes owning a major component or complex project from requirements and architecture through release and ongoing operation.

  • Proven ability to outline a component’s technical plan, establish objectives for engineers, assign design and implementation tasks, and guide delivery within your team and nearby teams with little supervision.

  • Extensive practical experience in one or more of these areas: distributed processing using Spark or a similar system; relational, distributed, or analytical databases; production ETL, change-data capture, streaming, or event handling; or backend and cloud platforms managing large data volumes. You must grasp the interfaces and failure modes of nearby layers thoroughly to inform solid architectural choices.

  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals and production proficiency in Python or another backend or systems language, with the ability and willingness to work primarily in Python and SQL. Experience designing reusable abstractions, reviewing substantial changes, and personally implementing and debugging critical code paths.

  • Strong SQL and data-modeling skills, with practical depth in query execution, incremental processing, schema evolution, consistency, and analytical consumption. Ability to reason about idempotency, replay, late-arriving data, partial failure, and correctness across system boundaries.

  • Experience leading complex investigations involving multiple components and teams. Ability to use logs, metrics, traces, query plans, profiles, and controlled experiments to establish root cause, coordinate resolution, and prevent recurrence.

  • Demonstrated architectural judgment: evaluating alternatives, anticipating future requirements, and balancing reliability, performance, cost, security, compatibility, and maintainability. Experience leading significant migrations or architectural changes while preserving production service.

  • Experience establishing production quality and operational practices that other engineers adopt, including testing, CI/CD, monitoring, alerting, rollback, incident response, and secure deployment.

  • Proven success in influencing technical decisions without official authority, advising engineers outside your immediate project, and advancing workflow improvements across closely related teams. Ability to simplify complex issues, offer a course of action, and communicate decisions and delivery risks clearly.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Proven expertise in building, refining, and running Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, or Unity Catalog workloads along with shared platform features.

  • Experience designing and operating Kafka or comparable streaming systems, including partitioning, consumer behavior, offset management, backpressure, replay, and schema compatibility.

  • Experience scaling, migrating, or tuning relational, distributed, time-series, object-storage, or information retrieval systems, including Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.

  • Background operating compute or GPU clusters, or working with Kubernetes, Slurm, cloud infrastructure, and fleet telemetry across AWS, Azure, GCP, or other providers.

  • Experience building production agentic systems or agent harnesses, including tool integration, context management, evaluation, permissions, observability, and failure recovery. Evidence of measurable improvements in engineering productivity or operational outcomes.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

jobs.description:
BrightHire is a category-creating, high-growth, Series B software company with a mission to give everyone the hiring experience they deserve.

We deliver on this mission by transforming the way many of the world’s leading companies build exceptional teams. We created the Interview Intelligence category, and our clients include some of the world’s most innovative companies—Canva, OpenAI, Ramp, Hubspot—up to the Fortune 500.

The Role

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead some of BrightHire’s most consequential product initiatives, like major growth bets and new SKUs.

This is a high-judgment, hands-on role for an experienced leader. You’ll work across zero-to-one and scaling efforts: defining new AI-powered workflows, improving products used by hiring teams every day, and helping establish the product and technical foundations for BrightHire’s system of action for hiring.

You should be able to quickly understand the market and customer problems, separate the most impactful opportunities from the rest, conceive new solutions, and drive high-velocity, high-quality execution.

We’re also seeking someone who has personally built AI products – not simply worked adjacent to them. You understand model capabilities and limitations, prompts, evaluation, and the details that turn an AI prototype into a product customers trust and use with the right UX/UI and workflows.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead major product initiatives from customer discovery through launch, adoption, and iteration—including zero-to-one work in ambiguous, fast-moving areas.
  • Set a clear product direction and make high-quality prioritization decisions amid incomplete information.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Design to build excellent AI products, getting hands-on with model behavior, prompts, context, human-in-the-loop design, evaluation, quality, and reliability.
  • Work directly with customers and prospects to validate problems and solutions, then turn insight into differentiated products.
  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Zoom teams to bring products to market and drive measurable customer value.
  • Define success metrics, use qualitative and quantitative signals to improve the product, and raise the bar for product judgment and AI craft across the team.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, AI, or high-growth environments.
  • Hands-on experience shipping generative AI products or agentic systems, including prompt and context design, evaluation, output quality, and user trust.
  • A track record of independently taking consequential products from early concept to successful customer adoption.
  • Strong product judgment: you can separate compelling AI demos from durable customer value and make difficult tradeoffs well.
  • Technical fluency and the ability to partner deeply with engineers on AI systems, quality, and reliability.
  • Exceptional customer instincts, with a high bar for craft, usability, and product quality.
  • Clear, influential communication across executives, technical teams, customers, and go-to-market partners.
  • Comfort operating with urgency and ambiguity while bringing clarity and focus to others.

Nice to have

  • Experience in recruiting, HR technology, workflow software, communications, or enterprise AI.
  • Experience building products that integrate with platforms such as ATSs, collaboration tools, or enterprise systems.
  • Experience working in a startup or leading zero-to-one products within a larger organization.

Why BrightHire

BrightHire is operating with the focus and customer intimacy of a category-defining product team, with the reach and advantages of Zoom behind us. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a major new product category, work directly with customers, and build products that can reach hiring teams at global scale.

You’ll join a team that cares deeply about the quality of the products we build and the experiences we create for candidates, hiring teams, and one another.

Compensation and Benefits

This role is eligible for Zoom’s compensation and benefits programs. The expected base salary range for this position is between $175,000 and $220,000 plus applicable bonus and equity opportunities. Actual compensation will depend on factors including experience, location, and job-related skills.

Company Overview:

Lightspeed is the leading provider of cloud-based software for dealerships, serving the Powersport, Marine, RV, Trailer, and Golf Car industries adding hundreds of dealerships to the Lightspeed community each year.
Lightspeed’s Dealer Management Solution (DMS) enables dealerships to optimize their end-to-end business operations, including Sales, Parts, Service, Rentals, Payments, Accounting, and Customer Relationship Management (CRM). When implemented into their daily operations, Lightspeed helps dealers increase their profitability by selling more units, service, and parts, all while creating a more streamlined experience for customers.
Lightspeed is the most complete and integrated DMS in the industry with over 500 integrations with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), aftermarket parts and accessory distributors and dozens of other software tools that a dealership may use to run their business. Uniquely designed by dealers for dealers, and refined over the past 4 decades, Lightspeed empowers over 4,500+ dealers across North America with the tools and technology they need to manage their dealerships.

As a Salesforce Developer, you will be a key technical contributor responsible for designing, building, and maintaining custom solutions within our Salesforce org. You will partner with Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Finance, and Product teams to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical implementations — spanning custom Apex development, Flow automation, and integrations across our DMS ecosystem. Your work will directly shape our ability to deliver exceptional customer experiences, support subscription and contract lifecycle management, and drive operational excellence as Lightspeed continues its growth trajectory. This is both a developer and a systems-ownership role: you will not just build features but be accountable for the health, performance, and governance of our Salesforce environment.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy custom Apex classes, triggers, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Aura components to meet evolving business needs.
  • Build and maintain scalable automation using Flow Builder, Process Builder, and Workflow Rules, with a preference for declarative solutions where appropriate.
  • Participate in Agile development cycles, contributing to sprint planning, code reviews, and
    release management.
  • Implement and maintain deployment pipelines using Salesforce DX, GitHub, and CI/CD
    frameworks such as Copado or Gearset.
  • Maintain a comprehensive test suite (minimum 80% Apex code coverage) and manage sandbox
    strategy for development, UAT, and staging environments.
  • Oversee daily operations of the Salesforce org, including user setup, profiles, permission sets,
    role hierarchy, and field-level security.
  • Maintain and enhance page layouts, custom objects, record types, validation rules, and sharing
    settings to support business function changes.
  • Conduct regular performance audits, security reviews, and data quality checks; enforce data
    governance and deduplication standards.
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases (3x per year), evaluate new features, and implement
    relevant updates with appropriate regression testing.
  • Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of all configurations, customizations, integrations, and
    architectural decisions.
  • Own and extend Lightspeed’s Salesforce integration architecture, ensuring reliable data flow

    across connected systems including:

    ◦ NetSuite (ERP & financial data)

    ◦ Certinia (Professional Services Automation)
    ◦ NICE CXOne (Contact Center)
    ◦ DocuSign (Contract execution)
    ◦ Conga Composer (Document generation)
    ◦ Enablix (Sales enablement)
    ◦ Qualtrics (Customer feedback)
    ◦ FormAssembly (Data collection)
    ◦ Avonni (UI/UX components)

  • Evaluate, install, and configure third-party AppExchange applications to extend Salesforce
    functionality in alignment with business priorities.
  • Build and maintain REST/SOAP API integrations with internal and external platforms.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Finance, and Product teams to gather
    requirements and deliver solutions that scale with the business.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship on Salesforce best practices across teams.
  • Support end-user training and adoption initiatives, creating documentation and enablement
    materials as needed.

What You'll Bring:
Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on Salesforce development and administration experience in a fast-
    paced SaaS or technology company.
  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ or Revenue Cloud for subscription, quoting, and contract
    lifecycle management.
  • Active Salesforce certifications: Salesforce Administrator and Salesforce Platform Developer I.
  • Proficiency in Apex, SOQL, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC), with strong understanding of governor limits and Salesforce architecture.
  • Experience with Salesforce DX and source-driven development workflows (version control with Git, scratch orgs, unlocked packages).
  • Demonstrated ability to design and build REST/SOAP API integrations between Salesforce and third-party platforms.
  • Solid understanding of the Salesforce Security Model: profiles, permission sets, field-level security, sharing rules, and OWD.
  • Strong data modeling skills, including custom object design, lookup/master-detail relationships, and schema planning.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools for Salesforce deployments (e.g., Copado, Gearset, or GitHub Actions with SFDX).
  • Excellent problem-solving, prioritization, and project management skills in a dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills; comfortable working cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Additional certifications: Salesforce Platform Developer II, JavaScript Developer I, or Data Architect.
  • Familiarity with the dealer, automotive, powersports, marine, or equipment industries.
  • Experience in a B2B SaaS company with recurring revenue models.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more of our key integrated platforms: NetSuite, Certinia, NICE CXOne, DocuSign, Conga Composer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or

    equivalent practical experience.

Pay transparency is a key component of this commitment, ensuring that potential candidates have a clear understanding of the compensation they can expect.
