jobs.excerpt: Senior Product Marketing Manager, AI InferenceWEKA is the AI data and memory infrastructure company transforming how organizations build, run, and scale AI.
jobs.description:
Senior Product Marketing Manager, AI Inference

WEKA is the AI data and memory infrastructure company transforming how organizations build, run, and scale AI. NeuralMesh™ combines high-performance data storage and extended GPU memory in a single software platform, providing a foundation for training, inference, and agentic AI workloads that maximizes GPU productivity, accelerates AI outcomes, and improves the economics of AI at scale.

WEKA is a pre-IPO, growth-stage company backed by world-class venture capital investors and AI infrastructure leaders. Our technology is trusted by 30% of the Fortune 50, as well as leading hyperscalers, neoclouds, AI builders, and research organizations. Our team is customer-obsessed, accountable, bold, and collaborative, with a shared focus on helping customers succeed. If we sound like your kind of people, join us!

About The Role

WEKA is seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to help define and build our AI inference business, one of the fastest-moving and most consequential markets in technology. You'll own WEKA's inference proposition for the organizations that run inference at scale, including the AI clouds and service providers that deliver it to others.

This is an early-stage product marketing role focused on a market, not a single product. You'll define how WEKA wins in inference across the full NeuralMesh portfolio. That starts with Augmented Memory Grid, which extends GPU memory and changes the economics of serving models at scale, and extends to NeuralMesh Axon, model-weight loading and checkpointing, and agentic data services. You'll help decide where WEKA should focus, who we build for, and what makes us different by discovering what customers need, testing positioning in the market, and turning what works into proof and a go-to-market motion that can scale.

Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing, you'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Alliances, and Marketing, and alongside WEKA's Platform, Technical, Partner, Compete, and Industry product marketers. You'll also work directly with the early customers and design partners who run inference at scale: AI-native companies and model builders, enterprises putting AI into production, and the AI clouds and service providers that deliver inference to others.

Who We're Looking For

You're a product marketer who loves the early stage. You'd rather help shape a new market proposition and find the path to scale than optimize a playbook that's already working. You combine strong product marketing fundamentals with the technical depth to understand how inference really works: serving frameworks, KV cache, GPU memory hierarchies, time-to-first-token, multitenant GPU infrastructure, and the tradeoffs that set cost per token. You can go deep with an ML infrastructure engineer in the morning and build an economic argument for a CFO in the afternoon.

You're a builder who is comfortable with a blank page and an evolving answer. You treat positioning, segments, and use cases as hypotheses to test, not conclusions to defend, and you change direction quickly when the evidence says to. You're an excellent writer and storyteller who can turn an early customer result into proof, and you'd rather show specific numbers and named customers than make broad claims.

You also know that positioning only matters if it helps find and win the right customers. You stay close to customers, Product, and the market, and you watch how inference architectures, buyers, competitors, and budgets are changing. You measure success by early customer impact and by building the repeatable motion that follows.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Inference Positioning & Messaging: Define WEKA's positioning, messaging, value propositions, priority use cases, and competitive differentiation for AI inference across the portfolio. Treat them as hypotheses at first, and sharpen them into one differentiated proposition as patterns emerge.
  • AI Cloud & Service Provider Proposition: With Partner PMM, own the core proposition for AI clouds and cloud providers that serve inference. This includes multitenancy, Kubernetes-based operations, and the cross-cloud capabilities that make WEKA the storage standard for the category. You own the capability story that spans many clouds; Partner PMM leads joint propositions built with a named cloud partner.
  • Design Partners & Early Customers: Work with Product and Sales to find, recruit, and support design partners and early adopters, and learn from every engagement.
  • Inference Economics: Define and quantify WEKA’s economic value across GPU utilization, time-to-first-token, throughput, concurrency, tokens per GPU, and cost per token. Build the economic case customers need to justify investment.
  • Proof & Evidence: Partner with Technical Marketing, Engineering, and early customers to turn benchmarks and first production deployments into credible proof.
  • Shape the Product: Act as a strategic partner to Product in building the product that will win in AI inference. Bring customer and market evidence into decisions about which inference bets to pursue, what to build, and for whom.
  • Test, Launch, and Learn: Lead product marketing for new inference capabilities, integrations, and solutions. Test positioning, segments, use cases, and packaging with customers and the field, and use each launch to build market presence and sharpen the story.
  • Create High-Impact Content: Personally develop inference content including blogs, web pages, solution briefs, presentations, and customer stories that bring the story to life.
  • Build the Path to Scale: As winning patterns emerge, turn them into repeatable sales plays, discovery guides, objection handling, and enablement that help Sales, Solutions Engineering, and partners win.
  • Be an External Voice: Represent WEKA's inference story with customers, analysts, press, and industry audiences through briefings, events, and thought leadership.
  • Measure Impact: Track early signals of product-market fit, including a validated ideal customer profile, design partner engagement, lighthouse customers in production, and win rates in target segments. Build toward pipeline and revenue contribution.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in product marketing, product management, solution marketing, or a closely related role in enterprise technology.
  • Demonstrated experience taking a new product, category, market proposition, or business from early stage to traction, at a startup or as a new venture inside a larger company.
  • Strong product marketing fundamentals across customer discovery, positioning and messaging, content development, launches, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Working knowledge of AI inference and the infrastructure behind it, including accelerated computing, model serving, GPU memory, data infrastructure, and the performance and cost dynamics of running models in production.
  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand infrastructure architectures, benchmarks, and product capabilities, then translate them into clear customer value for technical and business audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to build quantified economic value arguments such as TCO, ROI, or cost-per-unit models, and defend them with technical and executive audiences.
  • Exceptional writing, storytelling, and presentation skills, with demonstrated experience personally creating high-quality content such as solution briefs, presentations, web content, blogs, whitepapers, sales tools, or similar assets.
  • Proven ability to work directly with product managers, engineers, sales teams, and customers, and turn input from multiple stakeholders into a clear point of view and high-quality deliverables.
  • Experience marketing to AI-native companies, ML/AI platform teams, cloud or service providers, or enterprise infrastructure buyers is a strong plus.
  • Ability to operate effectively as a senior individual contributor, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution and moving quickly from idea to finished work.
  • Strong, evidence-driven business judgment, with the ability to prioritize the work most likely to validate the market and drive early traction.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by a market and product strategy that can evolve quickly as WEKA learns.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical or business field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Located in North America with the ability to travel up to 25%.

How We Work: The WEKA Way

  • We are Accountable: We take full ownership, always, even when things don't go as planned. We lead with integrity, show up with responsibility and ownership, and hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards.
  • We are Brave: We question the status quo, push boundaries, and take smart risks when needed. We welcome challenges and embrace debates as opportunities for growth, turning courage into fuel for innovation.
  • We are Collaborative: True collaboration isn't only about working together. It's about lifting one another up to succeed collectively. We are team-oriented and communicate with empathy and respect. We challenge each other, resolve conflict constructively, and are transparent about our goals and the results we achieve. Together, we're unstoppable.
  • We are Customer Centric: Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We actively listen and prioritize their success, and every decision we make is driven by how we can better serve, support, and empower them to succeed. When our customers win, we win.

Concerned you don't meet every qualification? Don't let it stop you from applying!

Studies have shown that traditionally underrepresented groups may be less likely to apply for jobs if they don't meet every qualification specified. WEKA is committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you are excited about this position but are concerned your past work experience doesn't match up perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles at WEKA.

WEKA is an equal opportunity employer that prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Job Title: Director of Social Media

Department: Communications

Location: Washington, DC; Oakland, CA; or remote

Supervises: Up to 6 employees

Context: At the Sierra Club, we believe in the power of interdependence. Together, we remain committed to the fight for a healthy climate built on a foundation of environmental, racial, economic, and gender justice – a future where all people benefit from a healthy, thriving planet and a direct connection to nature. As the climate crisis and deeply entrenched systemic racism all fuel injustice, we will continue to fight for a bold, transformational agenda that recognizes the interconnectedness between our planet, our humanity, and our future. By recognizing that our destinies are tied, we continue to name that all things are fundamentally connected, and the overlap between ecology, race, gender, and representative government will move to either advance our collective humanity or to oppress it. Sierra Club has close to 700 staff across the country and a network of 64 local chapters that are led and fueled by thousands of volunteers. We are also proud to be a unionized employer, with three labor unions representing more than half of our employees.

Scope: The Director of Social Media is a strategic, creative leader who shapes how Sierra Club shows up on social media. They do this by leveraging data and audience segmentation and combining an understanding of the latest social trends and creative content to tell a cohesive public narrative, generate concrete campaign wins, and foster meaningful engagement. This position requires a proven track-record of managing people, projects, and platforms to achieve successful outcomes around list growth and retention, campaigning and organizing, culture change, fundraising, and brand objectives.

This person must be comfortable working in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment and managing a small team within a much larger group of stakeholders. The Director of Social Media will advocate for the strategies and build and manage the systems, processes, and standards that enable effective social media collaboration across the organization. They will serve as a strategic partner and educator to a variety of internal stakeholders, helping our colleagues understand how to work effectively with the Social Media team and support them in translating their expertise and priorities into compelling content for our social media audiences.

To be successful, the Director of Social Media will be on the leading edge of understanding social media trends, platforms, technologies, and marketing techniques; with a track record of using metrics to adapt these strategies and improve results. The ideal candidate will have an understanding of climate and environmental issues, tracking movement in narratives and cultural trends that can help the movement do the vital work of protecting people and planet while advancing solutions.

Job activities include but are not limited to:

    • Social Media Identity Development: Leads on the creative development and delivery of Sierra Club’s social media identity – including voice, visual style, creative content, and innovative platform strategies – in close partnerships with key cross-departmental stakeholders. They will also coach and advise regarding social strategy for key organizational leaders and stakeholders.

      • Creative and Reflexive Content Strategy: Stays nimble and on top of latest industry trends, breakthrough creative campaigns, pop culture, and current events – taking advantage of moments and trends in real-time. Balances multiple issues and shifting priorities to unify and strategically use our organizational voice(s) to respond to the world in real time. Diversifies content and leverages different social media platforms to develop visual and story-based content and market the organization, including its campaigns. Drives content strategies that foster meaningful engagement and a sense of community for both existing and expansion audiences.

        • Developing and Advancing the Team: Develops a team of strategists, creatives, and content developers, managing individuals to contribute at their highest level. Fosters a team culture of innovation, collaboration and accountability alongside concrete near-term and long-term strategic planning. Works to create professional development and project management opportunities for staff.

        • Programming: Sets and achieves programmatic goals through the integration of marketing functions, fundraising, storytelling, list growth, crisis response, influencer engagement and organizing tactics. Supports the development of data-informed strategies, tracking and reporting insights from audience segments, content and platform engagement, with monthly and quarterly social media reporting.

        • Process and Governance: Develops, adapts, and supports a governance structure for our social program; including social media processes for internal and external Sierra Club audiences and key stakeholders. Establishes and enforces content intake, scheduling and review processes. Trains internal staff, chapters, and volunteers on social media best practices and brand standards. Manages contracts and projects with external vendors.

          • This position directly relates to the 24-hour news cycle which will sometimes require weeknight and weekend hours.

A successful candidate must have the following skills and experiences:

    • A Do-er and a Director. You have experience doing top-to-bottom of what is required of a Social Media team; and have a demonstrated track record of both directing a team to successful outcomes, and rolling up your sleeves to do the work alongside of your team as needed.

      • Creative. Your social media and change-making strategies have been driven through innovative and story-based content. You’ve worked with organizations to develop their tone and identity to successfully carve out their niche in the world. And you have the technical skill and creative tool proficiencies to bring these stories to life.

      • Building a Program. You have the ability to build a social media program from top-to-bottom: A proven history of developing the processes and infrastructure needed to establish and grow a program; experience with developing and executing qualitative and quantitative data-informed strategies; success navigating competing priorities with internal and external stakeholders; and managing a team through the creation and execution of effective story-based content.

        • Leadership. You’ve had significant management experience with a demonstrated ability to effectively communicate, coach, and support teams in working effectively together. You’ve navigated complex organizational structures to facilitate collaborative partnerships between stakeholders to keep workflow consistent and shared goals attainable. You are familiar with creating governance structures for social programming and strategies for training and educating content creators on best practices and brand standards.

        • Social Technology. You have deep expertise with social media platforms e.g., Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, and Substack; with a history of adapting technology, tactics, metrics, and innovation in line with social trends. In addition, you have robust knowledge of social media scheduling, monitoring, analytics and reporting software.

        • Equity. You model effective equity analysis and practice and demonstrate a sophisticated understanding of how group dynamics impact supervisory relationships, organizational culture, partnerships, campaigns and coalition work. Your decision-making is consistent, intentional, and committed to creating equitable outcomes at all levels. You have led high-performing and leaderful teams across group identities. You intervene when challenging group dynamics play out, in ways that build understanding, trust, and deeper self-awareness of team members.

The strongest candidates will also demonstrate the following experience, skills and competencies:

    • Knows Our Work. You have experience in the environmental movement or social justice advocacy space: Campaigning, creating public demand for a policy, training volunteers, holding the decision makers accountable, and/or taking delivery on campaign goals. You are in tune with the communities we work with; able to leverage cultural trends to generate enthusiasm, growth, and real power; and be able to convey this information through various digital media platforms.

    • Influencer Partnerships. Influencer cultivation and partnership have been a core part of your past social media strategy and programmatic development. You come to this work with existing influencer partnerships, are in tune with the communities we work with, and will be able to leverage these collaborations and cultural trends to generate enthusiasm, growth, and real power.

    • Top-Notch Organization Skills. There’s a lot to keep track of in this role, and things cannot fall through the cracks. Managing multiple priorities, timeliness, and attention to detail is key, as is knowing when to ask for support.

To Apply

At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care through Counterpart Assistant, our technology platform for primary care. As Senior Manager of UX Design for the Interventions Pillar, you will lead the team designing how clinical insight becomes action. Your portfolio will include decision support, treatment planning, intervention selection, treatment execution, care coordination, and longitudinal follow-through.

You will manage talented, experienced designers who already understand our product, systems, and clinical users deeply. Your role is to help them expand their strategic ownership, make stronger decisions through ambiguity, influence across the organization, and define the future of their domains.

AI will be an important part of this work. You will guide teams in applying AI where it can help clinicians synthesize information, evaluate options, plan care, and follow through—while preserving appropriate evidence, transparency, and clinical control.

Why this role?

The Interventions Pillar addresses a central challenge in healthcare: identifying an opportunity is not enough. Better outcomes require translating insight into an appropriate decision, treatment plan, action, and durable follow-through.

This role is an opportunity to:
● Shape how Counterpart supports consequential clinical decisions and treatment workflows.
● Develop senior designers into stronger strategic and organizational leaders.
● Define how AI can responsibly assist clinical reasoning and action.
● Connect clinical expertise, product strategy, design, and technology around measurable outcomes.

As a Senior Manager, UX Design, you will:

  • Lead the clinical UX strategy. Establish a coherent direction across clinical decision support, treatment planning, intervention selection, execution, coordination, and longitudinal follow-through.
  • Develop senior design talent. Coach experienced designers to lead through ambiguity, define strategy, make high-quality trade-offs, influence senior stakeholders, and increase their impact beyond their immediate product areas.
  • Advance AI-enabled clinical workflows. Help teams determine where AI should synthesize information, generate options, recommend next steps, automate work, or remain out of the workflow. Establish expectations for evidence, uncertainty, human oversight, review, and correction.
  • Create strong cross-functional decisions. Partner with Clinical, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Research leaders to connect clinical needs, model capabilities, user evidence, technical constraints, and business priorities.
  • Raise the quality and effectiveness of execution. Strengthen critique, research synthesis, clinical review, prototyping, evaluation, and learning practices so teams can move efficiently without oversimplifying consequential problems.

Success in this role looks like:This leader will bring deep expertise in clinical-product design while creating strategic alignment and design leverage across the Interventions pods.

  • In the first 90 days, establish leadership and strategic alignment by building strong partnerships with product directors, ensuring balanced workloads, and embedding design as a critical part of business strategy. Success will be measured by stakeholder feedback, stronger design integration, and improved operational effectiveness.
  • In the first 6 months, focus on delivering impact by deepening user understanding, embedding research insights into design decisions, and pushing for best-in-class UX. Accelerate iteration cycles, reducing time-to-insight by 30%, while fostering a culture of experimentation and autonomy. Guide the team in complex problem-solving, balancing constraints, and proactively shaping solutions.
  • Beyond six months, scale strategic impact and industry influence by positioning design as a key business driver, ensuring UX directly contributes to engagement, provider adoption, and overall user experience. You will push for consumer-grade, next-gen experiences that redefine digital healthcare while strengthening team expertise, fostering strategic thinking, and elevating design’s role in product direction. Success will be measured by design’s ability to drive best-in-class UX, shape industry standards, and create tangible product improvements that shift user expectations.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have 7+ years of design experience in a design environment (in-house, agency, or relevant industry), with 5+ years of managing people.
  • You have led complex, high-consequence workflows in healthcare or another expert professional domain.
  • You bring strong judgment in interaction design, information design, research, and product strategy— and know how to coach others without taking over their work. You can demonstrate how you have helped experienced designers grow from strong executors into strategic decision-makers and organizational leaders.
  • You have experience with AI-enabled products or can demonstrate sound judgment about recommendations, automation, evidence, uncertainty, and human oversight.
  • You have experience in complex systems and applications, knowing how to simplify the complex and create delightful, intuitive experiences.
  • You are an advocate for collaboration, working closely with product and engineering to ensure design is a driver of business outcomes, not just execution.
  • You are excited about shaping the future of healthcare UX – bringing the same level of quality and innovation seen in leading consumer products to an industry that desperately needs it.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

jobs.excerpt: Na Neon, nossa missão é simplificar a vida financeira de milhões de brasileiros de forma segura, ágil e escalável.
jobs.description:
Na Neon, nossa missão é simplificar a vida financeira de milhões de brasileiros de forma segura, ágil e escalável. Para que possamos continuar crescendo e inovando sem limites, a nossa blindagem perimetral e arquitetura de redes em nuvem precisam ser impecáveis. Como Cloud Security Engineer Specialist, você será a liderança técnica responsável por desenhar, automatizar e sustentar a segurança de nossas redes e perímetros na nuvem (com foco massivo em AWS). O seu desafio será garantir a integridade de um ecossistema financeiro complexo utilizando o que há de mais moderno em soluções de borda (Palo Alto e Zscaler), atuando de forma estratégica e hands-on para guiar o nosso time em direção a um ambiente cada vez mais resiliente e seguro por design.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetura de Nuvem Segura: Desenhar, implementar e otimizar arquiteturas de rede seguras no ecossistema AWS, utilizando as melhores práticas de segmentação, isolamento e privilégio mínimo.
  • Gestão de Perímetro e SASE: Configurar, administrar e evoluir nossos firewalls de próxima geração (Palo Alto Networks / VM-Series) e nossas plataformas de acesso seguro e borda (Zscaler - ZIA/ZPA), liderando a estratégia de SASE/Zero Trust.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Desenvolver e manter nossa infraestrutura de rede e segurança de forma totalmente automatizada (Security as Code) utilizando Terraform, mitigando riscos e promovendo padronização.
  • Monitoramento e Resposta Ativa: Atuar na linha de frente para detectar, analisar e mitigar ameaças ou incidentes de segurança de rede em tempo real, implementando melhorias contínuas para blindar novos vetores de ataque.
  • Conformidade de Alto Nível: Garantir que todos os ambientes de rede em nuvem estejam em conformidade com as diretrizes internas de segurança e com frameworks regulatórios de mercado (PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks).
  • Disseminação de Cultura: Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico do time, mentorando engenheiros e analistas, e sendo a referência em Security by Design para desenvolvedores, POs e outras áreas de tecnologia.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Sólida experiência técnica atuando em Segurança de Redes e Cloud Security em ambientes complexos e escaláveis.
  • Domínio avançado do ecossistema de redes e segurança nativo da AWS (VPC, Security Groups, NACLs, Transit Gateway, Route 53, AWS WAF, Shield, GuardDuty e CloudTrail).
  • Prática consolidada na administração de firewalls de próxima geração Palo Alto Networks (VM-Series, Panorama).
  • Vivência técnica robusta com soluções de SASE/Zero Trust da Zscaler (Zscaler Internet Access - ZIA e Zscaler Private Access - ZPA).
  • Profundo conhecimento em fundamentos de redes: protocolos de roteamento dinâmico (BGP, OSPF), topologias de VPN (IPsec, SSL), modelo TCP/IP, OSI e análise avançada de pacotes.
  • Experiência prática na criação e manutenção de códigos de infraestrutura (IaC) utilizando Terraform.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento prático de segurança em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (Microsoft Azure ou Google Cloud Platform - GCP).
  • Experiência com plataformas modernas de CNAPP/CSPM (ex: Prisma Cloud, Wiz, Orca Security).
  • Certificações técnicas ativas, tais como:
  • AWS Certified Advanced Networking ou AWS Certified Security - Specialty.
  • Palo Alto Networks PCNSE.
  • Zscaler Certified Cloud Specialist (ZCCS).
  • Certificações de mercado agnósticas (CISSP, CCSP, CEH).

**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH **

Location: Remote

Salary Range:~$2,000–$2,500 USD per month
Schedule: Monday–Friday, typically 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET or CT
English Proficiency: Excellent written and spoken English required

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing professional community and membership organization serving thousands of accomplished entrepreneurs and founders who have successfully built and exited companies.

The organization creates meaningful connections and high-quality experiences through local chapters, curated groups, forums, events, workshops, and real-time community interaction.

The team operates with a high level of ownership, moves quickly, works remotely across time zones, and integrates AI deeply into day-to-day operations.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and relationship-oriented Community & Events Associate to help shape the day-to-day experience of a large and highly engaged founder community.

This role sits at the intersection of community management, content, communications, events, and program coordination.

You will own the content calendar, help determine what communications members receive and when, coordinate events and workshops from beginning to end, stay closely connected to conversations happening across the community, and help identify the topics, people, and opportunities that matter most.

This is a writing-heavy and execution-oriented role for someone who combines excellent communication skills with attention to detail, sound judgment, curiosity, and a genuine interest in people.

Why This Opportunity?

You'll have the opportunity to work closely with a community of thousands of experienced entrepreneurs and business leaders while having a meaningful impact on their member experience.

You'll also join a small, fast-moving remote team where:

  • You can take meaningful ownership early.
  • Your ideas and observations can directly influence programs and communications.
  • AI is actively used to make work faster and more effective.
  • You can see the measurable impact of the campaigns, events, and initiatives you manage.
  • There is significant room to grow based on your strengths and interests.

What You'll Do

Content & Communications

  • Own and maintain the community content and communications calendar, determining what goes out, when, and why.
  • Write, edit, and refine communications sent to members while maintaining a clear, natural, and consistent brand voice.
  • Build, test, and send email campaigns.
  • Select and manage appropriate audience segments for different communications.
  • Review campaigns carefully before launch, including links, formatting, dates, names, and other details.
  • Track campaign performance and identify what content and messages resonate most strongly with members.
  • Share insights and recommendations based on engagement and performance data.

Events & Programs

  • Coordinate virtual and occasional in-person events from planning through execution.
  • Create and manage registration pages, reminders, logistics, and event-day support.
  • Promote events to the most relevant members to drive attendance.
  • Coordinate speakers and workshops, including scheduling, confirmations, logistics, and run-of-show preparation.
  • Manage program communications including applications, deadlines, participant updates, and waitlists.
  • Follow up with attendees and participants after events.
  • Track which events, speakers, and topics perform best and use those insights to improve future programming.

Community Engagement

  • Stay closely connected to daily conversations happening within the community.
  • Develop a strong understanding of what members are discussing, asking about, celebrating, and struggling with.
  • Identify recurring themes, community wins, concerns, and opportunities for meaningful member connections.
  • Welcome new voices and help encourage thoughtful participation.
  • Provide first-line community moderation when needed.
  • Escalate situations requiring additional review or decisions to the appropriate internal team member.
  • Proactively identify members who may benefit from meeting or connecting with one another.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

You'll focus on understanding the community, its members, communication style, tools, and existing programs.

You'll begin supporting campaigns and events with guidance from the team.

By 60 Days

You'll independently manage much of the weekly communications calendar and take greater ownership of events and program execution.

By 90 Days

You'll have a strong pulse on the community and proactively surface what members need, what topics are gaining traction, and where the organization should focus next.

How We Work

AI-Assisted by Default

AI is an important part of the team's workflow.

You'll use AI tools to help with first drafts, summaries, reporting, research, organization, and repetitive tasks so that more of your time can be spent on judgment, relationships, creativity, and execution.

You should already be comfortable experimenting with AI tools and interested in becoming even better at using them.

Attention to Detail Matters

You'll be communicating with thousands of experienced founders and business leaders.

Small details matter.

You'll be expected to catch incorrect links, formatting issues, outdated dates, inconsistent names, typos, and other mistakes before anything is published or sent.

Async and Remote

The team works remotely across multiple time zones and communicates heavily in writing.

You'll be expected to:

  • Share updates proactively.
  • Flag blockers early.
  • Manage your time effectively.
  • Take ownership without waiting for constant direction.

Measure and Improve

Your work doesn't stop when a campaign is sent or an event ends.

You'll review what happened, understand what worked, identify what didn't, and help the team improve the next iteration.

Tools You May Use

The organization currently works with tools such as:

  • Customer.io or similar email marketing platforms
  • Event management platforms such as Luma
  • Notion
  • Google Workspace
  • Slack
  • WhatsApp
  • ChatGPT and other AI tools

You do not need previous experience with every tool listed above.

What matters most is your ability to learn new tools quickly and figure out how to use them effectively.

Required Qualifications

  • Excellent written English, with the ability to communicate naturally, clearly, and professionally.
  • Strong writing and editing skills.
  • Ability to adapt to an established brand voice rather than imposing your own writing style.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines, events, communications, and priorities simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Proactive working style: you identify what needs to happen and take action.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and genuine interest in building relationships.
  • Comfortable communicating with entrepreneurs, founders, executives, and senior professionals.
  • Strong judgment, discretion, and professionalism.
  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of your everyday workflow.
  • Ability to learn new software and systems quickly.
  • Willingness to communicate openly when blocked or when something requires additional attention.

Preferred Qualifications

These are helpful but not required:

  • Experience with Customer.io, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, HubSpot, Braze, or a similar email marketing platform.
  • Previous community management or moderation experience.
  • Experience managing communities through WhatsApp, Slack, or similar platforms.
  • Event coordination experience, either virtual or in person.
  • Experience supporting a founder, investor, executive, professional, or membership-based community.
  • Previous experience working remotely and in an asynchronous environment.
  • Experience tracking engagement metrics and using data to improve communications or programming.

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity for someone who wants more than a narrowly defined coordination role.

You'll have exposure to a highly accomplished entrepreneurial community while developing experience across:

  • Community building
  • Content and communications
  • Events and programming
  • Email marketing
  • Member engagement
  • AI-enabled workflows
  • Performance measurement
  • Relationship building

Because the team is small, strong performers will have opportunities to take on increasing responsibility and grow into the areas where they demonstrate the most strength.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

The Business Process Lead, Order to Cash owns the end-to-end design of the business processes that run from order acceptance through cash collection and recognized revenue. This role is the connective tissue between the business stakeholders who operate these processes and the technology teams that build supporting systems, and is accountable for the detailed capability decomposition of this value stream. Process design decisions in this role have direct consequences for billing accuracy, revenue recognition, and financial reporting integrity, and the role carries a corresponding financial control responsibility.

Importantly, this role owns the business capabilities in this value stream — their definition, design, decomposition, and governance — in close partnership with the business teams that operate the underlying functions day to day. It does not own those functions themselves; success depends on heavy partnership with business and technology leads rather than on direct authority. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role: the person hired personally facilitates working sessions, maps processes, writes requirements, and stays engaged through delivery and adoption. It also sits within a newly created function whose operating model and standards are still being defined, giving the person hired real influence over how the broader practice takes shape. The role holds several formal agreements with peer process owners covering shared boundaries, and maintaining those agreements is a core, ongoing part of the job rather than an occasional task.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and continuously maintain a detailed (L2/L3) decomposition of order and subscription management, software provisioning and fulfillment, usage consumption and rating, billing and invoicing, invoice-to-cash, and revenue recognition capabilities, keeping documentation accurate as the operating model and systems landscape evolve, and using standards shared across the Business Process Lead team.
  • Facilitate structured working sessions with business stakeholders across this value stream to document how processes work today and design how they should work going forward, producing process maps, documented decisions, and requirements a technical team can act on without extensive follow-up.
  • Translate future-state process designs into system requirements, partner with Product Owners and Engineering Leads through design, build, and testing, and confirm that what gets delivered reflects the intended process design.
  • Support two parallel delivery tracks — current, in-production systems and the next-generation platform build — correctly identifying which track an incoming request belongs to, and ensuring lessons learned in day-to-day operations are reflected back into documentation and forward-looking design work.
  • Own change management, enablement, and adoption for process changes in this value stream — stakeholder impact assessment, readiness planning, training materials, and post-launch verification that new processes are being used as intended — and define and report the process performance metrics that show whether they are working.
  • Hold and maintain documented agreements at shared boundaries with peer Business Process Leads, so handoffs between value streams are explicitly agreed rather than assumed.
  • Own the capability design for software provisioning and fulfillment — manual provisioning, provisioning error handling, feature enablement, software suspension and reinstatement, and trial extension — partnering with the teams who operate those processes.
  • Own the capability design for usage consumption and rating, including overage management and how rated usage flows into billing and revenue treatment.

Required Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of revenue recognition standards (ASC 606) and subscription billing mechanics, with the demonstrated ability to reason independently through how a mid-contract order change flows to invoicing, revenue schedules, and unbilled or deferred revenue balances. This is a firm screening requirement given the financial control responsibilities of the role, not a general preference.
  • 5+ years of experience in business process design, business analysis, business architecture, or operations in a relevant domain.
  • Demonstrated experience decomposing business capabilities into detailed, multi-level structures.
  • Strong facilitation skills with cross-functional business stakeholders, including experience working at a director level, and comfort holding formal cross-functional agreements with peer process owners rather than treating a boundary handoff as a one-time conversation.
  • Experience translating business process requirements into system requirements or work items for a technical delivery team, along with strong documentation habits.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with contract modification accounting and its process implications in a subscription business.
  • Billing operations, collections, or revenue accounting process design experience.
  • Experience with consumption or usage-based billing and rating models, including how overages are handled and billed.
  • Experience with software provisioning, license entitlement, or feature enablement process ownership.
  • Indirect tax process design experience, including taxability determination, nexus, and exemption certificate management.
  • Prior experience partnering with a shared platform engineering team on roadmap sequencing and prioritization.
  • Experience with Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced, a dedicated revenue recognition engine such as RightRev, Oracle and NetSuite, and indirect tax engines such as OneSource or CertifyTax.

Additional information

jobs.title: Director, GTM Enablement
jobs.excerpt: About Wunderkind:Wunderkind is a performance marketing solution that uses AI and data to help brands acquire and retain customers through one-to-one, personalized messages across websites, email, text, and ads, guaranteeing a lift in revenue.
jobs.description:
About Wunderkind:Wunderkind is a performance marketing solution that uses AI and data to help brands acquire and retain customers through one-to-one, personalized messages across websites, email, text, and ads, guaranteeing a lift in revenue. Founded in 2010, Our goal is to scale a brand’s ability to create and grow customer relationships through websites, email, text, and ads. We believe individuals should have the freedom to choose the kind of internet they want. An internet that fosters genuine relationships with brands. An internet that treats humans like real people instead of “web traffic.” We also believe in empowering brands to treat their customers as individuals, satisfying their unique needs with tailored experiences and thoughtful communication. By expertly personalizing, automating, and scaling beautiful one-to-one experiences, Wunderkind helps brands acquire new customers at scale and keep them loyal for life.

Role Overview

Are you a master translator who can take complex, deeply technical product blueprints and turn them into high-converting, value-driven GTM narratives? Do you love the science of learning but hate the slow, traditional bottlenecks of old-school L&D?

We are looking for a Director, GTM Enablement to bridge the gap between our Product engine and our commercial teams (primarily Sales & Customer Success). As a team of one, you won't just be managing a process; you will be architecting a scalable, AI-augmented enablement engine. You will partner closely with Product, Solution Consulting, and Product Marketing to ensure our GTM teams deeply understand our new products, technical capabilities, and real-world use cases.

This role is remote. Preferred location within Eastern US Timezone.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate Technical to Commercial: Convert complex product briefs and technical documentation into digestible, high-impact enablement programs and assets for Sales and CS.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the strategic connective tissue between Product, Solution Consulting, Strategy Consulting, and Product Marketing (PMM).
  • Program Design & Delivery: Apply strong L&D methodologies to design learning paths, certification programs, and interactive workshops that ensure product knowledge actually sticks.
  • Scale with AI: Act as a force multiplier. Because this is a standalone role, you will leverage AI tooling (LLMs, agentic solutions, and automation) to build content, generate training materials, and scale enablement across the organization.
  • Partner with Tech Experts: Work hand-in-hand with Solution Consultants to distill advanced technical features into clear, value-oriented customer use cases

What You Bring (Requirements)

  • Experience: 8+ years of relevant experience in GTM Enablement, Product Marketing, Technical Enablement, or a closely related L&D function.
  • SaaS Expertise (Strong Preference): A deep understanding of the fast-paced nature of SaaS environments, product release cycles, and commercial motions.
  • The "Product Whisperer" Gene: Proven ability to sit with engineers and product managers, understand the technical "how," and independently translate it into the commercial "why."
  • AI Literacy: Hands-on, practical experience using AI tools (e.g., advanced prompting, LLM workflows, agentic software) to automate content creation and scale your individual output.
  • L&D Mindset: A strong grasp of instructional design, modern adult learning principles, and how to measure enablement efficacy beyond just "completion rates."

Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves)

  • A sharp understanding of the priorities, KPIs, and pain points of Marketing Leaders (knowing what makes them tick helps you align our product value proposition to executive buyers).

What Success Looks Like in 60 Days: You have mapped out our upcoming product roadmap, and our past launches, established a seamless intake process with the Product and Solution Consulting teams, and deployed your first AI-assisted enablement sprint to the Sales and CS orgs.


The base salary range for this role is $140,000.00 to $160,000.00 in New York and California. Regional bands apply for other areas of the United States. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each specific candidate; including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, applicable certifications, and geographic work location. This may vary depending on living location and market rate.

jobs.excerpt: Why should you consider joining Auvik? • You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology.
jobs.description:
Why should you consider joining Auvik?

  • You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology. Auvik’s network management software helps IT teams by automating time-consuming tasks, streamlining operations, and mitigating risk. It’s more important than ever to be able to remotely monitor and manage network infrastructure, and with Auvik, IT professionals have that essential visibility and control.
  • You want to work with a leadership team who are transparent and trustworthy. Our senior leaders have a vision for Auvik. They are experienced, knowledgeable, approachable, and consistently working hard to drive success, both for the company and the team of people who make it happen.
  • You want to work with a product customers love. People rave about what we’ve built. Our customers are smart, aspirational, and highly technical. It pays to get the details right.
  • You want regular opportunities for learning and growth. With ongoing feedback from leadership, you’ll find that Auvik encourages you to be your very best. Our onboarding process is thorough and informative because we want to make sure you’re prepared to have a great work experience. We also have programs designed to help you take the next steps you want for your career.
  • You want the flexibility to manage your work, your way. We’re a fully distributed team and we’re prepared to continue to support working from home (or the space you choose!). We trust you to get the job done where you feel most comfortable and effective.


What’s this role about?

As our Payroll Accountant reporting to the Payroll Manager, you’ll help the finance team with the ongoing administration of Auvik’s payroll and accounting processes.

What will I be doing?

  • Payroll Processing: Administer semi-monthly payroll for Canada and the U.S., as well as monthly payroll for international locations.
  • Employee Support: Act as the primary point of contact for all payroll-related inquiries.
  • Data Management: Maintain and update payroll, incentive, and equity system records.
  • Reconciliations: Conduct routine payroll and benefits reconciliations to ensure accuracy and compliance.
  • Payroll Administration: Support the Payroll Manager with all areas of payroll administration, including: month-end processes, incentive calculations, stock option management, and common share administration.
  • Accounting & Reporting: Perform daily payroll accounting tasks, including posting general ledger entries, calculating stock compensation expenses, and managing fixed asset amortization.
  • Month-End Close: Prepare journal entries, accruals, and reconciliations while assisting with cost analysis.
  • Year-End Compliance: Assist with payroll year-end processes, including tax form preparation, reconciliation, and balancing.
  • Process Optimization: Identify and implement improvements to enhance payroll and accounting workflows.
  • Audit Support: Assist with annual audits to ensure compliance with financial regulations.
  • Ad Hoc Projects: Contribute to special projects as needed.

What are we looking for?

  • A few years of Canadian payroll experience (U.S. and international payroll experience is a plus).
  • Post-secondary degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience in corporate accounting, ideally in a multi-entity environment.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and payroll systems (Ceridian Dayforce preferred).
  • Strong time management, problem-solving, and analytical abilities.
  • Ability to effectively communicate at all levels of the organization, both verbally and in writing.
  • Capable of working independently and within cross-functional teams, managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Payroll Compliance Practitioner (PCP) certification or actively working toward it.

We’re actively hiring for this role and looking to bring someone great onto the team as soon as possible.

About Auvik

Auvik delivers cloud-based network management software that gives IT teams instant visibility and control over their infrastructure — whether on-site, remote, or dispersed across global networks. Our platform automates network discovery, mapping, monitoring, configuration backups, traffic analysis and alerting, so IT professionals and MSPs can manage complex, multi-site environments with ease.

We’re focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to make any accommodations you may need throughout the interview process as well.

Auvik is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

Hiring Process

At Auvik, our hiring process is designed to be personal, transparent, and human-led. Our Talent Acquisition Partners review all resumes, connect with candidates whose skills and experience aligns with the role, and stay in communication with you throughout your journey. If our interests align, you'll meet with a hiring manager, as well as additional members of the hiring team in follow-up conversations. All of your interviews will take place via Zoom.

Before meeting with a hiring manager, we also ask candidates to complete a 5-minute Predictive Index (PI) assessment. This helps us understand and match your strengths and work preferences with roles that will set you up for success.

We use AI tools to support administrative tasks in the hiring process; such as helping source candidates, drafting communications, and interview summaries, so our team can stay focused and present during conversations. We do not use AI tools to interview, screen or assess candidates; or determine who moves forward in the process. We debrief and consider the full context of every conversation before making hiring decisions. We believe hiring requires judgment that can be augmented but, not replaced by AI.

Compensation Details

At Auvik, our compensation philosophy is to be market competitive, reward performance, reflect our commitment to equity and maintain transparency with our employees. We have defined job levels and compensation ranges for each of our markets we employ, based on research from various sources of market data, which are reviewed on a regular basis.

The hiring range for this position is listed below. Compensation offered for candidates in this role is based on a number of factors including job-related skills, knowledge, and experience. These factors may cause your compensation to vary within the range outlined below.

In addition to cash compensation, all full-time employees are granted stock options to share in Auvik’s future successes. Auvik employees are eligible to participate in additional benefits and programs including our comprehensive health and dental benefits plan, Wellness spending account, GRSP matching program, flexible paid time off, paid parental leave program, and are eligible for remote working subsidies.

Salary Range:
$60,000—$78,000 CAD

We partner with organizations to design and deliver systems that streamline dispatch, asset management, field operations, and enterprise integrations. jobs.excerpt: CloudLinux is transforming the Linux infrastructure market by ensuring security and stability for over 500,000 servers worldwide.
jobs.description:
CloudLinux is transforming the Linux infrastructure market by ensuring security and stability for over 500,000 servers worldwide. Our products - CloudLinux OS, TuxCare, and Imunify360 - are the de facto standard in the hosting industry and Enterprise segment.

We are seeking a visionary engineer to lead the evolution of our data platform. In 2025, we are shifting from classic database administration to an Internal Database-as-a-Service (DBaaS) model. We need a specialist who doesn’t just "configure backups," but designs resilient distributed systems, writes code to automate infrastructure, and transforms databases into a reliable service for product teams.

If you are tired of endless tickets and want to build platforms capable of processing petabytes of data, this role is for you.

Your Challenges & Responsibilities:

  • DBaaS Architecture: Design and implement a self-service platform based on Terraform and Ansible, enabling the deployment of HA clusters (PostgreSQL and ClickHouse, MongoDB, Redis) in a heterogeneous environment (Bare Metal + OpenNebula + Kubernetes + Public Clouds). You will turn infrastructure into a product.
  • Scaling ClickHouse: Manage exponentially growing analytics clusters (12+ clusters, tens of terabytes of data). You will tackle sharding, table engine optimization (ReplicatedMergeTree), and building reliable S3 backup pipelines under high load.
  • Data Platform & Analytics Support: Maintain and scale the infrastructure for Apache Airflow and Redash. You will ensure the reliability of ETL pipelines and visualization tools, bridging the gap between raw infrastructure and the data analytics team.
  • Reliability as Code: Implement SRE practices in data management. Replace manual incident response with automated self-healing mechanisms. Define and implement SLO/SLI for all databases.
  • Stack Modernization: Lead the migration process from legacy solutions to modern cloud patterns. Participate in decision-making regarding the implementation of Kubernetes operators for stateful workloads.
  • Expertise & Mentorship: Serve as the technical authority for product teams, helping them optimize data schemas and SQL queries for high-load systems.

Our Tech Stack:

  • Databases: PostgreSQL 15+ (Patroni, PgBouncer), ClickHouse (Sharded/Replicated), MongoDB, Redis, Kafka
  • Data & Analytics: Apache Airflow, Redash (Infrastructure & Integration).
  • Infrastructure: Own 3+DC colocation (OpenNebula, Kubernetes, Bare Metal), AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, DO – Hybrid Cloud.
  • Automation & IaC: Terraform, Ansible, Python/Go, GitLab, Jenkins, Gerrit.
  • Observability: VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Loki.

Why CloudLinux?

  • Culture: A Remote-first company with an "Employees First" principle. We value results, not hours in the office.
  • Impact: Your architectural decisions will determine the stability of services used by thousands of companies around the world.
  • Growth: We support professional development and pay for training and conferences.

Requirements

What We Expect From You:

  • AI-Augmented Engineering: You don't view AI as a replacement for deep technical fundamentals, but as a high-leverage tool. We actively use AI agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini, etc.) to automate boilerplate, analyze complex logs, and speed up research. We expect you to be open to modern workflows and integrate AI into your day-to-day operations, allowing you to focus your brainpower on the true architectural challenges.
  • Deep PostgreSQL Expertise (5+ years): You know MVCC internals, understand locking mechanics, can configure Patroni and PgBouncer "with your eyes closed," and have experience with seamless major version upgrades under load.
  • ClickHouse Mastery: Experience operating large clusters, understanding ZooKeeper/ClickHouse Keeper, sharding, replication internals, and the ability to diagnose performance issues at the data-part level.
  • Engineering Mindset (SRE/DevOps): You hate doing the same task twice by hand. Experience writing complex Terraform modules and Ansible roles is mandatory. Programming skills in Python or Go for automation are a huge plus.
  • Hybrid Environment Experience: You understand the differences between running DBs on Bare Metal vs. Kubernetes vs. Cloud and know how to optimize TCO and disk subsystem performance (NVMe, Network Storage).
  • Systems Approach: You see the big picture - from the network packet to the application business logic. You understand the importance of security (FIPS, Audit logs) and Disaster Recovery.
  • English: upper-intermediate or higher - to ensure clear communication of progress within the teams

Nice to Have:

  • Experience building an Internal Developer Platform (IDP).
  • Experience operating databases in Kubernetes (CloudNativePG, Altinity Operator).
  • Experience working in Cloud and Hosting providers on similar services.

Benefits

What's in it for you?

  • A focus on professional development.
  • Interesting and challenging projects.
  • Fully remote work with flexible working hours, which allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide.
  • Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves.
  • Compensation for private medical insurance.
  • Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.
  • Budget for education.
  • The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent.

jobs.excerpt: Our US Partner is seeking a reliable and detail-oriented E-Commerce Platform Specialist to own the day-to-day operation of their e-commerce platform portfolio.
jobs.description:
Our US Partner is seeking a reliable and detail-oriented E-Commerce Platform Specialist to own the day-to-day operation of their e-commerce platform portfolio. The ideal candidate will manage a proprietary branded store platform built in-house, as well as a third-party enterprise e-commerce platform used for complex client deployments.

This role requires strong technical execution, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively with internal teams, sales departments, and enterprise clients. You will spend most of your time inside the platforms building, configuring, and troubleshooting configurations independently.

This is a full-time role, on a US shift and on a Work From Home set-up.

If you have the right skill set, this may be your opportunity to enter this fast-growing organization.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Platform Operations (70%)

  • Build, configure, and launch branded client stores on both internal and external e-commerce platforms.

  • Handle HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript customizations independently, without escalating to the development team.

  • Configure products, categories, pricing, access rules, approval workflows, and checkout settings per client.

  • Manage Single Sign-On (SSO) integrations with client identity providers, including Azure AD.

  • Maintain and monitor integrations with warehouse, fulfillment, and ERP systems.

  • Troubleshoot platform issues, isolate root causes, and resolve or escalate them efficiently.

  • Use Git for version control when working on the internal platform codebase.

  • Keep platform records current, including store specifications, configuration decisions, and onboarding runbooks.

Client and Sales Support (20%)

  • Serve as the operational point of contact for active store clients, handling configuration requests, asset updates, and reporting.

  • Work alongside the sales team to scope new store requirements before commitments are made to a client.

  • Translate client briefs into concrete platform configurations, flagging what is native, what needs custom work, and what is out of scope.

  • Support store launches end-to-end, covering requirements gathering, building, QA, and final go-live execution.

Roadmap and Migrations (10%)

  • Feed the internal platform roadmap with client and operational requirements, working closely with the Head of Technology and front-end developers.

  • Plan and execute migrations of existing client stores from legacy platforms like Magento and Shopify onto the current platform stack.

  • Inventory existing store configurations, product catalogs, and integrations before initiating migrations.

  • Manage content and data transfers, re-platforming workflows seamlessly where necessary.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required Experience & Technical Skills

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience operating or building e-commerce stores across multiple platforms.

  • Direct experience with Magento (Open Source or Commerce) and Shopify, including configuration, theming, product setup, and migrations.

  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript with the ability to make layout, styling, and functional changes independently.

  • Comfortable utilizing Git for version control at a basic operational level.

  • Proven experience configuring SSO integrations (Azure AD / SAML 2.0).

  • Deep understanding of e-commerce platform architecture, including routing, templates, product catalogs, variants, and checkout flows.

  • Ability to read and interpret code well enough to debug without always relying on a developer.

  • Conceptual understanding of integrations (APIs, webhooks, and system connectivity) without needing to build them from scratch.

Professional & Behavioral Skills

  • Strong operational instincts with a proactive, can-do attitude—you close loops, document actions, and do not need to be chased.

  • Comfortable working directly and professionally with enterprise clients and sales teams.

  • A "finisher" mindset: able to take a store brief and take it live without constant escalation, spotting platform gaps early.

  • Commercial awareness to know when to push back on requirements that are structurally unfeasible.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and configurations in a fast-paced environment.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with company store or branded merchandise platforms (such as Liftoff Commerce, BrightStores, or similar).

  • Familiarity with warehouse or fulfillment integrations (ShipStation, Extensiv, or similar).

  • Exposure to NetSuite or another major ERP in an e-commerce context.

  • Prior experience in the promotional products or branded merchandise industry.

Nice-to-have qualifications

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Email Channel
jobs.excerpt: Hi, I'm Brian, Senior Director of Engineering at Customer.
jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Brian, Senior Director of Engineering at Customer.io. We're looking for experienced engineers who want to own a channel end to end — from the infrastructure that delivers billions of messages reliably, to the product surfaces our customers use to build, send, and analyze their campaigns. You'll work across the stack, bringing both systems thinking and product craft to one of the most technically rich problem spaces in the industry.

You don't need email experience to apply. We can teach you the email domain. The engineers who thrive here are the ones who love learning a deep problem space, not only the ones who arrive already knowing it.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React, Ember and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What We Value

Ownership You own problems end to end. You move fast, act like an owner, and thrive in ambiguity. You've led complex projects before, whether officially or not, and you're ready to do it again.

Engineers with product taste You think like a user, not just an engineer. You care how your systems power real customer value — and how to make them better.

A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done" You bring rigor and creativity. Best practices matter — but never more than forward motion.

What You'll Do

  • Build and evolve the frontend experiences customers use to create, preview, and analyze campaigns — editors, configuration, and analytics dashboards
  • Design and scale backend systems that process high volumes of messages and events: queue management, retry logic, rate limiting, and real-time event pipelines
  • Build automated systems that respond intelligently to feedback signals from external providers — classification, suppression, throttling, and health scoring
  • Partner with in-house domain experts to turn their knowledge into automated tooling — you bring the systems skills, they bring the email depth
  • Instrument and monitor channel health end to end: signal detection, anomaly alerting, and observability
  • Own problems end to end — from architecture and schema design to testing, deployment, and monitoring
  • Share knowledge and raise the bar through short videos, thoughtful writing, and mentorship
  • Use AI agents to make multi-file changes by scoping the work, writing the prompt, and verifying the output

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience building scalable, distributed systems in Go (or similar statically typed languages)
  • Experience building product-facing frontend features in React or similar frameworks, with attention to UX quality and polish
  • Experience building or consuming APIs that handle high-throughput async workloads — event streams, queues, and systems that degrade gracefully under load
  • Comfort integrating with external systems you don't control — third-party APIs, rate limits, opaque failure modes — and designing for resilience around them
  • Comfort working in cloud-native environments (AWS, GCP)
  • Familiarity with relational databases (we use MySQL primarily) and an understanding of performance tradeoffs
  • Experience with observability tooling and operating production systems
  • A bias for action over perfection, and pride in owning technical decisions

Nice to have: Familiarity with email infrastructure — deliverability, authentication standards (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), sender reputation, or high-volume sending

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $150,000 - $200,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions — just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  • Application — We review everyone with care. Tell us why you're interested.
  • Recruiter Call (30 mins) — Let's chat about what you're looking for and how we work.
  • Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins) - Talk with one of our hiring managers about your working style and a project you've owned end-to-end, plus a short AI-assisted coding exercise.
  • Technical Interview (60 mins) — A collaborative system design conversation focused on scaling challenges.
  • Take-Home Assignment — Complete a short, realistic task similar to what you'd work on here.
  • Assignment Review Call (60 mins) — Walk us through your work and discuss tradeoffs, priorities, and how you'd iterate.
  • Project Deep Dive (60 minutes: A focused conversation on a technical project you've owned end-to-end, and how you balance planned work against urgent, customer-impacting issues.

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact .

Join us!

We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read and want to build software that makes communication better for everyone — apply now.
